programme.title: Fast verheiratet
programme.desc: Tom and Violet want to get married and as promising as the engagement party is, life circumstances dictate otherwise. Violet gets a two-year job offer in another city. But the two years turn into four and so the walk to the altar becomes more and more drawn out. Five years, to be exact. During this time, the couple is exposed to the expectations of families, religions, the mortality of grandparents and, last but not least, their own self-doubt. / Tom und Violet wollen heiraten und so vielversprechend die Verlobungsfeier auch ist, so anders wollen es die Lebensumstande. Violet bekommt ein zweijahriges Jobangebot in einer anderen Stadt. Doch aus den zwei Jahren werden vier und so zieht sich der Gang zum Traualtar immer mehr in die Lange. Funf Jahre, um genau zu sein. In dieser Zeit sieht sich das Paar den Erwartungshaltungen der Familien, der Religionen, der Mortalitat von GroSSeltern und nicht zuletzt den eigenen Selbstzweifeln ausgesetzt.

programme.title: Twist
programme.desc: Oliver Twist lives on and off the street. He is a fanatical freerunner and a talented graffiti artist. When he is once again on the run from the police, he is taken in by two members of a gang of art thieves led by the experienced fraudster Fagin. Twist is warmly welcomed as if he were joining a new family. But he is also being prepared for a life as an art thief. / Oliver Twist lebt auf und neben der StraSSe. Er ist ein fanatischer Freerunner und ein talentierter Graffitikunstler. Als er wieder einmal auf der Flucht vor der Polizei ist, wird er von zwei Mitgliedern einer Bande von Kunstdieben aufgenommen, die von dem erfahrenen Betruger Fagin angefuhrt wird. Twist wird herzlich willkommen geheiSSen, als ob er in eine neue Familie eintreten wurde. Aber er wird auch auf ein Leben als Kunstdieb vorbereitet.

But the dream vacation soon turns into a nightmare when Mavis realizes that Dracula has fallen in love with the ship's mysterious captain, Ericka, who is hiding a secret. / Die Monsterfamilie besteigt ein luxurioses Kreuzfahrtschiff, damit Dracula eine Pause vom Hotel machen kann. Alle geben sich dem SpaSS hin, den die Kreuzfahrt zu bieten hat, einschlieSSlich Monster-Volleyball, exotischen Ausflugen und das Aufholen ihrer Mondbraune. Aber der Traumurlaub verwandelt sich bald in einen Albtraum, als Mavis erkennt, dass sich Dracula in die mysteriose Kapitanin des Schiffes, Ericka, verliebt hat, die ein Geheimnis verbirgt.

If the candidates answer more questions correctly than the “Jager”, they win. / In der Quizsendung tritt ein Team von vier Kandidaten gegen den "Jager" an. Im Finale treten die verbliebenen Kandidaten im Team gegen den "Jager" an und verteidigen das bisher erspielte Geld. Sie mussen innerhalb von zwei Minuten so viele Fragen wie moglich beantworten. programme.title: Eternal You - From the end of finitude / Eternal You - Vom Ende der Endlichkeit
programme.desc: Start-ups can create AI avatars of the deceased to comfort mourners and provide the opportunity to communicate. This creates a profound examination of the human desire for immortality and the ethical questions that arise from the commercialization of this technology. The possibility of saying goodbye and finding consolation contrasts with the question of who this innovation ultimately serves and who the biggest beneficiaries are. / Start-ups konnen KI-Avatare von Verstorbenen kreieren, um Trauernden Trost zu spenden und die Moglichkeit zur Kommunikation zu bieten. Daraus entsteht eine tiefgreifende Auseinandersetzung mit dem menschlichen Verlangen nach Unsterblichkeit und den ethischen Fragen, die sich aus der Kommerzialisierung dieser Technologie ergeben. Die Moglichkeit, Abschied zu nehmen und Trost zu finden, steht im Kontrast zu der Frage, wem diese Innovation letztendlich dient und wer die groSSten Profiteure sind.

programme.desc: When the well-known writer Victor from Paris dies under mysterious circumstances, a biographer becomes interested in the life of the deceased. Without further ado, he asks the widow Sarah to give him insight into their relationship. She was with the author for over 40 turbulent years. Finally, Sarah is seen in public as Victor's supporting force during his artistic creation process, but she reveals a bitter secret. / Als der namhafte Schriftsteller Victor aus Paris unter mysteriosen Umstanden ums Leben kommt, findet ein Biograf Interesse am Leben des Verstorbenen. Kurzerhand bittet er die Witwe Sarah, ihm Einblick in die gemeinsame Beziehung zu geben. Diese ist uber 40 turbulente Jahre lang mit dem Autor zusammen gewesen. Zuletzt gilt Sarah in der Öffentlichkeit als Victors stutzende Kraft wahrend seines kunstlerischen Schaffungsprozesses, doch sie offenbart ein bitteres Geheimnis.

programme.title: Das Yoga-Magazin
programme.desc: Relax, meditate, find yourself and all this in the living room at home - the “Yoga Magazine” makes it possible. Competent and friendly yoga trainers show the best exercises for switching off. By the way, the program doesn't just report from the television studio. The programs are often recorded in a very special location - for example in Ibiza. / Entspannen, meditieren, zu sich selbst finden und das alles im heimischen Wohnzimmer _ das "Yoga-Magazin" macht es moglich. Kompetente und sympathische Yogatrainer zeigen die besten Übungen zum Abschalten. Die Sendung meldet sich ubrigens nicht nur aus dem Fernsehstudio. Oftmals werden die Sendungen in einer ganz besonderen Location aufgenommen _ zum Beispiel auf Ibiza.

programme.title: “We move Austria” school / "Wir bewegen Österreich" Schule
programme.desc: Der SpaSS an Sport und Bewegung steht bei WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule im Vordergrund. Ziel der ORF-Initiative ist es, Schulerinnen und Schuler sowie Lehrerinnen und Lehrer auf digitalem Weg mit kurzen Bewegungseinheiten zu erreichen und diese damit taglich in den osterreichischen Klassenzimmern stattfinden zu lassen. Weder Turnsaal noch Sportbekleidung oder spezielle Gerate sind dafur notwendig. Als unkompliziertes, tagliches Bewegungsangebot fur das Klassenzimmer will WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule fur mehr Bewegung und eine gesunde und ausgeglichene Lebensweise begeistern. Zum Start der Erweiterung der Initiative WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH auf den Schulbereich stehen 30 Folgen mit einer Dauer von jeweils sechs bis acht Minuten mit maSSgeschneiderten Übungen fur den Schulalltag im Klassenraum zur Verfugung. Im Fokus sind Kraftigung, Geschicklichkeit, Koordination und Entspannung, um den oft stressigen Schultag besser bewaltigen zu konnen. Die Bewegungseinheiten werden von der diplomierten Sportlehrerin Karin Augeneder prasentiert.

The high pressure to perform that is common in normal sports is often eliminated here. There are winners, but no losers. The athletes want to live out a passion together and encourage each other to achieve new, extraordinary achievements. / Unter dem Begriff "Funsport" werden Trend- und Extrem­sportarten zusammengefasst, bei denen es zumeist primar um den SpaSSfaktor geht. Der hohe Leistungsdruck, der in normalen Sportarten ublich ist, entfallt hier haufig. Es gibt Gewinner, aber keine Verlierer. Die Sportler wollen gemeinsam eine Leidenschaft ausleben und sich gegenseitig zu neuen, auSSergewohnlichen Leistungen anspornen.

programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the camera of your favorite TV steam, Roe deer and Mark. programme.title: A nation witness / Narod priča
programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-recorted journalist Biljana Stokic, discovery what the heart of the people tells about the Serbian, the tradition and history of our cities and villages, their everyday life and the struggle for preserving true values, diligent work, faith, and love for theirs and ours, Otamb. In a combination of sincere stories of those who live on their work, through the discovery of the sights and natural beauties of our country and their homes, with the words of hope and inspiration, and with pictures of which the heart is melted, with a cheerfulness that defeats all obstacles and problems, Biljana Stokic will peek into their everyday life. How does an ordinary man live? What are his problems and challenges? What is the strength to work and nurture tradition and good interpersonal relationships? How does our native lump breathe and does she have a flat in her beauty? What do they remember? What are they stunned before? What are they coming back? In front of our camera, they will open up and tell the story, who we do not know how much they carry love, research, courage in themselves, those who know how strangely difficult and easy life is, those who have felt the suffering and beauty of life's simplicity. / Novi format, autorska putopisno-reportažna emisija novinarke Biljane Stokić, otkriće vam šta srce naroda priča o Srpskoj, o tradiciji i istoriji naših gradova i sela, o njihovoj svakodnevici i borbi za očuvanje pravih vrijednosti, marljivom radu, vjeri, i ljubavi prema njihovoj i našoj, otadžbini. U spletu iskrenih priča onih koji žive od svog rada, kroz otkrivanje znamenitosti i prirodnih ljepota naše zemlje i njihovih domova, uz riječi nade i inspiracije, te uz slike od kojih se rastopi srce, sa vedrinom koja porazi sve prepreke i probleme, Biljana Stokić će, dugogodišnjim novinarskim iskustvom, zaviriti u njihovu svakodnevicu. Kako živi običan čovjek? Koji su njegovi problemi i izazovi? U čemu nalazi snagu za radom i njegovanje tradicije i dobrih međuljudskih odnosa? Kako diše naša rodna gruda i ima li joj u ljepoti ravne? Čega se sjećaju? Pred čim ostaju zadivljeni? Čemu se vraćaju? Pred našom kamerom, otvoriće se i ispričati priču, oni za koje ne znamo koliko u sebi nose ljubavi, istrajnosti, hrabrosti, oni koji znaju koliko je život čudnovato težak i lak, oni koji su osjetili i stradanje i ljepotu životne jednostavnosti.

programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the camera of your favorite TV steam, Roe deer and Mark. programme.desc: The Person series is a Turkish criminal drama from 2018. in the director of the Sayplace, which in magnificent way connects the true tragedy and absurdity of life, and the test of existence puts moral values. The story is followed by a retired Judge and the widower Aga, which was diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease. Aware that will soon forget everything, that from his personality and value will not remain nothing, he makes a fatal decision - he will kill all the criminals who skillfully dragged himself under the hands of the law. He goes into a vengeful campaign, and the task of revealing who turns the dirtiest souls and minds of Istanbul the inspection nevers, which has been a jailer in their own living. Will Aga and Nerva be opponents or will join their strengths? How terrible will be the network of secrets, death of witnesses and forgets? / Serija Persona je turska kriminalistička drama iz 2018. godine u režiji Onura Sajlaka, koja na veličanstven način spaja istinsku tragediju i apsurd života, a na test postojanja stavlja moralne vrijednosti. Priča prati penzionisanog sudiju i udovca Agu, kojem je dijagnostifikovana Alchajmerova bolest. Svjestan da će uskoro zaboraviti sve, da od njegove ličnosti i vrijednosti neće ostati ništa, donosi kobnu odluku – ubiće sve zločince koji su se vješto izvukli ispod ruke zakona. On polazi u osvetnički pohod, a zadatak da otkrije ko redom uvija najprljavije duše i umove Istambula pripašće inspektorki Nevri, koja je već godinama tamničar sopstvenih životnih bura. Da li će Aga i Nerva biti protivnici ili će udružiti svoje snage? Koliko će strašna biti mreža tajni, smrtim svjedoka i zaborava?

programme.title: Exercise with Lydia / Vježbajte s Lidijom
programme.desc: In today's world we often don't have time to exercise. Many are the benefits of regular exercise. In addition to body shaping, you are also provided with good health. In addition to good physical form, exercise contributes to good mental health. programme.title: From morning to tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the camera of your favorite TV steam, Roe deer and Mark. The two of them except the couple are in the studio, they are for years and private life. However, what the audience doesn't even want, is that their idyll on the screen has nothing to do with what the cameras turn off - the two of them actually live a nightmare. When the Marko director of Television is quitting, to move to competing television, he gets a blow from which he falls into a coma, and the director finds a double, young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play an Oscar brand, and will it work? In addition to being in an interesting way, with many laughs and life situations, their relationship and relationships with colleagues and friends, even to the vortex of the media, will see many secrets, and those business and new love and friendship, and start new avalanches of rivalry. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

You will meet some of the famous Serbian athletes who have already enrolled in the history of great European clubs. / Emisija "Na ivici terena" otkriće vam kako žive naši poznati sportisti, daleko od domovine, i kako brane boje najvećih klubova. Kako to izgleda njihov život na treninzima i na terenu na kojem se ostavlja srce, suze i znoj i kako provode slobodno vrijeme kada ne osvajaju poene i titule. programme.title: Alo alo
programme.desc: One of the most popular British comedies in the 1980s, located in the World War II in France occupied by German troops. In the town of Nouvion, Rene runs the Cafe Artois, a place to socialize French, and the Germans. Colonel von Strohm asks Renea to hide in his cafe stolen the image, which he wanted himself at the same time as Hitler. Rene is trying to maintain a balance in his business to satisfy French resistance and the Nazi troops and so he could survive. / Jedna od najpopularnijih britanskih komedija 80-ih godina, smještena u Drugi svjetski rat u Francuskoj koju su okupirale njemačke trupe. U gradiću Nouvion, Rene vodi kafić Artois, mjesto za druženje Francuza, a i Nijemaca. Pukovnik Von Strohm traži od Renea da sakrije u svom kafiću ukradenu sliku, koju je istodobno poželio i sam Hitler. Rene pokušava održati ravnotežu u svom poslu kako bi udovoljio francuskom Otporu i nacističkim trupama i tako mogao preživjeti.

programme.title: Beauty UFC 40 / MMA UFC 40
programme.desc: The term "Mixed Martial Arts" was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing a review of the "Ultimate Fighting Championship" tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin "mixed martial arts" se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na "Ultimate Fighting Championship" turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Studio UFC: Fight Night Charles Oliveira vs Mateusz Gamrot
programme.desc: See the study show that is dedicated to the current struggles organized by UFC. This association was founded in 1993. in Las Vegas. / Pogledajte studijsku emisiju koja je posvećena aktuelnim borbama koje organizuje UFC. Ovo udruženje je osnovano 1993. godine u Las Vegasu.

programme.title: Beauty UFC 10 / MMA UFC 10
programme.desc: The term "Mixed Martial Arts" was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing a review of the "Ultimate Fighting Championship" tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin "mixed martial arts" se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na "Ultimate Fighting Championship" turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: MMA UFC Fight Night

programme.title: Boks
programme.desc: Roki Marcano, Mike Tyson, Sugar Ray Robinson, Muhammad Ali, Joe Luis. Should the more reason more to follow this noble martial skill? First traces of boxes we are already in the third century before Christ on Sumerian drawings. Ne propustite svaku priliku da uživate u ovom uzbudljivom sportu.

programme.title: Martial arts - mma / Borilački sport - MMA
programme.desc: The term "Mixed Martial Arts" was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing a review of the "Ultimate Fighting Championship" tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin "mixed martial arts" se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na "Ultimate Fighting Championship" turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Beauty UFC 320 / MMA UFC 320
programme.desc: The term "Mixed Martial Arts" was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing a review of the "Ultimate Fighting Championship" tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin "mixed martial arts" se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na "Ultimate Fighting Championship" turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Football Qualifying for SP 2026 / Fudbal Kvalifikacije za SP 2026
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Football Qualifying for EP U21 / Fudbal Kvalifikacije za EP U21
programme.desc: U21 The European Football Championship is a competition under UEFE organization and is held every two years. At the end of the main competition, the right to perform the right to perform 12 teams, the host and the 11 best representations that are successfully completed by the qualification cycle. A total of 54 teams enter the drum qualification and are distributed in nine groups of six national teams. All national teams in the group play with mutual susrieties home and away. Nine first-placed national teams in each group generate a direct placement to the end of the final, while the four best-placed representations through the playing of the last two months in the final of the European Championship. / U21 Evropsko fudbalsko prvenstvo je takmičenje pod organizacijom UEFE te se održava svake dvije godine. Na završnicu glavnog takmičenja pravo nastupa ostvaruje 12 ekipa, domaćin i 11 najboljih reprezentacija koje uspešno odrade kvalifikacioni ciklus. Ukupno 54 ekipe ulaze u bubanj kvalifikacija i rasporijeđene su u devet grupa po šest reprezentacija. Sve reprezentacije u grupi odigravaju međusobne susrijete kući i u gostima. Devet prvoplasiranih reprezentacija u svakoj grupi ostvaruju direktan plasman na završnicu dok četiri najbolje drugoplasirane reprezentacije preko plej ofa love posljednja dva mijesta u završnici Evropskog prvenstva.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB League / Košarka - VTB liga
programme.desc: The VTB league brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. With the dominant Russian clubs in the league, clubs from Bijelarus, Estonia, Kazakh and Latvia are also attended. Through the history of the League launched in 2008. More clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine participated. Starting from the season 2013-204. The VTB League is also the national championship for Russian clubs, from which the champion of Russia becomes best. In order for clubs to access the league must have a minimum capacity hall for 3000 viewers. The name of the VTB league comes from the General Sponsor of the League of the VTB Bank. FIBA Europe is 2013 officially recognized the league. / VTB liga okuplja ponajbolje košarkaške klubove iz Istočne i Sjeverne Evrope. Uz dominantno ruske klubove u ligi prisustvuju još i klubovi iz Bijelorusije, Estonije, Kazahstana i Letonije. Kroz istoriju lige koja je pokrenuta 2008. godine sudjelovali su još klubovi iz Litvanije i Ukrajine. Počevši od sezone 2013.-2014. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. FIBA Evropa je 2013. službeno prepoznala ligu.

programme.title: Handball - Ehf European League / Rukomet - EHF Europska liga
programme.desc: EHF Cup How else by importance, competition for male handball clubs in Europe begins in 1993. years. Until then, this competition was called the IHF Cup that did its first season in the 1981-1982 season. Since 2012. The EHF Cup was connected by a former EHF Cup Cup Cup Cup. The competition as well as the Champions League consists of part where clubs play by groups and the best passes into the "Knock Out" phase. After the quarterfinals in two matches between the opponent, Sylad "Final Four". Semifinals and finals, as well as a match for a third place, are played on a single match. / EHF kup kako drugo po važnosti takmičenje za muške rukometne klubove u Evropi svoj put započinje 1993. godine. Do tada se ovo takmičenje nazivalo IHF kup koje je svoju prvu sezonu odradilo u sezoni 1981.-1982. Od 2012. godine EHF kupu je priključen nekadašnji EHF Kup pobjednika kupova. Takmičenje se kao i Liga šampiona sastoji od dela gdje klubovi igraju po grupama i najbolji prolazi u "knock out" fazu. Nakon četvrtfinala na dvije utakmice između protivnika sijledi "final four". Polufinale i finale, kao i utakmica za treće mjesto, igraju se na jednu dobijenu utakmicu.

Međunarodne prijateljske nogometne utakmice odlična su prilika izbornicima i savezima za iskoristiti slobodne reprezentativne termine bez službenih utakmica za okupljanje momčadi te uigravanje različitih taktičkih zamisli. programme.title: Basketball - VTB League / Košarka - VTB liga
programme.desc: The VTB league brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. With the dominant Russian clubs in the league, clubs from Bijelarus, Estonia, Kazakh and Latvia are also attended. Through the history of the League launched in 2008. More clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine participated. Starting from the season 2013-204. The VTB League is also the national championship for Russian clubs, from which the champion of Russia becomes best. In order for clubs to access the league must have a minimum capacity hall for 3000 viewers. The name of the VTB league comes from the General Sponsor of the League of the VTB Bank. FIBA Europe is 2013 officially recognized the league. / VTB liga okuplja ponajbolje košarkaške klubove iz Istočne i Sjeverne Evrope. Uz dominantno ruske klubove u ligi prisustvuju još i klubovi iz Bijelorusije, Estonije, Kazahstana i Letonije. Kroz istoriju lige koja je pokrenuta 2008. godine sudjelovali su još klubovi iz Litvanije i Ukrajine. Počevši od sezone 2013.-2014. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. FIBA Evropa je 2013. službeno prepoznala ligu.

programme.title: Handball - Ehf European League / Rukomet - EHF Europska liga
programme.desc: EHF Cup How else by importance, competition for male handball clubs in Europe begins in 1993. years. Until then, this competition was called the IHF Cup that did its first season in the 1981-1982 season. Since 2012. The EHF Cup was connected by a former EHF Cup Cup Cup Cup. The competition as well as the Champions League consists of part where clubs play by groups and the best passes into the "Knock Out" phase. After the quarterfinals in two matches between the opponent, Sylad "Final Four". Semifinals and finals, as well as a match for a third place, are played on a single match. / EHF kup kako drugo po važnosti takmičenje za muške rukometne klubove u Evropi svoj put započinje 1993. godine. programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Football Qualifying for SP 2026 / Fudbal Kvalifikacije za SP 2026
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: LaLiga Talking Football
programme.desc: Interesting talks with current and former participants in the highest, Spanish, football league. They talk about their experiences, opinion and unforgettable time spent in the game. / Interesantni razgovori sa sadašnjim i bivšim učesnicima najviše, španske, fudbalske lige. programme.title: Football Qualifying for SP 2026 / Fudbal Kvalifikacije za SP 2026
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

Neizvesne utakmice i visok nivo kvaliteta fudbala i tehnički aspekt igre čine Segundu izrazito medijski propraćenim takmičenjem.

programme.title: Football Qualifying for SP 2026 / Fudbal Kvalifikacije za SP 2026
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Football - English League / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being a champion of England is a goal that weighs every player of the Premier League. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League / Košarka - Turska liga
programme.desc: The very beginnings of the Turkish basketball take far before the league of 1966. Years. Ear even early 20. The centuries of hoops under the hoops were known in Turkey. Students with Rober College in Istanbul in 1904. They first discovered the charms of this team sport. The first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs started the year after the founding of the league. The second league was launched three years later. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams that plays each with every twice in the regular part after which the play-of eight of the best teams follows. The two weakest placed teams fall out of the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko prije osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plej-of osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. programme.title: Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Basketball - 2. ABA League / Košarka - 2. ABA Liga
programme.desc: 2. The ABA league is the second degree of the regional basketball ABA league. Krka New place is the historical first winner of the ABA 2. Leagues, competitions founded in the 2017/2018 season. With a victory on the Fajnal Forum and a goblet intended for the winner, the Krka team achieved a placement in 1. ABA league from the next season. The league participates 12 teams that seek the road to four best teams and placement on Fainal for. Purpose of the ABA 2. The league is to enable smaller basketball environments competition with stronger regional competition. / 2. ABA liga je liga drugog stepena regionalne košarkaške ABA lige. Krka Novo Mesto je istoriski prvi pobjednik ABA 2. lige, takmičenja koje je osnovano u sezoni 2017/2018. Uz pobedu na fajnal foru i peharu namjenjenom pobjedniku, ekipa Krke ostvarila je i plasman u 1. ABA ligu od sljedeće sezone. U ligi učestvuje 12 ekipa koje nakon dvokružnog sistema utakmica traže put prema četiri najbolje ekipe i plasman na fajnal for. Svrha ABA 2. lige je omogućiti manjim košarkaškim sredinama takmičenje sa jačom regionalnom konkurencijom.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League / Košarka - Turska liga
programme.desc: The very beginnings of the Turkish basketball take far before the league of 1966. Years. Ear even early 20. The centuries of hoops under the hoops were known in Turkey. Students with Rober College in Istanbul in 1904. They first discovered the charms of this team sport. The first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs started the year after the founding of the league. The second league was launched three years later. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams that plays each with every twice in the regular part after which the play-of eight of the best teams follows. The two weakest placed teams fall out of the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko prije osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plej-of osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

The first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs started the year after the founding of the league. The second league was launched three years later. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams that plays each with every twice in the regular part after which the play-of eight of the best teams follows. The two weakest placed teams fall out of the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko prije osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plej-of osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Basketball - 2. ABA League / Košarka - 2. ABA Liga

Leagues, competitions founded in the 2017/2018 season. With a victory on the Fajnal Forum and a goblet intended for the winner, the Krka team achieved a placement in 1. ABA league from the next season. The league participates 12 teams that seek the road to four best teams and placement on Fainal for. Purpose of the ABA 2. The league is to enable smaller basketball environments competition with stronger regional competition. / 2. ABA liga je liga drugog stepena regionalne košarkaške ABA lige. Krka Novo Mesto je istoriski prvi pobjednik ABA 2. lige, takmičenja koje je osnovano u sezoni 2017/2018. Uz pobedu na fajnal foru i peharu namjenjenom pobjedniku, ekipa Krke ostvarila je i plasman u 1. ABA ligu od sljedeće sezone. U ligi učestvuje 12 ekipa koje nakon dvokružnog sistema utakmica traže put prema četiri najbolje ekipe i plasman na fajnal for. Svrha ABA 2. lige je omogućiti manjim košarkaškim sredinama takmičenje sa jačom regionalnom konkurencijom.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League / Košarka - Turska liga
programme.desc: The very beginnings of the Turkish basketball take far before the league of 1966. Years. Ear even early 20. The centuries of hoops under the hoops were known in Turkey. Students with Rober College in Istanbul in 1904. They first discovered the charms of this team sport. The first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs started the year after the founding of the league. The second league was launched three years later. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams that plays each with every twice in the regular part after which the play-of eight of the best teams follows. The two weakest placed teams fall out of the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko prije osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plej-of osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League / Košarka - Turska liga
programme.desc: The very beginnings of the Turkish basketball take far before the league of 1966. Years. Ear even early 20. The centuries of hoops under the hoops were known in Turkey. Students with Rober College in Istanbul in 1904. They first discovered the charms of this team sport. The first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs started the year after the founding of the league. The second league was launched three years later. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams that plays each with every twice in the regular part after which the play-of eight of the best teams follows. The two weakest placed teams fall out of the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko prije osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plej-of osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Basketball - 2. ABA League / Košarka - 2. ABA Liga
programme.desc: 2. The ABA league is the second degree of the regional basketball ABA league. Krka New place is the historical first winner of the ABA 2. Leagues, competitions founded in the 2017/2018 season. With a victory on the Fajnal Forum and a goblet intended for the winner, the Krka team achieved a placement in 1. ABA league from the next season. The league participates 12 teams that seek the road to four best teams and placement on Fainal for. Purpose of the ABA 2. The league is to enable smaller basketball environments competition with stronger regional competition. / 2. ABA liga je liga drugog stepena regionalne košarkaške ABA lige. Krka Novo Mesto je istoriski prvi pobjednik ABA 2. lige, takmičenja koje je osnovano u sezoni 2017/2018. Uz pobedu na fajnal foru i peharu namjenjenom pobjedniku, ekipa Krke ostvarila je i plasman u 1. ABA ligu od sljedeće sezone. U ligi učestvuje 12 ekipa koje nakon dvokružnog sistema utakmica traže put prema četiri najbolje ekipe i plasman na fajnal for. Svrha ABA 2. lige je omogućiti manjim košarkaškim sredinama takmičenje sa jačom regionalnom konkurencijom.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: NHL
programme.desc: "NATONAL HOCKEY LEAGUE" is the most prestigious club hockey competition that dates back to 1917. when the competition was formed and functioned with two more North American hockey stars. Since 1926. NHL becomes the main and most significant hockey association and thus competition in North America. Only the competition is divided into two divisions, western and east and after regular part plays the Pleffeus for the Trophy Stanley Cup. / "Natonal Hockey League" je najprestižnije klupsko hokejaško takmičenje na svijetu koje datira još iz 1917. godine kada je takmičenje formirano i funkcionisalo je sa još dvije sjevernoameričke hokejšake asocijacije. Od 1926. NHL postaje glavna i najznačajnija hokejaška asocijacija i samim time takmičenje u Severnoj Americi. Samo takmičenje je podijeljeno u dve divizije, zapadnu i istočnu te se nakon regularnog dijela igra plejof za trofej Stenli kupa.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Grit and Glory Enduro Mountain Bike Racing
programme.desc: Documentary program on top athletes competing within the elite cycling competition. Meet the cyclists that train hard to achieve the best possible result and learn that they face all challenges on the path to success. / Dokumentarni program o vrhunskim sportiste koji se takmiče u okviru elitnog biciklističkog takmičenja. Upoznajte bicikliste koji vredno treniraju kako bi ostvarili što bolji rezultat i saznajte sa kojim se svim izazovima suočavaju na putu ka uspehu.

programme.title: Mountain biking: Holy Cup _Mont-Sainte-Anne (W) / Brdski biciklizam: Svetski kup _Mont-Sainte-Anne (Ž)
programme.desc: Follow exciting broadcasts from the World Collector World Cup. The competition includes the best cyclists from all over the world, which will try out in different disciplines on fairly demanding trails. / Pratite uzbudljive prenose sa Svetskog prvenstva u brdskom biciklizmu. U takmičenje su uključene najbolje biciklistkinje iz celog sveta, koje će se oprobati u različitim disciplinama na prilično zahtevnim stazama.

programme.title: Mountain biking: Holy Cup, Mont-Sainte-Anne / Brdski biciklizam: Svetski kup, Mont-Sainte-Anne
programme.desc: Follow the stage of the World Cup in Mountain Cycling in the Descpression discipline, which is held in Mont-Sainte-Anne in Canada. / Pratite etapu Svetskog kupa u brdskom biciklizmu u disciplini spust, koja se održava u Mont-Sainte-Anneu u Kanadi.

programme.title: Golf - Japan Championship / Golf - Šampionat Japana
programme.desc: Japan Open Championship is a professional golf tournament as part of Japan Golf Tour. It was founded in 2000 and is one of the four largest tournaments on this golf tour. / Japan Open championship je profesionalni golf turnir u sklopu Japan golf tura. Osnovan je 2000 godine i jedan je od četiri najveća turnira na ovom golf turu.

programme.title: Bike - Tur Lombardy (M) / Biciklizam - Tur Lombardije (M)
programme.desc: The race through Lombard is the last in a series of five monumental classics in the World Cycling Union calendar. "The classic of the opal leaves", as this race is still called, is considered one of the oldest and most prestigious one-day competitions during the fall. At 113. Release of cyclists will ride from bergamers to Komo, 243 kilometers long. / Trka kroz Lombardiju poslednja je u nizu od pet monumentalnih klasika u kalendaru Svetske biciklističke unije. "Klasik opalog lišća", kako se još naziva ova trka, smatra se jednim od najstarijih i najprestižnijih jednodnevnih takmičenja tokom jeseni. Na 113. izdanju biciklisti će voziti od Bergama do Komoa, rutom dugačkom 243 kilometara.

programme.title: UCI GRAVEL World Championship - Review / UCI Gravel Svetsko prvenstvo - Pregled
programme.desc: An overview of the best moments from the World Cycling Championships in which competitors participate that must show speed, but also the ability to overcome the most challenging trails. The event is held from 2022. years. / Pregled najboljih momenata sa Svetskog prvenstva u biciklizmu na kom učestvuju takmičari koji moraju da pokažu brzinu, ali i sposobnost da savladaju najizazovnije staze. Događaj se održava od 2022. godine.

programme.title: Superbajk: Supersport Svetsko Prvenstvo - Estoril
programme.desc: The best young motorcyclists gather in Estoril, the Portuguese city located on the coast of the Atlantic Ocean. This competition is used to acquire experience for future large races. / Najbolji mladi motociklisti okupljaju se u Estorilu, portugalskom gradu koji se nalazi na obali Atlantskog okeana. Ovo takmičenje služi za sticanje iskustva za buduće velike trke.

programme.title: Snuker: Xian Grand Prix
programme.desc: Follow the exciting competition in the Snuker whose host is the Chinese city of Siana. programme.title: Kulturna baština
programme.desc: On the southwestern edge of Petrova Polje, at the foot of the Promine Mountain, Siverić housed. More than a century and a half _ until the 1970s _ was a prosperous place whose main economic flywheel was a coal mine. The mine is gone, and the time when there was a different one in Siverić, it will speak family memories today, almost miraculously saved after turbulent events during the 20th century, wars, persecution, as well as emotional, nostalgic saying that few remaining residents who, despite everything, want to remember only happy days. / Na jugozapadnom rubu Petrova polja, u podnožju planine Promine, smjestio se Siverić. Više od stoljeća i pol _ sve do sedamdesetih godina prošloga stoljeća _ bio je prosperitetno mjesto kojemu je glavni gospodarski zamašnjak bio rudnik ugljena. Rudnika više nema, a o vremenu kad se u Siveriću živjelo drugačije nego danas progovorit će obiteljske uspomene, gotovo čudom spašene nakon turbulentnih događaja tijekom 20. stoljeća, ratova, progonstva, kao i emotivna, nostalgična kazivanja ono malo preostalih stanovnika koji, unatoč svemu, žele pamtiti samo sretne dane.

programme.title: Terminator 3: Machine rebellion / Terminator 3: Pobuna strojeva
programme.desc: Action / Distopia, ZF. It's been a decade since John Connor (Nick Stahl) helped prevent the Day of Judgment _ The day Skynet's advanced network of machines had to acquire self -awareness and destroy humanity. But on August 29, 1997, he came and passed without incidents, despite the two Skynet's failed attempts to kill Connor and began the war against humanity. Now the 22-year-old, Connor lives outside the system _ no home, no credit card, no phone and has no job. There is no record of his existence. No way to find Skynet. As long as ... ... from the shadows of the future, T-X (Kristianna Loken) comes from the shadow of the future, Skynet's most advanced killing machine so far. Sent from the future to complete the job that his predecessor, T-1000, failed to do, that machine is ruthless how attractive his human mask is. And is exponentially more powerful, more dangerous and more destructive than any terminator who came before him. But this time Connor is not the only target on Skynet's list for the shooting _ veterinarian Kate Brewster (Claire Danes), who has nothing to suspect, awaits the collision of an ancient past, the present that promises and the unimaginable future ... but only if he manages to draw an unstoppable T-X terminal. When Connor and Kate realize that their daytime day is dizzying _ only three hours divide from the end of the world _ Their only hope for survival is a redeemed T-100 (Arnold Schwarzenegger), Connor's mysterious _ and now an outdated _ former assassination. Together they have to beat the technologically superior T-X and prevent the threat of the Day of Judgment ... or face the fall of the civilization we know it. / Akcijski / distopija, ZF. Prošlo je desetljeće otkad je John Connor (Nick Stahl) pomogao spriječiti Sudnji dan _ dan kada je Skynetova napredna mreža strojeva trebala steći samosvijest i uništiti čovječanstvo. Ali 29. kolovoza 1997. došao je i prošao bez incidenata, unatoč dvama Skynetovim neuspjelim pokušajima da ubije Connora i započne rat protiv čovječanstva. Sada 22-godišnjak, Connor živi izvan sustava _ nema dom, nema kreditne kartice, nema telefon i nema posao. Nema zapisa o njegovu postojanju. Nema šanse da ga Skynet pronađe. Sve dok... ...iz sjena budućnosti ne dođe T-X (Kristianna Loken), Skynetov dosad najnapredniji stroj za ubijanje. Poslan iz budućnosti kako bi dovršio posao koji je njegov prethodnik, T-1000, nije uspio obaviti, taj je stroj nemilosrdan koliko je njegova ljudska maska privlačna. I eksponencijalno je moćniji, opasniji i destruktivniji od svakog terminatora koji je došao prije njega. Ali ovoga puta Connor nije jedina meta na Skynetovoj listi za odstrel _ veterinarku Kate Brewster (Claire Danes), koja ništa ne sluti, čeka sudar davne prošlosti, sadašnjosti koja obećava i nezamislive budućnosti... ali samo ako uspije umaknuti nezaustavljivu terminatoru T-X. Kada Connor i Kate shvate da im se Sudnji dan vrtoglavo približava _ samo ih tri sata dijele od smaka svijeta _ njihova je jedina nada za preživljavanje preprogramirani terminator T-100 (Arnold Schwarzenegger), Connorov tajanstveni _ i sada zastarjeli _ bivši atentator. Zajedno moraju pobijediti tehnološki nadmoćnog T-X-a i spriječiti prijetnju Sudnjega dana... ili se suočiti s padom civilizacije kakvu poznajemo.

programme.title: Slatka Irma
programme.desc: Comedy. At Fri in Paris, everyone sleeps except the shopkeeper, prostitutes in Casanova and visitors to the cafe in that street. The cafe, whose owner of Moustache (L. Jacobi), is also set by a police officer who blinks for permanent "salary" to the fact that prostitutes are not properly "registered". It is the most beautiful prostitute "Cute" Irma (S. Maclaine) on which his first working morning will bury naive new police officer Nestor Patou (J. Lemmon).
