He does not know that everyone lives in "Idils" _ and underwater and prostitutes and police officers, so he spends a raid in the hotel. Among the "customers" is his head, inspector Lefevre (H. Bernardi), who knocked him off work. Nestor stops in a cafe near Moustache and in a conflict of the Irma's "Protector" Hippolyte (B. Yarnell). It is now a new "protector", Nestor, who falls in love with her head ... "Irma La Douce" was a Broadway Museum, which Billy Wilder was adapted with his permanent collaborator I. A. L. Diamond in the "sentimental comedy without dancing and singing". The music was composed by Andre Previn, who received Oscar for that. Faithfully Wilder's associate Alexandre Trauner imagined and built a beautiful Paris scenography, and J. Lemmon and especially S. Maclaine as Irma are great. Many critics described this film as a "adult fairy tale." / Komedija. U pet ujutro u Parizu svi spavaju osim zaposlenika tržnice, prostitutki u ulici Casanova i posjetitelja kafića u toj ulici. U kafić, čiji je vlasnik Moustache (L. Jacobi), zalazi i policajac-pozornik koji za stalnu "plaću" žmiri na činjenicu da prostitutke nisu propisno "registrirane". Najljepša je prostitutka "Slatka" Irma (S. MacLaine) na koju će svog prvog radnog jutra naletjeti naivni novi policajac-pozornik Nestor Patou (J. Lemmon). Nestoru treba malo dulje kako bi shvatio da su djevojke koje stoje na ulici i odvode muškarce u hotelčić "Casanova" prostitutke. On ne zna da svi žive u "idili" _ i podvodači i prostitutke i policajci, pa provede raciju u hotelu. Među "mušterijama" je i njegov šef, inspektor Lefevre (H. Bernardi), koji ga izbaci s posla. Nestor svrati u kafić kod Moustachea i tu u jednom sukobu premlati Irminog "zaštitnika" Hippolytea (B. Yarnell). Ona odsad ima novog "zaštitnika", Nestora, koji se u nju zaljubi preko glave... "Irma la Douce" bio je brodvejski mjuzikl koji je Billy Wilder adaptirao sa svojim stalnim suradnikom I. A. L. Diamondom u "sentimentalnu komediju bez plesa i pjevanja". Glazbu je skladao Andre Previn koji je za to dobio Oscara. Vjerni Wilderov suradnik Alexandre Trauner zamislio je i izgradio prekrasnu parišku scenografiju, a J. Lemmon i osobito S. MacLaine kao Irma sjajni su. Mnogi su kritičari opisali ovaj film kao "bajku za odrasle".

programme.title: Pozitivno
programme.desc: Find out where it is and how the sanctuary of the Mother of God of Jerusalem was created. The artifacts, documents and books written in Glagolitic script are located in 27 countries and 90 cities. The president of the Glagolitic Friends Society Darko Žubrinić tells us about several less known interesting things related to Glagolitic. Take a peek with us in the oldest church in Bosnia and Herzegovina. / Doznajte gdje se nalazi i kako je nastalo svetište Majke Božje Jeruzalemske. Artefakti, dokumenti i knjige pisane glagoljicom nalaze se u 27 zemalja i 90 gradova. Predsjednik Društva prijatelja glagoljice Darko Žubrinić govori nam o nekoliko manje poznatih zanimljivosti vezanih za glagoljicu. Zavirite s nama u najstariju crkvu u Bosni i Hercegovini.

programme.title: Biblija
programme.desc: When the Bible outlines a man's mission, then it emphasizes the cultivation of the earth, using the theological word that describes the service of God and signifies the servant of the Lord. It also testifies to the harvest ceremonies and the days of gratitude for the fruits of the earth. God is the source of life, and by cultivating the earth and its fertility man is given food to satisfy existential needs. How much do we respect the soil and its fruits and how much do we exploit it? In the Bible, Rev. Ivica Zrno and Djurica Pardon. / Kad Biblija zacrtava čovjekovo poslanje, onda ističe upravo obrađivanje zemlje, rabeći pri tom teološku riječ koja opisuje služenje Bogu i označava slugu Gospodnjega. Ona također svjedoči o žetvenim svečanostima i danima zahvalnosti za plodove zemlje. Bog je izvor života, a obrađivanjem zemlje i njezinom plodnošću čovjeku je dana hrana za zadovoljenje egzistencijalnih potreba. Koliko poštujemo zemlju i njezine plodove a koliko ju izrabljujemo? U Bibliji govore vlč. Ivica Zrno i Đurica Pardon.

programme.title: Misa
programme.desc: Parish of St. The Luke of the Evangelist was founded on July 1, 1975 by the decree of Archbishop Franjo Kuharić from Zagreb. From the first worship at a home church in a popular Mamutica apartment, through the lobby of the elementary school "Gustav Krklec" and the consecration of the newly built parish church on September 16, 2007. According to Cardinal Josip Bozanić, to this day, the parish has overwhelmed five decades of fertile activities. The conceptual architectural solution for the Pastoral Center and this church was given by architects from the parish of Romano Vukoja and Robert Križnjak. The warden of the parish is Rev. Darko Bručić Pavuk, who invited the guest of the pre -foster by Rev. Duje Kurtovic, pastor of Karlovac settlement Švarča. Production Organizer: Luka Zadravec / Župa sv. Luke Evanđelista osnovana je 1. srpnja 1975. dekretom zagrebačkog nadbiskupa Franje Kuharića. Od prvih bogoslužja u kućnoj crkvi u jednom stanu u popularnoj Mamutici, preko predvorja OŠ "Gustav Krklec" i posvećenja novoizgrađene župne crkve 16. rujna 2007. po rukama kardinala Josipa Bozanića, pa sve do današnjih dana, župa je prevalila pet desetljeća plodna djelovanja. Idejno arhitektonsko rješenje za pastoralni centar i ovu crkvu dali su arhitekti iz župe Romano Vukoja i Robert Križnjak. Upravitelj župe je vlč. Darko Bručić Pavuk koji je u povodu 50. obljetnice osnutka župe pozvao gosta predslavitelja vlč. Duju Kurtovića, župnika karlovačkog naselja Švarča. Organizator produkcije: Luka Zadravec

programme.title: Witness to reality and fantasy / Priča o stvarnosti i fantaziji
programme.desc: In the history of Croatian Radio and Television, some people have given their face to a small screen, so we all remember them. And some, behind the camera, created our cultural heritage as authors. We usually don't know much about them. When a man gets off the stage of his life, his story disappears into oblivion. They say some stories existed to be forgotten. Thanks to the fragments of the memory of colleagues and friends, preserved recordings and fragments of literary creativity, this one, at least for now, is not. More than four hundred works of all television formats and genres were preserved in the HRT archives, signed by director Drazen Piskoric. This is the story of the "reality and fantasy" of his life. / U povijesti Hrvatske radiotelevizije neki ljudi su dali svoje lice malom ekranu, pa ih svi pamtimo. A neki su, iza kamere, kao autori stvarali našu kulturnu baštinu. O njima, obično, ne znamo mnogo. Kad čovjek siđe s pozornice svoga života, njegova priča nestaje u zaboravu. Kažu kako su neke priče postojale da bi bile zaboravljene. Zahvaljujući fragmentima sjećanja kolega i prijatelja, sačuvanim snimkama i ulomcima literarnog stvaralaštva, ova, barem zasad, nije. U arhivu HRT-a sačuvano je više od četiri stotine djela svih televizijskih formata i žanrova koje potpisuje redatelj Dražen Piškorić. Ovo je priča o "stvarnosti i fantaziji" njegova života.

programme.desc: On Wednesday, April 20, 2016, Dr. Michael Schulenberg gives Prince therapy because of the symptoms of the abstinence crisis. Andrew Kornfeld te dugogodišnji Princeovi prijatelji Kirk Johnson i Meron Kekure sutradan dolaze u Paisley Park potražiti Princea. Na svoj užas, nalaze njegovo beživotno tijelo na podu dizala. programme.title: Witness to reality and fantasy / Priča o stvarnosti i fantaziji
programme.desc: In the history of Croatian Radio and Television, some people have given their face to a small screen, so we all remember them. And some, behind the camera, created our cultural heritage as authors. We usually don't know much about them. When a man gets off the stage of his life, his story disappears into oblivion. They say some stories existed to be forgotten. Thanks to the fragments of the memory of colleagues and friends, preserved recordings and fragments of literary creativity, this one, at least for now, is not. More than four hundred works of all television formats and genres were preserved in the HRT archives, signed by director Drazen Piskoric. This is the story of the "reality and fantasy" of his life. / U povijesti Hrvatske radiotelevizije neki ljudi su dali svoje lice malom ekranu, pa ih svi pamtimo. A neki su, iza kamere, kao autori stvarali našu kulturnu baštinu. O njima, obično, ne znamo mnogo. Kad čovjek siđe s pozornice svoga života, njegova priča nestaje u zaboravu. Kažu kako su neke priče postojale da bi bile zaboravljene. Zahvaljujući fragmentima sjećanja kolega i prijatelja, sačuvanim snimkama i ulomcima literarnog stvaralaštva, ova, barem zasad, nije. programme.title: Third age / Treća dob
programme.desc: The long -awaited amount of annual pension supplement, colloquially called the thirteenth pension, was welcomed as a cold shower for many pensioners _ Just on the International Day of the Elderly, October 1. The amount of 6 euros per year is considered as shameful, and the abolition of pension taxes _ by favoring those with the highest income. On the other hand, the Government and coalition partner of the Croatian pensioner party point out that this contributes to the improvement of the position of the elderly fellow citizens. But most of them barely survive, pensioners are testified daily. Unfortunately, there are a small number of those whose pensions exceed the average and who will feel an increase after applying a new tax policy. More than 60 percent of a total of one million and two hundred thousand retirees receive pensions lower than the average, which officially amounts to 690 euros. It will be the president of the Croatian Pensioners' Union on Monday about all this and the way of 6 euros per year of the year _ in the show on Monday on Monday, and State Secretary of State Marinko Luikned will be given. / Dugoočekivani iznos godišnjeg dodatka na mirovinu, kolokvijalno nazvan trinaesta mirovina, dočekan je kao hladan tuš za mnoge umirovljenike _ upravo na Međunarodni dan starijih osoba, 1. listopada. Iznos od 6 eura po godini staža mnogi smatraju sramotnim, a ukidanje poreza na mirovine _ pogodovanjem onima s najvišim primanjima. S druge strane, Vlada i koalicijski partner Hrvatska stranka umirovljenika ističu da se time doprinosi unaprjeđenju položaja starijih sugrađana. No, da većina jedva preživljava, svakodnevno svjedoče upravo umirovljenici. Nažalost, malen je broj onih čije mirovine prelaze prosjek i koji će osjetiti povećanje nakon primjene nove porezne politike. Više od 60 posto od ukupno milijun i dvjesto tisuća umirovljenika prima mirovine niže od prosjeka, koji službeno iznosi 690 eura. O svemu tome _ i o načinu na koji se došlo do iznosa od 6 eura po godini staža _ u emisiji Treća dob u ponedjeljak na govorit će predsjednica Sindikata umirovljenika Hrvatske Višnja Stanišić, a pojašnjenje će dati i državni tajnik Marinko Luikneda.

programme.title: Lidijina kuhinja

Desert će biti kolačići s ricottom i komadićima čokolade, omiljeni u Lidijinoj obitelji. Pridružite se Lidiji i naučite koliko je ricotta svestrana.

Svakodnevno putuju u školu, na treninge, igraju se na ulicama i pločnicima, a njihova sigurnost u velikoj je mjeri u našim rukama. Koliko ih učimo prometnim pravilima, koliko smo mi odrasli odgovorni, što možemo učiniti da im put bude siguran?

programme.title: Lovac na bilje
programme.desc: The herb hunter visits the "Croatian Sahara", which is made up of the remains of the only Croatian desert and the geographical-Botanical reserve. The desert is located on the eastern part of the town of Đurđevac. Đurđevac Sands represent a variety of habitats for the entire living settlement. Some of the plants in this episode are gray thunder, silk, chin chin, early hamster, rabbit and medicinal asparagus. The guests of the episode are B.Sc. Geology Martin Mahović and Željka Kolar from the Public Institution for Management of Protected Nature Parts in the Koprivnica-Križevci County. / Lovac na bilje posjećuje "Hrvatsku Saharu" koju čine ostaci jedine hrvatske pustinje i geografsko-botanički rezervat. Pustinja se nalazi na istočnom dijelu Grada Đurđevca. Đurđevački pijesci predstavljaju raznolika staništa za cijelo živo naselje. Neke od biljaka u ovoj epizodi su siva gromotulja, svilenica, vlasulja bradica, rani hrčak, zečjak i ljekovita šparoga. Gosti epizode su dipl. ing. geologije Martin Mahović i Željka Kolar iz Javne ustanove za upravljanje zaštićenim dijelovima prirode na području Koprivničko-križevačke županije.

programme.title: Witness to reality and fantasy / Priča o stvarnosti i fantaziji
programme.desc: In the history of Croatian Radio and Television, some people have given their face to a small screen, so we all remember them. And some, behind the camera, created our cultural heritage as authors. We usually don't know much about them. When a man gets off the stage of his life, his story disappears into oblivion. They say some stories existed to be forgotten. Thanks to the fragments of the memory of colleagues and friends, preserved recordings and fragments of literary creativity, this one, at least for now, is not. More than four hundred works of all television formats and genres were preserved in the HRT archives, signed by director Drazen Piskoric. This is the story of the "reality and fantasy" of his life. / U povijesti Hrvatske radiotelevizije neki ljudi su dali svoje lice malom ekranu, pa ih svi pamtimo. A neki su, iza kamere, kao autori stvarali našu kulturnu baštinu. O njima, obično, ne znamo mnogo. Kad čovjek siđe s pozornice svoga života, njegova priča nestaje u zaboravu. Kažu kako su neke priče postojale da bi bile zaboravljene. Zahvaljujući fragmentima sjećanja kolega i prijatelja, sačuvanim snimkama i ulomcima literarnog stvaralaštva, ova, barem zasad, nije. U arhivu HRT-a sačuvano je više od četiri stotine djela svih televizijskih formata i žanrova koje potpisuje redatelj Dražen Piškorić. Ovo je priča o "stvarnosti i fantaziji" njegova života.

programme.title: Ben Fogle - the people of the wilderness / Ben Fogle - Ljudi od divljine
programme.desc: The Ben Fogle adventurer will spend the week in the Portuguese highlands with Alex, 39, a British, who once dealt with the sale of outdoor equipment, and today he lives lonely on the hillside. The psychic crisis and personal tragedy forced him to reconsider his life and move out of Britain. Ben will find out that Alex once survived without heating, electricity and water. Today, it remodges centuries -old buildings into an ideal farmhouse. She will tell Ben what challenges face by living in the hottest part of Portugal, and that, although he enjoys a solitary life, he is ready to hang out with like -minded people again. Among the like -minded people is a friend who helps him accomplish the plan to open the farm for guests. And she has an exceptional life story. / Pustolov Ben Fogle provest će tjedan u portugalskom gorju s Alexom (39), Britancem koji se nekoć bavio prodajom opreme za boravak na otvorenom, a danas samotno živi na obronku planine. Psihička kriza i osobna tragedija prisilile su ga da preispita život i odseli se iz Britanije. Ben će saznati kako je Alex svojedobno preživio bez grijanja, struje i vode. Danas preuređuje stoljetne građevine u idealan seoski dom. Ispričat će Benu s kakvim se izazovima suočava živeći u najtoplijem dijelu Portugala i kako je, premda uživa u samotnjačkom životu, spreman ponovno se družiti s istomišljenicima. Među istomišljenicima je i prijateljica koja mu pomaže ostvariti plan da farmu otvori za goste. I ona ima iznimnu životnu priču.

programme.title: Labirint
programme.desc: In the heart of the post -war Yugoslavia, Industrogradnja, a company that changed cities and lives, was born. Skyscrapers, hotels, monumental bridges, housing _ _ It all built it. And it was built in Germany, Poland, Iraq, Russia ... Moscow adorns the impressive Russian Academy of Sciences, which is their hands. In the show "Legend of Industrogradnja" we discover stories behind concrete and steel, we explore who created and who destroyed Industrogradnja. How did the construction giant who once counted 12,500 employees disappeared? / U srcu poslijeratne Jugoslavije rodila se Industrogradnja, firma koja je mijenjala gradove i živote. Neboderi, hoteli, monumentalni mostovi, stambeni objekti _ sve je to ona gradila. A gradilo se u Njemačkoj, Poljskoj, Iraku, Rusiji... Moskvu krasi impresivna Ruska akademija znanosti koja je njihovih ruku djelo. U emisiji "Legenda o Industrogradnji" otkrivamo priče iza betona i čelika, istražujemo tko je stvarao, a tko rušio Industrogradnju. Kako je nestao građevinski div koji je nekad brojao 12.500 zaposlenih?

programme.title: Roditeljstvo u životinjskom svijetu
programme.desc: On the open lawns of our planet, parents must constantly weigh between risk and gain when raising the next generation. Although abundant grass promises an abundance of food and places where the family can settle, open regions mean competition and predators. In England, the imaginative potter is exploiting all the grace of the lawn. Skillfully builds a clay cradle and is full to the top of the offspring for offspring they will never meet. In the Keni Park, Masai Mara Geprodica on the outdoor expanses of the cubs shows the hunting skills they will need when they grow up. It will be crucial when she needs help with the gnu cub. It is more difficult for others to achieve. On the open plains of Donji Zambezi, everything is on the side of the thirty -member pack of wild dogs. But parents have to instill a sense of discipline into their inexperienced cubs or hunting can perish. In India, Mother Langu's must learn to be good nanny before they take on the role of parents _ and to some it does not fall easy! It is a world where the balance between risk and gain is constantly changing: parents everywhere in Ravnice are forced to new and difficult decisions. In the Kalahari nests of brownish sparrows, the largest in the world, usually protecting the colony from the sun's heat. But unbearable thermal wave causes the breakdown of social order as dissatisfied neighbors begin to throw birds out of the nest. In Patagonia, the mother of Gvanak must join thousands of others in an attempt to arrive at winter feding sites for the survival of their descendants, in which they are disturbed by kilometers and kilometers of fences. Adversity and parents are increasingly difficult for animal parents, but people can provide simple solutions. / Na otvorenim travnjacima našeg planeta roditelji moraju pri podizanju sljedećeg naraštaja stalno vagati između rizika i dobitka. Iako obilna trava obećava obilje hrane i mjesta na kojima se obitelj može nastaniti, otvoreni predjeli znače konkurenciju i grabežljivce. U Engleskoj domišljata lončarska osa iskorištava svu blagodat travnjaka. Vješto gradi glinenu kolijevku i puni je do vrha gusjenicama za potomstvo koje nikad neće upoznati. U kenijskom parku Masai Mara gepardica na otvorenom prostranstvu mladuncima pokazuje lovačke vještine koje će im trebati kad odrastu. Bit će to presudno kad joj zatreba pomoć u obaranju mladunca gnua. Drugima je ravnotežu teže postići. Na otvorenim ravnicama donjeg Zambezija, sve je na strani trideseteročlanog čopora divljih pasa. Ali roditelji moraju u svoje neiskusne mladunce usaditi osjećaj discipline ili im lov može propasti. U Indiji majke langura moraju naučiti biti dobre dadilje prije nego što preuzmu ulogu roditelja _ a nekima to ne pada lako! To je svijet u kojem se ravnoteža između rizika i dobitka stalno mijenja: roditelji svugdje u ravnicama prisiljeni su na nove i teške odluke. U Kalahariju gnijezda smeđokapih vrabaca, najveća na svijetu, obično štite koloniju od sunčeve topline. No nepodnošljivi toplinski val uzrokuje raspad društvenog poretka jer nezadovoljni susjedi počinju izbacivati ptiće iz gnijezda. U Patagoniji majka gvanaka mora se pridružiti tisućama drugih u pokušaju da stigne na zimska hranilišta radi opstanka njihovih potomaka, u čemu ih ometaju kilometri i kilometri ograde. Nedaće i roditelje životinjskim je roditeljima sve teže zaobići, ali ljudi mogu pružiti jednostavna rješenja.

programme.title: Ples sudbine
programme.desc: The sugar reed mill is flooded. The village was destroyed and many residents lost almost everything and became homeless. They have to sleep in old slave dwellings in the mill. Due to heavy rain, water in the rural well is contaminated. That's why almost everyone got sick. Isadora spends the night in housing for slaves with all workers who help around everything and around Rafael. Joaquim claims with the master, Eugeni and Violet for the theft of money from the factory. But runs away for úrsula. Isadora provodi noć u nastambi za robove sa svim radnicima koji pomažu oko svega i oko Rafaela. Joaquim se sukobi s majstorom, Eugeniom i Violetom zbog krađe novca iz tvornice. Ali bježi zbog Úrsule. programme.title: Third age / Treća dob
programme.desc: The long -awaited amount of annual pension supplement, colloquially called the thirteenth pension, was welcomed as a cold shower for many pensioners _ Just on the International Day of the Elderly, October 1. The amount of 6 euros per year is considered as shameful, and the abolition of pension taxes _ by favoring those with the highest income. On the other hand, the Government and coalition partner of the Croatian pensioner party point out that this contributes to the improvement of the position of the elderly fellow citizens. But most of them barely survive, pensioners are testified daily. Unfortunately, there are a small number of those whose pensions exceed the average and who will feel an increase after applying a new tax policy. More than 60 percent of a total of one million and two hundred thousand retirees receive pensions lower than the average, which officially amounts to 690 euros. It will be the president of the Croatian Pensioners' Union on Monday about all this and the way of 6 euros per year of the year _ in the show on Monday on Monday, and State Secretary of State Marinko Luikned will be given. / Dugoočekivani iznos godišnjeg dodatka na mirovinu, kolokvijalno nazvan trinaesta mirovina, dočekan je kao hladan tuš za mnoge umirovljenike _ upravo na Međunarodni dan starijih osoba, 1. listopada. Iznos od 6 eura po godini staža mnogi smatraju sramotnim, a ukidanje poreza na mirovine _ pogodovanjem onima s najvišim primanjima. S druge strane, Vlada i koalicijski partner Hrvatska stranka umirovljenika ističu da se time doprinosi unaprjeđenju položaja starijih sugrađana. No, da većina jedva preživljava, svakodnevno svjedoče upravo umirovljenici. Nažalost, malen je broj onih čije mirovine prelaze prosjek i koji će osjetiti povećanje nakon primjene nove porezne politike. Više od 60 posto od ukupno milijun i dvjesto tisuća umirovljenika prima mirovine niže od prosjeka, koji službeno iznosi 690 eura. O svemu tome _ i o načinu na koji se došlo do iznosa od 6 eura po godini staža _ u emisiji Treća dob u ponedjeljak na govorit će predsjednica Sindikata umirovljenika Hrvatske Višnja Stanišić, a pojašnjenje će dati i državni tajnik Marinko Luikneda.

programme.title: Dr. Beck
programme.desc: Children are the most vulnerable participants in traffic. They travel to school every day, for training, play on the streets and sidewalks, and their safety is largely in our hands. How much do we teach them traffic rules, how many are adults responsible, what can we do to make their way safe? / Djeca su najranjiviji sudionici u prometu. Svakodnevno putuju u školu, na treninge, igraju se na ulicama i pločnicima, a njihova sigurnost u velikoj je mjeri u našim rukama. programme.title: Dulum zemlje
programme.desc: On Dugi Island, the Žamer family shows how it is possible to make a living from agriculture and in island conditions. Their goats, chickens and pigs are a source of food and pride, because being a shepherd on the island means to guard tradition and identity. In addition to the production of cheese, vegetables and eggs, the family runs Robinson tourism on the islet of Krkknat. The episode also brings the story of Goran Morovic, the owner of a luxury hotel on Dugi Otok, who brings in a new dimension of tourism into an island life. / Na Dugom otoku obitelj Žampera pokazuje kako je moguće živjeti od poljoprivrede i u otočnim uvjetima. Njihove koze, kokoši i svinje su izvor hrane i ponosa, jer biti pastir na otoku znači čuvati tradiciju i identitet. Osim proizvodnje sira, povrća i jaja, obitelj vodi robinzonski turizam na otočiću Krknata. Epizoda donosi i priču Gorana Morovića, vlasnika luksuznog hotela na Dugom otoku koji unosi novu dimenziju turizma u otočki život.

programme.title: Ben Fogle - the people of the wilderness / Ben Fogle - Ljudi od divljine
programme.desc: Ben Fogle goes to Emerald Island this time. He will visit George and Bettin, an Austrian-German married couple who has been living in the Ireland wilderness for 40 years. He would tell him what they led them to leave their life in Europe so far, as they found a new life and discovered beauty in the middle of a peat. They turned a piece of land into their corner of paradise, built a house and deeply connected with the nature that surrounds them. Ben will help them tear down the dried trees, they will catch up with the neglected drainage bright and bathe in a cold stream. He is aware that George and Bettini will be increasingly difficult to maintain possession over time. / Ben Fogle ovaj put ide na Smaragdni Otok. Posjetit će Georga i Bettinu, austrijsko-njemački bračni par koji već 40 godina živi u irskoj divljini. Ispričat će mu što ih je navelo da ostave dotadašnji život u Europi, kako su našli novi život i otkrili ljepotu usred tresetišta. Pusti komad zemlje pretvorili su u svoj kutak raja, izgradili kuću i duboko se povezali s prirodom koja ih okružuje. Ben će im pomoći srušiti osušena stabla, uhvatit će se u koštac sa zapuštenim odvodnim jarkom i okupati u hladnom potoku. Svjestan je da će Georgu i Bettini s vremenom biti sve teže održavati posjed.

programme.title: Ne zaboravite ostaviti recenziju
programme.desc: The fries were cold, the waiter was fiery! Reviews like this cure of the main chef, but cheered the restaurant owner. Hungry tourists are one of the biggest challenges. Is our sea enough for the Croatian gastrooponide to get five stars? / Pomfrit je bio hladan, konobar je bio vatren! Recenzija poput ove naljuti glavnog kuhara, ali razveseli vlasnika restorana. programme.title: Kotlina
programme.desc: "Kotlina" is a Bosnian criminal drama in five sequels. The series brings a dark and tense insight into the modern Sarajevo, where an investigation of a crime reveals layers of social tensions, personal dilemmas and hidden truths. Chief Inspector Edib Pasic and journalist Ajla Pasic soon realize that the search for the truth introduces them to the world of decisions that are difficult to justify but easily understand. ---- There was a body of an unknown man in the Botanical Garden of the National Museum of BiH. The investigation runs Senior Inspector Edib Pasic and his partner Mido Zec, while journalist Ajla Pasic accidentally becomes a witness to the beginning of the investigation. It is still not clear whether it is an accident or murder. At the same time, Sarajevo faces the return of Senci, who, after a long prison sentence, reveals that the city is no longer the same. / "Kotlina" je bosanskohercegovačka kriminalistička drama u pet nastavaka. Serija donosi mračan i napet uvid u suvremeno Sarajevo, gdje istraga jednog zločina otkriva slojeve društvenih tenzija, osobnih dilema i skrivenih istina. Glavni inspektor Edib Pašić i novinarka Ajla Pašić ubrzo shvaćaju da ih potraga za istinom uvodi u svijet odluka koje je teško opravdati, ali lako razumjeti. ---- U botaničkom vrtu Zemaljskog muzeja BiH pronađeno je tijelo nepoznatog muškarca. Očevid vode viši inspektor Edib Pašić i njegov partner Mido Zec, dok novinarka Ajla Pašić slučajno postaje svjedok početka istrage. Još uvijek nije jasno radi li se o nesreći ili ubojstvu. U isto vrijeme, Sarajevo se suočava s povratkom Senčija, koji nakon dugogodišnje zatvorske kazne otkriva da grad više nije isti.

programme.title: Razgovor s razlogom
programme.desc: The guest of the show Talking for a reason is longtime correspondent Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung for Southeast Europe _ German journalist and writer Michael Martens. We talk to him about why he is so captivated by the past and the way we handle it. How much was his interest in the fact that his grandfather was a Wehrmacht officer? Why is it difficult for us to put historical events in a realistic context? How did he come up with the idea to write a book about the breakup of the former Yugoslavia _ and is the correct claim that Germany was to blame for the process? What were the relations of German Chancellor Helmut Kohl and Croatian President Franjo Tudjman? What do the documents he explored about the relationship between Croatian politics to BiH at the time are revealed? From family history, through the breakup of Yugoslavia, to current events in Croatia and Europe _ There are many reasons to talk to Michael Martens. / Gost emisije Razgovor s razlogom je dugogodišnji dopisnik Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitunga za jugoistočnu Europu _ njemački novinar i pisac Michael Martens. S njim razgovaramo o tome zašto ga toliko zaokuplja prošlost i način na koji se s njom nosimo. Koliko je na njegov interes utjecala činjenica da mu je djed bio časnik Wehrmachta? Zašto nam je teško povijesne događaje staviti u realni kontekst? Kako je došao na ideju napisati knjigu o raspadu bivše Jugoslavije _ i je li točna tvrdnja da je za taj proces bila kriva Njemačka? Kakvi su bili odnosi njemačkog kancelara Helmuta Kohla i hrvatskog predsjednika Franje Tuđmana? Što otkrivaju dokumenti koje je istraživao o odnosu tadašnje hrvatske politike prema BiH? Od obiteljske povijesti, preko raspada Jugoslavije, do aktualnih zbivanja u Hrvatskoj i Europi _ mnogo je razloga za razgovor s Michaelom Martensom.

programme.desc: According to ancient philosophy, four basic elements intersection create our planet. One of them is water. She has created exceptional places that have always enchanted and confuse a man _ palau, a salty plain of Salar de Uyuni, Bolivia, Cenote in Mexico and more. In this sequel, legends and science help explain the origin and beauty of these unusual landscapes. / Prema antičkoj filozofiji, četiri osnovna elementa međudjelovanjem stvaraju naš planet. Jedan je od njih voda. Stvorila je iznimna mjesta koja oduvijek očaravaju i zbunjuju čovjeka _ Palau, slanu ravnicu Salar de Uyuni u Boliviji, cenote u Meksiku i još mnogo toga. U ovom nastavku legende i znanost pomažu objasniti postanak i ljepotu tih neobičnih krajolika.

Salomao encourages Tiaga to admit to Cacau what he feels for her, but he decides to go to reconcile with her. / Otac hvali Tiaga jer se suprotstavio Marcu, ali prizna da se brine da bi Marco mogao nauditi Cacau. Cacau obavijesti Reginu i Valdemara o Marcovoj prijetnji i odluči da neće s njime dijeliti skrbništvo nad sinom. Salomao potiče Tiaga da prizna Cacau što osjeća prema njoj, ali on se odluči otići pomiriti s njom.

programme.title: With our home / Kod nas doma
programme.desc: The daily show in our home is discussed every day afternoon about current topics and events in our country and in the world. It brings stories of inspirational people and follow important social events, fashion shows and premiere. In a pleasant atmosphere of study with public figures and experts, leaders talk about interesting topics. / Dnevna emisija Kod nas doma svaki radni dan poslijepodne progovara o aktualnim temama i zbivanjima kod nas i u svijetu. Donosi priče inspirativnih ljudi i prate važne društvene događaje, modne revije i premijere. U ugodnoj atmosferi studija s javnim osobama i stručnjacima voditelji razgovaraju o zanimljivim temama.

programme.title: Vijesti iz kulture
programme.desc: Culture news is followed daily events from different areas of culture and art. / Vijesti iz kulture svakodnevno prate događaje iz različitih područja kulture i umjetnosti.

programme.title: Skica za portret
programme.desc: In the form of a short documentary film, the show represents the authors important for Croatian history and culture. / U formi kratkog dokumentarnog filma emisija predstavlja autore važne za hrvatsku povijest i kulturu.

programme.title: Kulturna baština
programme.desc: Represents the diversity and wealth of monuments throughout Croatia. It reveals our heritage, from prehistoricity to this day. / Predstavlja raznolikost i bogatstvo spomenika diljem Hrvatske. Otkriva našu baštinu, od prapovijesti do danas.

programme.title: Dr. Beck
programme.desc: In the show Dr. Beck we will talk about diseases that once ran the world and related millions of lives, and today they are just historic terms for many. The plague, tuberculosis, polio, syphilis ... But are they really gone or are they just hiding? / U emisiji Dr. Beck razgovarat ćemo o bolestima koje su nekoć harale svijetom i odnosile milijune života, a danas su za mnoge tek povijesni pojmovi. Kuga, tuberkuloza, polio, sifilis... No, jesu li doista nestale ili se samo skrivaju?

programme.title: Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: Lidia will remind us of the importance of gathering at the table. With his grandson Olivia, she will prepare an impressive fried pelvis -shaped cheese stuffed with a colorful salad. We will then see the pasta Bucati with a broccoli and walnut pesto. The luxurious taste of every snack of that dish is like a warm hug. The following are peppers stuffed with turkey, which everyone would be able to prepare. Join Lydia because it is always more fun in society. / Lidia će nas podsjetiti na važnost okupljanja za stolom. S unukom Olivijom pripremit će dojmljivi prženi sir u obliku zdjelica nadjeven šarenom salatom. Potom ćemo vidjeti tjesteninu bucatini s pestom od brokule i oraha. Raskošan okus svakog zalogaja tog jela nalik je na topao zagrljaj. Slijede paprike nadjevene puretinom, koje bi svatko znao pripremiti. Pridružite se Lidiji jer je u društvu uvijek zabavnije.

programme.title: TV kalendar
programme.desc: Documentary-historical show, has been aired daily since 1976. Prikazuje važne događaje i obljetnice iz hrvatske i svjetske povijesti.

programme.desc: When Beverly learns that Linda Schwartz is preparing lunch for Thanksgiving, she is afraid that her role is the main housewife in the family and Erica's mom threatened; Murray's father surprises his family when he comes with a new friend. / Kad Beverly sazna da Linda Schwartz priprema ručak za Dan zahvalnosti, boji se da je njezina uloga glavne domaćice u obitelji i Ericine mame ugrožena; Murrayjev otac iznenadi obitelj kada dođe s novom prijateljicom.

programme.title: Izvan formata
programme.desc: There is a magazine in Croatia where you will not find a single advertisement, a magazine whose texts are read several times, and each copy is kept on shelves among books. Tonight we talk about a project called "Kàko" tonight, which brings us back to the time when we enjoyed texts that require dedication and attention _ texts that bring stories about creative individuals, guardians of tradition, social phenomena and amazing places. In the studio, we talk to Nives Bosniak, Magazine editor, and Ivan Blagajic, the driver of this unique project. Vid Baric, Lucija Tunkovic, Kristina Gavran and Alen Maric also participate in the show. / U Hrvatskoj postoji magazin u kojem nećete naći ni jednu reklamu, magazin čiji se tekstovi čitaju više puta, a svaki primjerak čuva se na policama među knjigama. Večeras u emisiji razgovaramo o projektu pod nazivom "Kàko", koji nas vraća u vremena kad smo uživali u tekstovima koji zahtijevaju posvećenost i pažnju _ tekstovima koji donose priče o kreativnim pojedincima, čuvarima tradicije, društvenim fenomenima i začudnim mjestima. U studiju razgovaramo s Nives Bošnjak, urednicom magazina, i Ivanom Blagajićem, pokretačem ovog jedinstvenog projekta. U emisiji sudjeluju i Vid Barić, Lucija Tunković, Kristina Gavran i Alen Marić.

programme.title: Night music program - videos / Noćni glazbeni program - spotovi
programme.desc: In the night hours we show new videos, shots of concerts and festivals and music shows from the HTV archive. / U noćnim satima prikazujemo nove spotove, snimke koncerata i festivala te glazbene emisije iz arhive HTV-a.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Adam finally fell on Nyu, but his excitement suddenly subsided when Brea tells him that he will attend college in another city; Adam fears that he will not be able to maintain a distance relationship. / Adam je napokon upao na NYU, ali uzbuđenje mu naglo splasne kad mu Brea kaže da će pohađati koledž u drugome gradu; Adam se boji da neće moći održati vezu na daljinu.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Beverly thinks of a plan to save Mike's marriage in disintegration, but her head is both made; Barry asks Adam and his friends to make a home movie in which he will play James Bond to seduce Joanne. / Beverly smisli plan da spasi Mikeov brak u raspadu, ali obije joj se o glavu; Barry traži od Adama i svojih prijatelja da snime kućni film u kojemu će on glumiti Jamesa Bonda kako bi zaveo Joanne.

programme.title: Dom na kvadrat
programme.desc: Due to the growing population of cities, the European Union brought a "green plan" to reduce or completely remove greenhouse gases in cities. We bring advice on how we can help with that. We visited a beautiful house that used to be a cottage, and the owner rearranged her into living space. / Zbog sve većeg broja stanovnika gradova, Europska unija donijela je "Zeleni plan" za smanjenje ili potpuno uklanjanje stakleničkih plinova u gradovima. Donosimo savjete kako možemo pomoći u tome. Posjetili smo predivnu kuću koja je nekad bila vikendica, a vlasnica ju je preuredila u životni prostor.

programme.title: Poslovni plan
programme.desc: The show brings the latest news from the economy, talks about perspectives, economic forecasts, GDP movement, problems and growth generators. / Emisija donosi najnovije vijesti iz ekonomije, govori o perspektivama, ekonomskim prognozama, kretanju BDP-a, problemima i generatorima rasta.

programme.title: Samo lagano
programme.desc: Today we will be about old _ in a new way. We will also talk about gifted people who have been able to find inspiration in what is daily to create something new and unique. Their ideas, skillful hands and enthusiasm have encouraged us to connect six separate stories into one unit united precisely _ talent. "No one knows what his powers are until they use them," Johann Wolfgang Goethe said. That is why even today be with us, and by the next time, think about what your powers are, start, put your effort to do _ and success will not be missing! And don't forget _ just lightly! / Danas ćemo o starome _ na nov način. Govorit ćemo i o nadarenim ljudima koji su u onome što je svakodnevno uspjeli pronaći nadahnuće za stvaranje nečega novog i jedinstvenog. Njihove ideje, vješte ruke i entuzijazam potaknuli su nas da šest zasebnih priča povežemo u jednu cjelinu koju ujedinjuje upravo _ talent. "Nitko ne zna koje su njegove moći dok ih ne iskoristi", rekao je Johann Wolfgang Goethe. Zato i danas budite s nama, a do sljedećeg puta razmislite koje su vaše moći, pokrenite se, uložite trud _ i uspjeh neće izostati! I ne zaboravite _ samo lagano!

programme.title: Auto Market Magazin
programme.desc: Neven Novak tested Geely Starray with a two -liter gasoline. We drove the Porsche 911 in Crete, Lynkandco 08 arrived in Croatia, Sara explains everything about the design of Cupre Tavascan. Suzuki organized a moto road show. Branimir tested the new Citroen C3 Aircross. Stay with us. / Neven Novak testirao je Geely Starray s dvolitrenim benzincem. Na Kreti smo vozili Porsche 911, u Hrvatsku je stigao LynkAndCo 08, Sara objašnjava sve o dizajnu Cupre Tavascan. Suzuki je organizirao Moto Road Show. Branimir je testirao novi Citroen C3 Aircross. Ostanite uz nas.

programme.title: Hotel Portofino
programme.desc: Cecil is trying to get his wife with the offer to cover the cost of remodeling, which causes suspicion with Belle and wonders what he expects in return, and what it means for her increasingly friendship with architect Marc Bonacini. Nish reluctantly helps Gianluci to attack fascists, but with a catastrophic outcome. / Cecil suprugu pokušava pridobiti ponudom da će pokriti troškove preuređenja, što kod Belle izaziva sumnjičavost i pita se što on očekuje zauzvrat te što to znači za njezino sve čvršće prijateljstvo s arhitektom Marcom Bonacinijem. Nish nevoljko pomogne Gianluci da napadne fašiste, ali s katastrofalnim ishodom.

programme.title: Hotel Portofino
programme.desc: Cecil hooked with gangsters who took over the local casino, and Betty's war with workers comes to emissions. Nish is on the run and Daniona is looking for him, and Bella and Lucian must help him avoid arrest. Lucian and Constance leave themselves to feelings. / Cecil se zakvači s gangsterima koji su preuzeli mjesni kasino, a Bettyn rat s radnicima dolazi do usijanja. Nish je u bijegu i Danioni ga traži, a Bella i Lucian moraju mu pomoći da izbjegne uhićenje. Lucian i Constance prepuštaju se osjećajima.

programme.title: Svijet vrtlara
programme.desc: We check what autumn news in the new Frances Tophill garden is as it estimates tomatoes in its converted greenhouse. And it should also be addressed by deploying permanent vegetables, before going to a specialized nursery for plants for a modernized pond. Rekha Mistry tells us about the successes and failures of her new vegetable garden in Peak District. Errol Reuben Fernandes goes to the garden in the center of Wakefield, who goes pace with today and gathers his community around him. In London, we are with a herbalist who has turned his yard into a botanical garden, and in Devon we get to know the main gardener who is trying to deal with the changing climate in various ways. In addition, we bring more video storage about the gardens sending us viewers. / Provjeravamo koje su jesenske novosti u novom vrtu Frances Tophill dok procjenjuje rajčice u svojem prenamijenjenom stakleniku. A treba se pozabaviti i razmještanjem trajnih povrtnica, prije nego što ode u specijalizirani rasadnik po biljke za modernizirani ribnjak. Rekha Mistry nam govori o uspjesima i neuspjesima u svojem novom povrtnjaku u Peak Districtu. Errol Reuben Fernandes odlazi u vrt u središtu Wakefielda koji ide u korak s današnjim vremenom i oko sebe okuplja svoju zajednicu. U Londonu se nalazimo s biljkoholičarem koji je svoje dvorište pretvorio u botanički vrt, a u Devonu upoznajemo glavnog vrtlara koji se na razne načine pokušava nositi s promjenjivom klimom. Osim toga donosimo još videouradaka o vrtovima koje nam šalju gledatelji.

programme.title: Krimi matineja: Grantchester
programme.desc: Seeking answers for Ms. Maguire, Sidney found himself in an isolated village without his priestly collar and full of doubts about himself, and only his resourcefulness can save him. Will Geordie find and save her best friend on time? / Tražeći odgovore za gđu Maguire, Sidney se našao u izoliranom selu bez svog svećeničkog ovratnika i pun sumnji u sebe, a spasiti ga može samo njegova snalažljivost. Hoće li Geordie na vrijeme naći i spasiti svog najboljeg prijatelja?

programme.title: Krimi matineja: Bitange iz Pizzofalconea
programme.desc: The murder of a young Volunteer of Crnkinja, who was killed near her parish, worried the parishioners and other young volunteers who help the poorest in the Pizzofalcone district. The concern also enhances the evil rumors that question the reputation of a young pastor, who is suspected of being in a love affair with the victim. A series of discoveries will take investigators in search of his brother a volunteer who was in bad relationships with his sister, and he was seen at the crime scene and since then he has disappeared. Still, some of the disturbing discoveries about the past of the young volunteer will further transfer the suspicion of the pastor. Lojacono seems to be increasingly convinced of the guilt of priests in the investigation that is very sensitive and complicated. / Ubojstvo mlade volonterke crnkinje, koja je ubijena u blizini njezine župe, zabrine župljane i druge mlade volontere koji pomažu najsiromašnijima u četvrti Pizzofalcone. Zabrinutost pojačaju i zle glasine koje dovode u pitanje reputaciju mladog župnika, za kojeg se sumnja da je bio u ljubavnoj vezi sa žrtvom. Niz otkrića odvest će istražitelje u potragu za bratom volonterke koji je bio u lošim odnosima sa sestrom, a viđen je na mjestu zločina i otad je nestao. Ipak, neka od uznemirujućih otkrića o prošlosti mlade volonterke dodatno će prebaciti sumnju na župnika. Čini se da je i Lojacono sve više uvjeren u krivnju svećenika u istrazi je koja je vrlo osjetljiva i komplicirana.

programme.title: Krimi matineja: Nijemi svjedok
programme.desc: After the man falls from the skyscraper, forensics gradually enter the criminal mile of the infamous mafia group of Ndranghet. With the help of the State Agency for the Fight against Organized Crime, Nikki and its teams try to reveal the truth. As the investigation is becoming increasingly shocking, Nikki internets in the mafia network, with fatal consequences. While Jack reveals shocking evidence, Nikki is concluded by an unexpected alliance and approaching the case to solve, but at the price of new casualties. / Nakon što muškarac padne s nebodera, forenzičari postupno ulaze u kriminalni milje zloglasne mafijaške skupine Ndrangheta. Uz pomoć Državne agencije za borbu protiv organiziranoga kriminala, Nikki i njezina ekipa pokušavaju otkriti istinu. Kako istraga postaje sve potresnija, Nikki se upliće u mafijašku mrežu, s kobnim posljedicama. Dok Jack otkriva šokantne dokaze, Nikki sklapa neočekivani savez i približava se razrješenju slučaja, no po cijenu novih žrtava.

programme.title: Karl Lagerfeld: Razotkrivanje
programme.desc: In 1952, Karl Lagerfeld arrived in Paris, where the fashion industry was in full swing. He met Yves Saint-Laurent and two young men, then assistants in reputable fashion houses, immediately became friends. They had very similar ambitions and even then the rivalry between them was visible. A series of memories scenes takes us to Nazi Germany and Karl's past, which he has been trying to hide all his life. His family supported the Nazis, and Karl was a lonely child, different from classmates. He was very close to his mother, who took him to the first fashion show. Published, he decided to go to Paris and become a designer. / Godine 1952. Karl Lagerfeld stigao je u Pariz, gdje je modna industrija bila u punom zamahu. Upoznao je Yvesa Saint-Laurenta i dva su mladića, tada pomoćnici u uglednim modnim kućama, odmah postali prijatelji. Imali su vrlo slične ambicije i već se tada naziralo suparništvo između njih. Niz scena sjećanja odvodi nas u nacističku Njemačku i Karlovu prošlost, koju je cijelog života pokušavao skriti. Njegova je obitelj podržavala naciste, a Karl je bio usamljeno dijete, različito od prijatelja iz razreda. Bio je vrlo blizak s majkom, koja ga je odvela na prvu modnu reviju. Očaran, odlučio je otići u Pariz i postati dizajner.

programme.title: Volim Hrvatsku
programme.desc: Sunday afternoon again, the show of the show I love Croatia. The captains are Dusan Bucan and Goran Navojec. The third show on the Dušan team will compete: Dora Dimić Rakar, Filip Detelic and Marina Orsag. In Goran's team we will watch Ananda Djuranovic, Filip Vidovic and Galjen Asim. Competitors will try well -known games such as a hit song, a happy birthday, TV and film, sports, famous compatriots, scams, average citizen and the word Croatia. The show is led by Mirko Fodor. Live music hits are performed by the band Ante Gele. / Nedjeljna popodneva ponovno uveseljava ekipa šoua Volim Hrvatsku. Kapetani su Dušan Bućan i Goran Navojec. U trećoj emisiji u Dušanovom timu natjecat će se: Dora Dimić Rakar, Filip Detelić i Marina Orsag. U Goranovom timu gledat ćemo Anandu Đuranović, Filipa Vidovića i Asima Ugljena. Natjecatelji će se okušati u dobro poznatim igrama poput Pogodi pjesmu, Sretan rođendan, TV i film, Sport, Poznati sunarodnjaci, Premetaljke, Prosječni građanin i Riječ hrvatska. Emisiju vodi Mirko Fodor. Hitove domaće glazbe uživo izvodi bend Ante Gele.

programme.title: Ne zaboravite ostaviti recenziju
programme.desc: Today's tourism has a new guide _ Google Maps. He knows the best path, the most attractive places and locations where it is worth stopping. The spectacular tool for which it actually works _ the whole world. Eight billion people leave reviews that lead us to unforgettable locations, but also to bizarre places we would never discover ourselves. How do digital platforms affect the way we travel and how is our tourist offer adapted to new rules? Croatian tourism of the future _ with one or five stars? / Današnji turizam ima novog vodiča _ Google Maps. On zna najbolji put, najatraktivnija mjesta i lokacije na kojima vrijedi stati. Spektakularan alat za koji zapravo radi _ cijeli svijet. Osam milijardi ljudi ostavlja recenzije koje nas vode do nezaboravnih lokacija, ali i do bizarnih mjesta koja sami nikada ne bismo otkrili. Kako digitalne platforme utječu na način na koji putujemo i kako se novim pravilima prilagodila naša turistička ponuda? Hrvatski turizam budućnosti _ s jednom ili pet zvjezdica?

programme.title: Policijske priče
programme.desc: Sometimes the perpetrators of the person you least expect, but Marijo Orlović and his team in his career have seen everything. The episode brings a story about an unexpected crime that paralyzed until yesterday a quiet tourist place. / Ponekad su počinitelji osobe od kojih to najmanje očekujete, ali Marijo Orlović i njegov tim u svojoj karijeri su vidjeli sve. Epizoda donosi priču o neočekivanom zločinu koji je paralizirao do jučer mirno turističko mjesto.

programme.title: Dnevnik Nomada
programme.desc: Kristijan Ilicic continues his journey with Egypt, and the traces of the Seljan brothers, as well as a personal fascination with local mythology, lead it to Giza, a town near Kairo, where he visits the world miracle _ pyramid. But the pyramids are just part of the fascinating and enigmatic history of ancient Egypt, which after an all -night train, he continues to explore in Luxor, a city where Pharaoh's ghosts are very present. Christian in Luxor reveals a series of impressive, huge temples with his unusual stories. Drawn to the irresistible charm of the sunset on the Nile, the night welcomed by sailing this great river. Nile was also a peasant brothers a signpost to travel to the final goal of _ Ethiopia. But before going to the depth of Africa, Christian leaves to visit the Red Sea, where he divers around the coral ridge, sailing to the Dolphin house and learns why Hurgada is one of the currently popular tourist destinations. / Kristijan Iličić nastavlja svoje putovanje Egiptom, a tragovi braće Seljan, kao i osobna fascinacija lokalnom mitologijom, vode ga do Gize, grada nedaleko Kaira, gdje posjećuje svjetsko čudo _ piramide. Ali piramide su samo dio fascinantne i zagonetne povijesti Starog Egipta, koju nakon cjelonoćnog putovanja vlakom nastavlja istraživati u Luxoru, gradu u kojem su duhovi faraona itekako prisutni. Kristijan u Luxoru otkriva niz impresivnih, golemih hramova sa svojim neobičnim pričama. Privučen neodoljivim šarmom zalaska Sunca na Nilu, noć dočeka ploveći ovom velikom rijekom. Nil je i braći Seljan bio putokaz za putovanje prema konačnom cilju _ Etiopiji. Ali Kristijan prije odlaska u dubinu Afrike odlazi posjetiti Crveno more, gdje roni oko koraljnog grebena, plovi do Kuće delfina i saznaje zašto je Hurgada jedna od trenutačno popularnijih turističkih destinacija.

programme.title: Hvar: Spartan World Championship race
programme.desc: The Croatian island of Hvar again becomes the center of the world in the increasingly popular sports discipline _ obstacles. On Saturday, October 11th, the Spartan World Championship returns, the adrenaline elimination type, which will be held again in the central Hvar Square. Competitors will face 100 meters of speed obstacles, which test strength, speed and agility in direct calculation. HRT will also monitor this competition in direct broadcast on the HRTi platform and the recording on HRT2. The commentator of the race is Bruno Kovacevic. / Hrvatski otok Hvar ponovno postaje središte svijeta u sve popularnijoj sportskoj disciplini _ utrci s preprekama. U subotu, 11. listopada, vraća se Svjetsko prvenstvo Spartan 100M, adrenalinska utrka eliminacijskog tipa koja će se ponovno održati na središnjem hvarskom trgu. Former Mike Jeffries CEO has taken over the company "Abercrombie and Fitch" when she was on exhalation and turned it into an empire worth billions of dollars. It became the embodiment of "clergy". After months of painstaking research, "Panorama" will talk to men who claim that they have been drawn into the dark world created to satisfy the sexual fantasy of Jeffies and his British partner Matthew Smith. They have been silent for years because they were afraid they would break confidence contracts. They describe how because of their experiences they feel used and traumatized. The highly positioned American lawyer requested the prosecutors to launch an investigation. / BBC-jeva "Panorama" istražuje optužbe o iskorištavanju i zlostavljanju u jednom od najvećih modnih brendova u Americi. Bivši izvršni direktor Mike Jeffries preuzeo je tvrtku "Abercrombie And Fitch" kad je bila na izdisaju i pretvorio je u carstvo vrijedno milijarde dolara. Postala je utjelovljenje "kulerstva". Nakon mjeseci mukotrpnog istraživanja, "Panorama" će razgovarati s muškarcima koji tvrde da su ih uvukli u mračni svijet stvoren da zadovolji seksualne maštarije Jeffriesa i njegova britanskog partnera Matthewa Smitha. Godinama su šutjeli jer su se bojali da će prekršiti ugovore o povjerljivosti. Opisuju kako se zbog svojih iskustava osjećaju iskorišteno i traumatizirano. Visoko pozicionirani američki odvjetnik zatražio je da tužioci pokrenu istragu.

Nagađanja o pravim razlozima potresala su Njemačku. No onda je Amanda Evans, novinarka News of the Worlda, otkrila vijest koja je izazvala senzaciju u svijetu. U članku naslovljenom Tajno dijete Borisa Beckera, s fotografijom djeteta koje je nevjerojatno nalikovalo teniskoj zvijezdi, potanko je iznijela sve pojedinosti o Borisovu susretu s manekenkom i prevoditeljicom Angelom Ermakovom.

programme.title: Grantchester
programme.desc: The disappeared child brings anxiety into the hearts of the villagers and Sidney must gather the community when the Sloga is most needed. programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Erica and Geoff decide to make fun to prove that they can still have fun as students, even though they are engaged; Beverly persuades the school principal to make a play inspired by the musical "glory" as a farewell to graduates. / Erica i Geoff odluče prirediti zabavu da dokažu da se i dalje mogu zabavljati kao studenti, iako su zaručeni; Beverly nagovara ravnatelja škole da prirede predstavu nadahnutu mjuziklom "Slava" kao oproštaj od maturanata.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: After the orientation weekend in college, Adam and Brea admit something that could jeopardize their relationship; Barry and Beverly openly acknowledge that they love artistic skating and investigate their shared passion. / Nakon orijentacijskog vikenda na koledžu, Adam i Brea priznaju nešto što bi moglo ugroziti njihovu vezu; Barry i Beverly otvoreno priznaju da vole umjetničko klizanje i istraže svoju zajedničku strast.

programme.title: Klub čitatelja
programme.desc: In the show, we talk about Olja Knezevic's book Strad Fortunat. programme.title: Night music program - videos / Noćni glazbeni program - spotovi
programme.desc: In the night hours we show new videos, shots of concerts and festivals and music shows from the HTV archive. / U noćnim satima prikazujemo nove spotove, snimke koncerata i festivala te glazbene emisije iz arhive HTV-a.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Geoff and Joanne are unpleasantly surprised by Goldberg's family custom for Valentine's Day. Despite the effort, Adam fails to be just friends with Bre. / Geoff i Joanne neugodno iznenade Goldbergove obiteljskim običajem za Valentinovo. Unatoč trudu, Adam ne uspijeva biti samo prijatelj s Breom.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Barry is forced to spend the weekend with ex -girls and their boys on Eric's and Geoff's common maiden/boys. Adam wants to prevent Lou not to ruin a wedding video. / Barry je prisiljen provesti vikend s bivšim djevojkama i njihovim dečkima na Ericinoj i Geoffovoj zajedničkoj djevojačkoj/momaćkoj zabavi. Adam želi spriječiti Loua da ne upropasti video za vjenčanje.

programme.title: Escape to the interior / Bijeg u unutrašnjost
programme.desc: Sonali Shah helps the young couple choose her first shared house in the picturesque landscape of the foreign currency. Sonali also went to the sea to find out more about a project that raises awareness of life below the surface of the sea along this magic coast. / Sonali Shah pomaže mladom paru odabrati svoju prvu zajedničku kuću u slikovitom krajoliku Devona. Sonali se također otisnula na more kako bi saznala više o projektu koji podiže svijest o životu ispod površine mora duž ove čarobne obale.

programme.title: Wonderful world of design: new streets / Čudesni svijet dizajna: Nove ulice
programme.desc: Thirty years, architect John and office administrator Julia are planning to build a fantastic house designed by John. They are tormented by evil happiness _ recession, losing their jobs and surpassing offers for the parcels have stopped their dream of a standalone construction. They finally secured a plot in the hill in Oxfordshire and more than ever wanting to build their home! Architect John designed the beautiful modernist part of the home to withdraw: it is elegant, it is a hiding place of life trials. But as soon as they start construction, their unhappy string continues. Coronavirus closure stops construction and every month spent in their expensive housed house is eroded by their limited budget and therefore threatens their plans for a leisurely pension. Pressure further harms John's health. However, with limited means, there is no choice but to run the project of this complex construction. / Trideset godina arhitekt John i uredska administratorica Julia planiraju izgraditi fantastičnu kuću koju je dizajnirao John. Muči ih zla sreća _ recesija, gubitak posla i nadmašivanje ponuda za parcele stali su na put njihovu snu o samostalnoj gradnji. Napokon su osigurali parcelu u Graven Hillu u Oxfordshireu i više nego ikad žele izgraditi svoj dom! Arhitekt John dizajnirao je prekrasan modernistički dio doma u koji će se povući: elegantno je to skrovište od životnih kušnji. No čim počnu s gradnjom, njihov nesretni niz se nastavlja. Zatvaranje zbog koronavirusa zaustavlja gradnju i svaki mjesec proveden u njihovoj skupoj unajmljenoj kući nagriza njihov ograničeni budžet te stoga ugrožava njihove planove za lagodnu mirovinu. Pritisak dodatno šteti Johnovu zdravlju. Ipak, s ograničenim sredstvima, nema drugog izbora nego sam voditi projekt ove kompleksne gradnje.

programme.title: Patina Mexican dishes / Patina meksička jela
programme.desc: Temozoon is the birthplace of the famous Jukatan smoked meat, Carne Ahumada, and everyone in the city claims that their cousin has designed this way of preparation. It will suffer to walk through the city to try different versions of this specialty. / Temozoon je rodno mjesto poznatog jukatanskog dimljenog mesa, carne ahumada, a svi u gradu tvrde da je baš njihov rođak osmislio taj način pripreme. Pati će prošetati gradom kako bi isprobala različite verzije ovog specijaliteta.

programme.title: Vrtlarski klub Alana Titchmarsha
programme.desc: Alan answers the spectators' gardening, Camilla Bassett-Smith explores the spectacular garden on the coastal, Claire Lowrie advises how to prepare room plants for summer, and Katy Watson reveals how to plant smart for periods of droughts and heavy rainfall. / Alan odgovara na vrtlarska pitanje gledatelja, Camilla Bassett-Smith istražuje spektakularan vrt na priobalju, Claire Lowrie savjetuje kako pripremiti sobne biljke za ljeto, a Katy Watson otkriva kako saditi pametno za razdoblja suše i obilnih kiša.

programme.title: Putovanja za vikend s Greggom Wallaceom
programme.desc: Gregg Wallace knows what we need for the holiday mood, the Christmas fair. Therefore, he goes to Vienna, a city where the Christmas fairs have arisen, where it will discover what it takes for the fair to be perfect and how best to enjoy them. It will get to know the world of warm drinks, special decorations, interesting traditions, winter games and many treats. It will tell us why this city, which is held today, is held more than 50 fairs, the source of numerous British Christmas traditions. / Gregg Wallace zna što nam treba za blagdansko raspoloženje, božićni sajam. Stoga odlazi u Beč, grad u kojem su božićni sajmovi nastali, gdje će otkriti što je potrebno da bi sajam bio savršen i kako najbolje uživati u njima. Upoznat će svijet toplih napitaka, posebnih ukrasa, zanimljivih tradicija, zimskih igara i mnogo poslastica. Reći će nam zašto je taj grad, u kojem se danas održava više od 50 sajmova, izvor brojnih britanskih božićnih tradicija.

programme.title: Austrijska gorska sela
programme.desc: In the valleys such as Gastajna, Klajnarlic and Grosarla, old mountain villages are rooted, rooted in local customs. The Gastajn valley has been marked by mining for centuries. The former miners nurture a special custom: dancing with swords. Willi Huttegger is certainly one of the most innovative mountain peasants. By exploiting his mountain pasture and his trade on the estate in the valley, he managed to switch to full -time agriculture. Markus Schaidreiter is still a young peasant in the Klajnarla valley who, under the motto "One for All, All for One" in cooperation with two other engaged young farmers, managed to achieve the merger of all three rural farms. The three of them want to return to the roots of agriculture. / U dolinama kao što su Gastajnska, Klajnarlska i Grosarlska raštrkana su stara planinska sela, ukorijenjena u lokalnim običajima. Gastajnska dolina stoljećima je bila obilježena rudarstvom. Bivši rudari njeguju poseban običaj: ples s mačevima. Willi Huttegger jamačno je jedan od najinovativnijih gorskih seljaka. Iskorištavanjem svog planinskog pašnjaka i svojom trgovinom na imanju u dolini uspio se prebaciti na poljodjelstvo s punim radnim vremenom. Markus Schaidreiter još je mlad seljak u Klajnarlskoj dolini koji je pod geslom "jedan za sve, svi za jednoga" u suradnji s još dvojicom angažiranih mladih poljodjelaca uspio postići spajanje svih triju seoskih gospodarstava. Njih trojica žele se vratiti korijenima poljodjelstva.
