programme.title: Endeavour - Young Morse / Endeavour - Mladi Morse
programme.desc: Endeavour, again sober, returns to the Castle Gate station at the moment of shocking discovery in a college garden. The investigation runs him and Thursdaya to the famous Oksford Orchestra, and when a new tragedy occurs, this time among musicians, they discover a network of secrets in his heart. At the same time, bloody London problems are overflowing at Oxford when cruel murder in an abandoned warehouse occurs. Solving the puzzle of Endeavour and Thursday, they notice disturbing links with a case that they hoped remained far behind them. / Endeavour se, ponovno trijezan, vraća u postaju Castle Gate baš u trenutku šokantnog otkrića u vrtu jednog koledža. Istraga vodi njega i Thursdaya do slavnog oksfordskog orkestra, a kad se dogodi nova tragedija, ovaj put među glazbenicima, oni otkriju mrežu tajni u njegovu srcu. Istodobno se krvavi londonski problemi prelijevaju u Oxford kad se dogodi okrutno ubojstvo u napuštenom skladištu. Rješavajući zagonetku Endeavour i Thursday uočavaju uznemirujuće poveznice sa slučajem za koji su se nadali da je ostao daleko iza njih.

programme.title: European Table Tennis Championship (W) / Europsko prvenstvo u stolnom tenisu (Ž)
programme.desc: From October 12 to 19, 2025. Zadar will host the 44th European Table Tennis Championship, where 24 men's national teams will weigh forces in groups and knockout stages. The competition in the Višnjik Hall brings top -notch sports, tension and spectacular encounters in the hike to the title. / Od 12. do 19. listopada 2025. Zadar će biti domaćin 44. Europskog ekipnog prvenstva u stolnom tenisu, gdje će 24 muške reprezentacije odmjeriti snage u grupama i nokaut fazama. Natjecanje u dvorani Višnjik donosi vrhunski sport, napetost i spektakularne susrete u pohodu na naslov.

programme.title: Auto Market Magazin
programme.desc: A new car models, technological innovation, test new vehicles, bring about maintenance tips. / U emisiji za ljubitelje automobila svaki tjedan predstavljaju se novi modeli automobila, tehnološke inovacije, testiraju nova vozila, donose savjeti o održavanju.

programme.title: Moj put
programme.desc: It is amazing how many strengths, positive energy and persistence hides in Gordana Glass, a fragile and essential Zagreb woman, since 1998. It is long and often not very comfortable to be her path to international success. From her workshop, fascinating works of art, mostly weighing and hundreds of pounds, leave for the world. Gordana is a mother of two adult sons, a woman ready to share with the needy a nice word and make her living space beautiful her work. She bent her family-commercial nest in Lamac, the suburb of Bratislava, who was inhabited by her compatriots five hundred years ago. It was one of the hundreds of the majority of Croatian villages then. Today, there are only four left: Croatian grave, Jandorf, Cunovi and Devinska Nova you. This is the latter for 36 years in memory of the centuries -old tradition and history of Croats in the area hosting the Festival of Croatian Culture. Exposed to assimilation stronger than ever before, they seek to say that they are still guarding their customs and language. Devinski's natives New Vasi still remember that Fanfare announced the first festival. It symbolically encouraged the awakening of there, the formerly forgotten, the Croatian community. It was in June 1989, on the eve of the "velvety revolution" that marked the end of the epoch of political one -sidedness. Thanks to the courage and sacrifice of many generations, the festival invokes memories of the ancient Croatian ancestor. Mostly weights, hardworking and hardworking people have inherited from the past of their specialty, the specific Chakavian-Ikav version of the Croatian Burgenland dialect, tunes, costumes, traditional dishes. / Nevjerojatno je koliko se snage, pozitivne energije i upornosti krije u Gordani Glass, krhkoj i eteričnoj Zagrepčanki, od 1998. stanovnici glavnoga slovačkog grada Bratislave. Dug je i nerijetko ne baš lagodan bio njezin put do međunarodnog uspjeha. Iz njezine radionice u svijet odlaze fascinantna umjetnička djela mahom teška i stotine kilograma. Gordana je majka dvojici odraslih sinova, žena spremna podijeliti s potrebitima lijepu riječ i svojim radovima uljepšati im životni prostor. Svoje obiteljsko-poslovno gnijezdo savila je u Lamaču, predgrađu Bratislave, koje su prije petstotinjak godina naselili njezini sunarodnjaci. Bilo je to jedno od stotinjak tada većinskih hrvatskih sela. Danas su ostala tek četiri: Hrvatski Grob, Jandorf, Čunovo i Devinska Nova Vas. Upravo ovo potonje već 36 godina u spomen na stoljetnu tradiciju i povijest Hrvata na tom prostoru domaćin je Festivala hrvatske kulture. Izloženi asimilaciji snažnije nego ikada prije, nastoje poručiti da još čuvaju svoje običaje i jezik. Starosjedioci Devinske Nove Vasi još pamte kako su fanfare najavile prvi festival. Njime je simbolično potaknuto buđenje tamošnje, dotad pomalo zaboravljene, hrvatske zajednice. Bilo je to u lipnju 1989., uoči "baršunaste revolucije" koja je označila kraj epohe političkog jednoumlja. Zahvaljujući hrabrosti i požrtvovnosti mnogih naraštaja, festival priziva sjećanja na davne hrvatske pretke. Mahom težaci, radišni i vrijedni ljudi baštinili su od prošlosti svoje posebnosti, specifičnu čakavsko-ikavsku inačicu hrvatskog gradišćanskog narječja, napjeve, nošnje, tradicionalna jela.

programme.title: Also: More / Pula: More
programme.desc: A mosaic informative issue dedicated to the richness of our Adriatic Sea, Coast and Coast. It brings interesting reports on topics related to living at sea and with it. It is broadcast from HRT studies Split, Rijeka, Zadar and Pula. / Mozaična informativna emisija posvećena bogatstvu našeg Jadranskog mora, obale i priobalja. Donosi zanimljive reportaže o temama vezanim za život na moru i uz njega. Emitira se iz HRT-ovih studija Split, Rijeka, Zadar i Pula.

programme.title: Ben Fogle - the people of the wilderness / Ben Fogle - Ljudi od divljine
programme.desc: The Ben Fogle adventurer will spend the week in the Portuguese highlands with Alex, 39, a British, who once dealt with the sale of outdoor equipment, and today he lives lonely on the hillside. The psychic crisis and personal tragedy forced him to reconsider his life and move out of Britain. Ben will find out that Alex once survived without heating, electricity and water. Today, it remodges centuries -old buildings into an ideal farmhouse. She will tell Ben what challenges face by living in the hottest part of Portugal, and that, although he enjoys a solitary life, he is ready to hang out with like -minded people again. Among the like -minded people is a friend who helps him accomplish the plan to open the farm for guests. And she has an exceptional life story. / Pustolov Ben Fogle provest će tjedan u portugalskom gorju s Alexom (39), Britancem koji se nekoć bavio prodajom opreme za boravak na otvorenom, a danas samotno živi na obronku planine. Psihička kriza i osobna tragedija prisilile su ga da preispita život i odseli se iz Britanije. Ben će saznati kako je Alex svojedobno preživio bez grijanja, struje i vode. Danas preuređuje stoljetne građevine u idealan seoski dom. Ispričat će Benu s kakvim se izazovima suočava živeći u najtoplijem dijelu Portugala i kako je, premda uživa u samotnjačkom životu, spreman ponovno se družiti s istomišljenicima. Među istomišljenicima je i prijateljica koja mu pomaže ostvariti plan da farmu otvori za goste. I ona ima iznimnu životnu priču.

programme.title: Roditeljstvo u životinjskom svijetu
programme.desc: On the open lawns of our planet, parents must constantly weigh between risk and gain when raising the next generation. Although abundant grass promises an abundance of food and places where the family can settle, open regions mean competition and predators. In England, the imaginative potter is exploiting all the grace of the lawn. Skillfully builds a clay cradle and is full to the top of the offspring for offspring they will never meet. In the Keni Park, Masai Mara Geprodica on the outdoor expanses of the cubs shows the hunting skills they will need when they grow up. It will be crucial when she needs help with the gnu cub. It is more difficult for others to achieve. On the open plains of Donji Zambezi, everything is on the side of the thirty -member pack of wild dogs. But parents have to instill a sense of discipline into their inexperienced cubs or hunting can perish. In India, Mother Langu's must learn to be good nanny before they take on the role of parents _ and to some it does not fall easy! It is a world where the balance between risk and gain is constantly changing: parents everywhere in Ravnice are forced to new and difficult decisions. In the Kalahari nests of brownish sparrows, the largest in the world, usually protecting the colony from the sun's heat. But unbearable thermal wave causes the breakdown of social order as dissatisfied neighbors begin to throw birds out of the nest. In Patagonia, the mother of Gvanak must join thousands of others in an attempt to arrive at winter feding sites for the survival of their descendants, in which they are disturbed by kilometers and kilometers of fences. Adversity and parents are increasingly difficult for animal parents, but people can provide simple solutions. / Na otvorenim travnjacima našeg planeta roditelji moraju pri podizanju sljedećeg naraštaja stalno vagati između rizika i dobitka. Iako obilna trava obećava obilje hrane i mjesta na kojima se obitelj može nastaniti, otvoreni predjeli znače konkurenciju i grabežljivce. U Engleskoj domišljata lončarska osa iskorištava svu blagodat travnjaka. Vješto gradi glinenu kolijevku i puni je do vrha gusjenicama za potomstvo koje nikad neće upoznati. U kenijskom parku Masai Mara gepardica na otvorenom prostranstvu mladuncima pokazuje lovačke vještine koje će im trebati kad odrastu. Bit će to presudno kad joj zatreba pomoć u obaranju mladunca gnua. Drugima je ravnotežu teže postići. Na otvorenim ravnicama donjeg Zambezija, sve je na strani trideseteročlanog čopora divljih pasa. Ali roditelji moraju u svoje neiskusne mladunce usaditi osjećaj discipline ili im lov može propasti. U Indiji majke langura moraju naučiti biti dobre dadilje prije nego što preuzmu ulogu roditelja _ a nekima to ne pada lako! To je svijet u kojem se ravnoteža između rizika i dobitka stalno mijenja: roditelji svugdje u ravnicama prisiljeni su na nove i teške odluke. U Kalahariju gnijezda smeđokapih vrabaca, najveća na svijetu, obično štite koloniju od sunčeve topline. No nepodnošljivi toplinski val uzrokuje raspad društvenog poretka jer nezadovoljni susjedi počinju izbacivati ptiće iz gnijezda. U Patagoniji majka gvanaka mora se pridružiti tisućama drugih u pokušaju da stigne na zimska hranilišta radi opstanka njihovih potomaka, u čemu ih ometaju kilometri i kilometri ograde. Nedaće i roditelje životinjskim je roditeljima sve teže zaobići, ali ljudi mogu pružiti jednostavna rješenja.

programme.title: Iron Lady / Željezna Lady
programme.desc: While the old Margaret Tatcher sorts his husband's clothes, who recently died, she talks to him along with him and discusses the past and a personal price she had to pay for power. In these memories, we return to Mladost Margaret Tatcher when she worked in a family trade and listened to her father's political speeches, going to Oxford with the rapture, and a difficult struggle to break into the world dominated by men and marries Denis (J. Broadbent) as a woman. The crown of her political activity was the position of the Prime Minister, for the first time in British history it was a woman and she remained in that place the longest of all in the last century in the United Kingdom ... / Dok ostarjela Margaret Tatcher razvrstava odjeću svog muža, koji je nedavno umro, usput s njim razgovara i raspravlja o prošlosti i osobnoj cijeni koju je morala platiti za moć. U tim se sjećanjima vraćamo u mladost Margaret Tatcher kad je radila u obiteljskoj trgovini i sa zanosom slušala političke govore svojega oca, odlaska na Oxford, te teške borbe da se kao žena probije u svijetu politike kojim su dominirali muškarci i udaje za Denisa (J. Broadbent). Kruna njezine političke aktivnosti bilo je mjesto predsjednika vlade, prvi put u britanskoj povijesti to je bila žena i na tom je mjestu ostala najduže od svih u prošlom stoljeću u Ujedinjenom Kraljevstvu...

programme.title: Dokaz nevinosti
programme.desc: Joe finally reveals what is hiding behind recent events, but it leads to the danger of those closest to him. / Joe napokon otkriva što se krije iza nedavnih događaja, no time dovodi u opasnost one koji su mu najbliži.

programme.title: Endeavour - Young Morse / Endeavour - Mladi Morse
programme.desc: Spring 1972. Morse and Thursday explore the body found in the college's garden and the murder of a colleague to eventually catch up with the case they thought was concluded a long time ago. --- ENDEAVOR, returns to the Castle Gate station again at the moment of shocking discovery in the garden of a college. The investigation runs him and Thursdaya to the famous Oksford Orchestra, and when a new tragedy occurs, this time among musicians, they discover a network of secrets in his heart. At the same time, bloody London problems are overflowing at Oxford when cruel murder in an abandoned warehouse occurs. Solving the puzzle of Endeavour and Thursday, they notice disturbing links with a case that they hoped remained far behind them. / Proljeće 1972. godine. Morse i Thursday istražuju tijelo nađeno u vrtu koledža i ubojstvo kolege da bi se na kraju uhvatili u koštac sa slučajem za koji su mislili da je davno zaključen. --- Endeavour se, ponovno trijezan, vraća u postaju Castle Gate baš u trenutku šokantnog otkrića u vrtu jednog koledža. Istraga vodi njega i Thursdaya do slavnog oksfordskog orkestra, a kad se dogodi nova tragedija, ovaj put među glazbenicima, oni otkriju mrežu tajni u njegovu srcu. Istodobno se krvavi londonski problemi prelijevaju u Oxford kad se dogodi okrutno ubojstvo u napuštenom skladištu. Rješavajući zagonetku Endeavour i Thursday uočavaju uznemirujuće poveznice sa slučajem za koji su se nadali da je ostao daleko iza njih.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Geoff and Joanne are unpleasantly surprised by Goldberg's family custom for Valentine's Day. Despite the effort, Adam fails to be just friends with Bre. / Geoff i Joanne neugodno iznenade Goldbergove obiteljskim običajem za Valentinovo. Unatoč trudu, Adam ne uspijeva biti samo prijatelj s Breom.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Barry is forced to spend the weekend with ex -girls and their boys on Eric's and Geoff's common maiden/boys. Adam wants to prevent Lou not to ruin a wedding video. / Barry je prisiljen provesti vikend s bivšim djevojkama i njihovim dečkima na Ericinoj i Geoffovoj zajedničkoj djevojačkoj/momaćkoj zabavi. Adam želi spriječiti Loua da ne upropasti video za vjenčanje.

programme.title: ART
programme.desc: In today's show, we are talking about the novel "Max, Mischa and the offensive of the aunt" by Johan Hartad, who has been proclaimed a book for a decade in Norway. We discover that this extensive work that questions the world of theater, identity, wars and trauma will premiere on the stage of the ZKM on October 17th. He will reveal his vision of this work full of references to the film, theater and music, which is at the center of the life of directors and artists, director Ivica Buljan and music author Darko Rundek in the studio. On the show, we will see a clip from rehearsal and talking to the actors and a conversation recorded in Oslo 2023 with the author of Romana visited by Ivona Haller in his home. / U današnjoj emisiji govorimo o romanu "Max, Mischa i ofenziva Tet" autora Johana Harstada, koji je u Norveškoj proglašen knjigom desetljeća. Otkrivamo kako će to opsežno djelo koje propituje svijet kazališta, identiteta, ratova i trauma 17. listopada premijerno zaživjeti na pozornici ZKM-a. Svoju viziju tog djela prepunog referencija na film, kazalište i glazbu, kojemu je u središtu život redatelja i umjetnika, otkrit će nam u studiju redatelj Ivica Buljan te autor glazbe Darko Rundek. U emisiji ćemo vidjeti isječak s probe i razgovor s glumcima te razgovor snimljen u Oslu 2023. s autorom romana kojeg je u njegovu domu posjetila Ivona Haller.

programme.title: Night music program - videos / Noćni glazbeni program - spotovi
programme.desc: In the night hours we show new videos, shots of concerts and festivals and music shows from the HTV archive. / U noćnim satima prikazujemo nove spotove, snimke koncerata i festivala te glazbene emisije iz arhive HTV-a.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: The day before the wedding, Erica rebelled against Beverly's exaggerated plans for a big day. / Dan prije vjenčanja, Erica se pobuni protiv Beverlynih pretjeranih planova za veliki dan.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: In order not to have to spend the spring holidays with his mom, Adam agrees to keep Erica's apartment downtown. Barry and JD want to break through on the music scene as a new boy band. / Kako ne bi morao provesti proljetne praznike s mamom, Adam pristane čuvati Ericin stan u centru grada. Barry i JD žele se probiti na glazbenoj sceni kao novi boy band.

programme.title: Escape to the interior / Bijeg u unutrašnjost
programme.desc: In order to be closer to her family and the sea, the Londonian woman needs the help of Alistair Appleton to find a new home in the Suffolski landscape. Alistair will also meet the couple who moved into the interior and created a beautiful flower meadow as a zone of biodiversity for a large range of flora and fauna. / U želji da bude bliže svojoj obitelji i moru, Londončanka treba pomoć Alistaira Appletona da nađe novi dom u suffolškom krajoliku. Alistair će također upoznati par koji se preselio u unutrašnjost i stvorio prelijepu cvjetnu livadu kao zonu biološke raznolikosti za velik raspon flore i faune.

programme.title: Wonderful world of design: new streets / Čudesni svijet dizajna: Nove ulice
programme.desc: Joanna and Ben build a magnificent American -style house in a rough part of Glasgow. Animator Joanna and carpenter Ben participate in the renovation of this city district and bring her a unique vision. Like the wild west buildings that inspire them, Joannina and Ben's house are like those on the ranch will be made of simple materials with a structural structure of dugglasia and fully coated with a rustic tin roof. The kitchen and living room with a double ceiling lit glass wall will be open inside. A handmade staircase will lead to the living room on the first floor and the main bedroom. But with a limited budget of £ 170,000, Joanna and Ben can afford this ambitious house only if they build it themselves. The problem is that they have never built a house before. Thus, with the help of their friend, carpenter Craig, they begin to learn the basic skills needed to build a ranch. / Joanna i Ben grade veličanstvenu kuću u stilu američkog ranča u grubom dijelu Glasgowa. Animatorica Joanna i stolar Ben sudjeluju u obnovi ove gradske četvrti i donose joj svoju jedinstvenu viziju. Poput zgrada Divljeg zapada koje ih inspiriraju, Joannina i Benova kuća nalik onima na ranču bit će izrađena od jednostavnih materijala sa strukturnom konstrukcijom od duglazije i u potpunosti obložena arišem s rustikalnim limenim krovom. Unutra će biti otvorena kuhinja i dnevni boravak s dvostrukim stropom osvijetljenim staklenim zidom. Ručno izrađeno stubište vodit će do dnevnog boravka na prvom katu i glavne spavaće sobe. Ali s ograničenim proračunom od 170.000 funti, Joanna i Ben si mogu priuštiti ovu ambicioznu kuću samo ako je sami izgrade. Problem je u tome što nikada prije nisu gradili kuću. Tako uz pomoć svog prijatelja stolara Craiga počinju sami učiti temeljne vještine potrebne za izgradnju ranča.

programme.title: Patina Mexican dishes / Patina meksička jela
programme.desc: The suffer returns to Merido to meet the siblings of Delius and Mary Elids, who like to cook and have fun, and are known for their recades _ hoods of spices and aromatic herbs, the unavoidable ingredient of all meals on Yucatán. He goes to Hijencu in Uxmal, where citrus, habanera and chaye are visited, which makes it unique, and can only be found on Yucatán. / Pati se vraća u Meridu kako bi upoznala sestre Deliju i Mariju Elide, koje vole kuhati i zabavljati se, a poznate su po svojim recadosima _ pastama od začina i aromatičnog bilja, nezaobilaznom sastojku svih jela na Yucatánu. Odlazi na hacijendu u Uxmalu, gdje obilazi plantaže citrusa, habanera i chaye te doznaje koji to sastojci recadose čine jedinstvenima, a mogu se naći samo na Yucatánu.

programme.title: Alan Titchmarsh: Pedeset nijansi zelene
programme.desc: On the occasion of the celebration of Alan Titchmarsh's 70th birthday and in honor of his fifty years of deeding gardening, a special show was filmed, which represents fifty of his favorite things. In this special episode, we celebrate horticulture throughout the United Kingdom, from ancient oaks to seasonal plants whose inflorescence can be missed in a tulle. We are moving where it all started in Alan's grandfather's garden, we travel across Britain: we will visit the royal Botanical gardens in Kew, Blenheim Palace and more, and in everything we will be helped by the famous Mary Berry and Griff Rhys Jones. This lavish production full of interesting things is designed in honor of the most popular British gardener. / U povodu proslave 70. rođendana Alana Titchmarsha i u čast njegovih pedeset godina bavljenja vrtlarstvom snimljena je posebna emisija koja predstavlja pedeset njemu najdražih stvari. U ovoj specijalnoj epizodi slavimo hortikulturu diljem Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva, od prastarih hrastova do sezonskih biljaka čiji cvat možete propustiti u tili čas. Krećemo ondje gdje je sve počelo _ u vrtu Alanovog djeda, putujemo diljem Britanije: posjetit ćemo Kraljevske botaničke vrtove u Kewu, palaču Blenheim i još mnogo toga, a u svemu će nam pomoći slavni Mary Berry i Griff Rhys Jones. Ova raskošna produkcija prepuna zanimljivosti osmišljena je u čast najpopularnijem britanskom vrtlaru.

programme.title: Michel Roux: Okusi francuskog juga
programme.desc: Michel Roux will spend an unforgettable Christmas in Provence where he will host family and friends. This top chef with several Michelin stars will prepare extraordinary celebratory dishes. Michel will prepare their spectacular appetizer in advance Bouillbaisse Terrine. With his four -year -old Panecak Tom, he will bake gingerbread for wood. A special Christmas tree will also bake, but the central part of his Christmas feast will be baked pork. And for Michel, there is no Christmas without his favorite holiday dessert _ Souffle with drunk plums with Armagnac. / Michel Roux provest će nezaboravan Božić u Provansi gdje će ugostiti obitelj i prijatelje. Ovaj vrhunski chef s nekoliko Michelinovih zvjezdica pripremit će izvanredna slavljenička jela. Michel će unaprijed pripremiti svoje spektakularno predjelo bouillabaisse terrine. Sa svojim četverogodišnjim pranećakom Tomom ispeći će medenjake za drvce. Ispeći će i posebno božićno drvo, ali središnji dio njegove božićne gozbe bit će pečena svinjetina. A za Michela nema Božića bez njegovog omiljenog blagdanskog deserta _ soufflea s pijanim šljivama s Armagnacom.

programme.title: Countries, people, adventures / Zemlje, ljudi, pustolovine
programme.desc: The Stockholm archipelago covers more than 30,000 islands and islets. This world begins just a few kilometers from the center of Stockholm, extends far into the Baltic Sea and has retained a large part of its original charm. Because most of the island can only be reached by sea. This islands for many Swedes are an ideal place to spend the summer in their own country. But the Stockholm archipelago did not go for summer visitors and tourists. On the islet of Grinda is a rural estate of Maria Jorgenson. It is not easy to deal with agriculture in this islands at all. The cows driving a boat here are the usual scene. Sanham's Thimig Johansen lives on Sandhamn. The first day of summer is still celebrated here in the traditional way. Maritimeness left a mark everywhere on the islands and between them. Per Nakkk Roni for wreckage and a trace for well -preserved ships from the Hanzeth era. As in what museum on the seabed, their remains rest: anchors, cannonballs, clay cubes and ship boards. / Štokholmski arhipelag obuhvaća više od 30.000 otoka i otočića. Taj svijet počinje samo nekoliko kilometara od središta Stockholma, proteže se daleko u Baltičko more i zadržao je velik dio svojeg izvornog šarma. Jer na većinu otoka može se doći samo morskim putem. Ovo je otočje za mnoge Šveđane idealno mjesto za provođenje ljeta u vlastitoj zemlji. No Štokholmski arhipelag nije idila samo za ljetne posjetitelje i turiste. Na otočiću Grinda seosko je imanje Marije Jorgensson. Baviti se poljodjelstvom na ovom otočju uopće nije lako. Krave koje se voze brodom ovdje su uobičajen prizor. Na Sandhamnu živi Sanna Thimmig Johansen. Prvi dan ljeta ovdje se još slavi na tradicionalan način. Pomorstvo je ostavilo traga posvuda na otocima i između njih. Per Normark roni za olupinama i traga za dobro očuvanim brodovima iz hanzeatskog doba. Kao u kakvu muzeju na morskom dnu počivaju njihovi ostaci: sidra, topovske kugle, glineni ćupovi i brodske daske.

programme.title: Endeavour - Young Morse / Endeavour - Mladi Morse
programme.desc: Oxford has flooded the crime wave. The homeless man was severely beaten, the young policeman was found dead, and the reputable painter disappeared. During that time, a discerned group of students works a mess, and the last season of the detective series is recorded in the city. Endeavour does not give up an investigation in Blenheim Vale. The team comes to shocking discoveries that point to a dark conspiracy in which the experts from Oxford are involved. Discoveries have their own price and thursday is forced to think of the safety of their loved ones. / Oxford je preplavio val zločina. Beskućnik je žestoko pretučen, mladi policajac pronađen mrtav, a ugledni je slikar nestao. Za to vrijeme raskalašena skupina studenata radi nered, a u gradu se snima posljednja sezona detektivske serije. Endeavour ne odustaje od istrage u Blenheim Valeu. Tim dolazi do šokantnih otkrića koja upućuju na mračnu urotu u koju su upleteni uglednici iz Oxforda i šire. Otkrića imaju svoju cijenu i Thursday je prisiljen misliti na sigurnost svojih najmilijih.

programme.title: TV kalendar
programme.desc: Documentary-historical show, has been aired daily since 1976. It shows important events and anniversaries from Croatian and world history. / Dokumentarno-povijesna emisija, emitira se svakodnevno od 1976. godine. Prikazuje važne događaje i obljetnice iz hrvatske i svjetske povijesti.

programme.title: Stories from Croatia / Priče iz Hrvatske
programme.desc: In today's show, we meet an Oscar, an unusual pet, a dwarf skin. programme.title: Klasika mundi
programme.desc: From the unique court park of Schonbrunn in Vienna, see a recording of the first part of the traditional summer concert of the Vienna Philharmonic Orchestra under the direction of the renowned maestro of Tugan Sozhi's. On the open stage, in a carefully selected program, they will be joined by a glad guest of the world's stage tenor Piotr Beczala and for the first time one of the most famous children's choirs, the Viennese boys. The program basis of the concert is the performance of the popular arias from the operetta and the operetta and works from the rich cultural European heritage. With this free concert in the unique ambience of the Schonbrunn Palace Palace in Vienna, which has been held since 2004, this brilliant orchestra continues to follow a specific cultural goal _ approaching classical music with a wide range of listeners and arousing interest outside its usual audience. Enjoy a spectacle produced by Orf television, which follow millions of viewers around the world in eighty countries. / Iz jedinstvenog dvorskog perivoja Schonbrunn u Beču pogledajte snimku prvog dijela tradicionalnog ljetnog koncerta Bečke filharmonije pod ravnanjem renomiranog maestra Tugana Sokhijeva. Na otvorenoj pozornici, u brižljivo odabranom programu, pridružit će im se rado viđeni gost svjetskih pozornica tenor Piotr Beczala te prvi put i jedan od najpoznatijih dječjih zborova, Bečki dječaci. Programska osnova koncerta je izvođenje popularnih arija iz opera i opereta te djela iz bogatog kulturnog europskog nasljeđa. Ovim besplatnim koncertnom u jedinstvenom ambijentu perivoja palače Schonbrunn u Beču, koji se održava još od 2004. godine, ovaj briljantni orkestar nastavlja slijediti specifičan kulturni cilj _ približavanje klasične glazbe širokom spektru slušatelja i pobuđivanje zanimanja izvan svoje uobičajene publike. Uživajte u spektaklu koji producira televizija ORF, a koji prate milijuni gledatelja diljem svijeta u osamdeset zemalja.

programme.title: Bernadette

Bernadette je očekivala da će dolaskom u Elizejsku palaču konačno dobiti mjesto koje zaslužuje, jer je svom suprugu uvijek bila potpora i pomogla mu da postane predsjednik, ali prevarila se. programme.title: 45. Osor music evenings / 45. Osorske glazbene večeri
programme.desc: This music festival, which has been held since 1976, has founded television and film director Daniel Marusic, guided by three basic premises: international character, affirmation of Croatian contemporary artistic creativity and the affirmation of Osor as a city of culture and music. In the Renaissance Basilica, the Church of the Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary, the 45th Osor Music Evening was opened by the HRT Women's Choir with an instrumental ensemble of the blower and percussionist under the direction of Tomislav Facini, with the performance of Madrigal by Eccellen Petar Bergama. Along with his matrigals, the song of the sea of ​​Igor Kuljeric was performed, whose creativity and long-standing leadership of the HRT choir left a strong mark in Croatian music culture. The European breath at the concert was brought by Les Angelus Claude Debussy in the choir processing of Clytus Gottwald. / Ovaj glazbeni festival koji se održava od 1976. godine utemeljio je televizijski i filmski redatelj Daniel Marušić vođen trima osnovnim premisama: međunarodnim karakterom, afirmacijom hrvatskog suvremenog umjetničkog stvaralaštva te afirmacijom Osora kao grada kulture i glazbe. U renesansnoj bazilici, crkvi Uznesenja Blažene Djevice Marije, 45. Osorske glazbene večeri otvorio je Ženski zbor HRT-a uz instrumentalni ansambl puhača i udaraljkaša pod ravnanjem Tomislava Fačinija i to izvedbom madrigala Spiriti eccellenti Petra Bergama. Uz njegove madrigale izvedena je i skladba More Igora Kuljerića, čije su stvaralaštvo i dugogodišnje vodstvo Zbora HRT-a ostavili snažan trag u hrvatskoj glazbenoj kulturi. Europski dašak na koncertu donijela je skladba Les Angelus Claudea Debussyja u zborskoj obradi Clytusa Gottwalda.

programme.title: Razgovor sa stijenama
programme.desc: Little is known that the geological material of the Earth's crust in the territory of Croatia reflects originally from two continents: European and African. Only a small part of Croatia belongs to the old European use. The beginning of our journey with Medvednica is the border zone of African, that is, the Adriatic microplog and the Eurasian slab. It is here that this tectonic border and zone of the collision of these two plates. The study of the geological material of Medvednica is started along its northwest edge, on a seismogenous fault that was the causative agent of the last Zagreb earthquake on March 2, 2020. After that, we get acquainted with the rocks of this mountain that differ in the type, composition, way and place of Genesis. In the word, it will really be boring here and uniformly talking to the rocks. In the mystical landscape of the abandoned Upper Bistra Mine, we discover unusual stone pillows, pillow lava or pillow lava. These findings represent the rest of the former Oceanic area called Neotetthys and thus geologically follow where this ocean was located at the time of the Mesozoik, in the Triassic period 250 million years ago. Following the traces in the rocks woven in Medvedgrad's walls, we explore the geological heritage of Medvednica from the Paleozoic period all the way to the rocks of only 16 million years old, such as the most famous _ lithotamian limestone from which the Zagreb Cathedral was built. We travel to a period of warm mycene about 12 million years ago, when Medvednica was mostly surrounded by water and occasionally emerged as an island in the sea of ​​paratetitis. We will also visit the Veternica Cave created by the action of the water for millions of years. The water path leads us a little more west, to the Žumberak Nature Park. The story of the Triassic Dolomites that prevail here is located in the period 240 million years ago. In Samobor Highlands, we will enter the mine of St. Barbara, the only place in Croatia where you can see the Siderit mineral. With the return to Medvedgrad, we round out this journey enriched with insights that go back to the past. Participants: prof. Ph.D. Bruno Tomljenović, prof. Ph.D. Drazen Balen, Ph.D. Jasenka Sremac, Asst. Ph.D. Ivica Pavičić, prof. Ph.D. Vesnica Garešić, Maja Klisurić and Tajana Ban Ćurić, B.Sc. geol. / Malokome je poznato kako geološka građa Zemljine kore na području Hrvatske odražava podrijetlo iz dvaju kontinenata: europskog i afričkog. Staroj europskoj kori pripada samo manji dio Hrvatske. Početak našeg putovanja Medvednicom je granična zona Afričke, odnosno Jadranske mikroploče i Euroazijske ploče. Upravo je ovdje ta tektonska granica i zona sudara tih dviju ploča. Istraživanje geološke građe Medvednice započinjemo uz njezin sjeverozapadni rub, na seizmogenom rasjedu koji je bio uzročnikom zadnjeg zagrebačkog potresa 22. ožujka 2020. godine. Nakon toga upoznajemo se sa stijenama ove planine koje se razlikuju po vrsti, sastavu, načinu i mjestu postanka. Riječju, ovdje zbilja neće biti dosadno i jednolično razgovarati sa stijenama. U mističnom krajoliku napuštenoga rudnika Gornja Bistra otkrivamo neobične kamene jastuke, pillow lave ili jastučaste lave. Ovi nalazi predstavljaju ostatak nekadašnjeg oceanskoga prostora koji se zvao Neotethys i tako geološki pratimo gdje se taj ocean nalazio u vrijeme mezozoika, u razdoblju trijasa prije 250 milijuna godina. Slijedeći tragove u stijenama utkanih u zidine Medvedgrada, istražujemo geološku baštinu Medvednice od razdoblja paleozoika sve do stijena starih tek nekih 16 milijuna godina, poput najpoznatijeg _ litotamnijskog vapnenca od kojeg je sagrađena i Zagrebačka katedrala. Putujemo do razdoblja toploga miocena prije oko 12 milijuna godina, kada je Medvednica većinom bila okružena vodom i povremeno izranjala kao otok u moru Paratetis. Posjetit ćemo i špilju Veternicu nastalu djelovanjem vode tijekom milijuna godina. Put vode vodi nas malo zapadnije, u Park prirode Žumberak. Priča o trijaskim dolomitima koji ovdje prevladavaju smještena je u razdoblje prije 240 milijuna godina. U Samoborskom gorju, ući ćemo u rudnik Sv. Barbara, jedino mjesto u Hrvatskoj gdje možete vidjeti mineral siderit. Povratkom na Medvedgrad zaokružujemo ovo putovanje obogaćeni spoznajama koje sežu milijune godina u prošlost. Sudjeluju: prof. dr. sc. Bruno Tomljenović, prof. dr. sc. Dražen Balen, dr. sc. Jasenka Sremac, doc. dr. sc. Ivica Pavičić, prof. dr. sc. Vesnica Garešić, Maja Klisurić i Tajana Ban Ćurić, dipl. ing. geol.

programme.title: As it is said / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The HTV Education and Science Department, in cooperation with the Croatian Language Institute, has recorded thirty videos in which, in addition to linguistic advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language such as the language of young people and foreign words in the Croatian language are addressed. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Stokavian and Chakavian dialects and unusual names of the place, but also of the frequent and unusual personal names. programme.title: As it is said / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The HTV Education and Science Department, in cooperation with the Croatian Language Institute, has recorded thirty videos in which, in addition to linguistic advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language such as the language of young people and foreign words in the Croatian language are addressed. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec.

programme.title: Razgovor sa stijenama
programme.desc: Little is known that the geological material of the Earth's crust in the territory of Croatia reflects originally from two continents: European and African. Only a small part of Croatia belongs to the old European use. The beginning of our journey with Medvednica is the border zone of African, that is, the Adriatic microplog and the Eurasian slab. It is here that this tectonic border and zone of the collision of these two plates. The study of the geological material of Medvednica is started along its northwest edge, on a seismogenous fault that was the causative agent of the last Zagreb earthquake on March 2, 2020. After that, we get acquainted with the rocks of this mountain that differ in the type, composition, way and place of Genesis. In the word, it will really be boring here and uniformly talking to the rocks. In the mystical landscape of the abandoned Upper Bistra Mine, we discover unusual stone pillows, pillow lava or pillow lava. These findings represent the rest of the former Oceanic area called Neotetthys and thus geologically follow where this ocean was located at the time of the Mesozoik, in the Triassic period 250 million years ago. Following the traces in the rocks woven in Medvedgrad's walls, we explore the geological heritage of Medvednica from the Paleozoic period all the way to the rocks of only 16 million years old, such as the most famous _ lithotamian limestone from which the Zagreb Cathedral was built. We travel to a period of warm mycene about 12 million years ago, when Medvednica was mostly surrounded by water and occasionally emerged as an island in the sea of ​​paratetitis. We will also visit the Veternica Cave created by the action of the water for millions of years. The water path leads us a little more west, to the Žumberak Nature Park. The story of the Triassic Dolomites that prevail here is located in the period 240 million years ago. In Samobor Highlands, we will enter the mine of St. Barbara, the only place in Croatia where you can see the Siderit mineral. With the return to Medvedgrad, we round out this journey enriched with insights that go back to the past. Participants: prof. Ph.D. Bruno Tomljenović, prof. Ph.D. Drazen Balen, Ph.D. Jasenka Sremac, Asst. Ph.D. Ivica Pavičić, prof. Ph.D. Vesnica Garešić, Maja Klisurić and Tajana Ban Ćurić, B.Sc. geol. / Malokome je poznato kako geološka građa Zemljine kore na području Hrvatske odražava podrijetlo iz dvaju kontinenata: europskog i afričkog. Staroj europskoj kori pripada samo manji dio Hrvatske. Početak našeg putovanja Medvednicom je granična zona Afričke, odnosno Jadranske mikroploče i Euroazijske ploče. Upravo je ovdje ta tektonska granica i zona sudara tih dviju ploča. Istraživanje geološke građe Medvednice započinjemo uz njezin sjeverozapadni rub, na seizmogenom rasjedu koji je bio uzročnikom zadnjeg zagrebačkog potresa 22. ožujka 2020. godine. Nakon toga upoznajemo se sa stijenama ove planine koje se razlikuju po vrsti, sastavu, načinu i mjestu postanka. Riječju, ovdje zbilja neće biti dosadno i jednolično razgovarati sa stijenama. U mističnom krajoliku napuštenoga rudnika Gornja Bistra otkrivamo neobične kamene jastuke, pillow lave ili jastučaste lave. Ovi nalazi predstavljaju ostatak nekadašnjeg oceanskoga prostora koji se zvao Neotethys i tako geološki pratimo gdje se taj ocean nalazio u vrijeme mezozoika, u razdoblju trijasa prije 250 milijuna godina. Slijedeći tragove u stijenama utkanih u zidine Medvedgrada, istražujemo geološku baštinu Medvednice od razdoblja paleozoika sve do stijena starih tek nekih 16 milijuna godina, poput najpoznatijeg _ litotamnijskog vapnenca od kojeg je sagrađena i Zagrebačka katedrala. Putujemo do razdoblja toploga miocena prije oko 12 milijuna godina, kada je Medvednica većinom bila okružena vodom i povremeno izranjala kao otok u moru Paratetis. Posjetit ćemo i špilju Veternicu nastalu djelovanjem vode tijekom milijuna godina. Put vode vodi nas malo zapadnije, u Park prirode Žumberak. Priča o trijaskim dolomitima koji ovdje prevladavaju smještena je u razdoblje prije 240 milijuna godina. U Samoborskom gorju, ući ćemo u rudnik Sv. Barbara, jedino mjesto u Hrvatskoj gdje možete vidjeti mineral siderit. Povratkom na Medvedgrad zaokružujemo ovo putovanje obogaćeni spoznajama koje sežu milijune godina u prošlost. Sudjeluju: prof. dr. sc. Bruno Tomljenović, prof. dr. sc. Dražen Balen, dr. sc. Jasenka Sremac, doc. dr. sc. Ivica Pavičić, prof. dr. sc. Vesnica Garešić, Maja Klisurić i Tajana Ban Ćurić, dipl. ing. geol.

programme.title: Parm, you are Nessala? / Garbo, kamo si nestala?
programme.desc: Innovative and poignant exploration of life, beauty and talent Greta Garbo and the reasons she left Hollywood at the height of her career. In 1941, at the age of 35, the biggest Hollywood star Greta Garbo suddenly announced that she was withdrawing. The fact that she would never play again commented on her, "If I could look at the premiere at least once and go home satisfied." In a unique and strong documentary by director Lorne Tucker, who connects exclusive archival recordings, interviews with people who knew her and the key moments of her life, Garbo re -speaks the voice of the award -winning actress Noomi Rapace (a girl with a Zmaja tattoo), providing dramatic insight and revealing the biggest puzzle of the film world. / Inovativno i potresno istraživanje života, ljepote i talenta Grete Garbo te razloga zbog kojeg je napustila Hollywood na vrhuncu karijere. Godine 1941., u dobi od 35 godina, najveća holivudska zvijezda Greta Garbo iznenada je objavila da se povlači. Činjenicu da nikada više neće glumiti oštro je komentirala: "Kad bih barem jedanput mogla pogledati pretpremijeru i otići doma zadovoljna." U jedinstvenom i snažnom dokumentarcu redateljice Lorne Tucker, koji spaja ekskluzivne arhivske snimke, intervjue s osobama koje su je poznavale te ključne trenutke njezina života, Garbo ponovno progovara glasom nagrađivane glumice Noomi Rapace (Djevojka s tetovažom zmaja), pružajući dramski uvid i razotkrivajući najveću zagonetku filmskog svijeta.

programme.title: Klasika mundi
programme.desc: From the unique court park of Schonbrunn in Vienna, see a recording of the first part of the traditional summer concert of the Vienna Philharmonic Orchestra under the direction of the renowned maestro of Tugan Sozhi's. On the open stage, in a carefully selected program, they will be joined by a glad guest of the world's stage tenor Piotr Beczala and for the first time one of the most famous children's choirs, the Viennese boys. The program basis of the concert is the performance of the popular arias from the operetta and the operetta and works from the rich cultural European heritage. With this free concert in the unique ambience of the Schonbrunn Palace Palace in Vienna, which has been held since 2004, this brilliant orchestra continues to follow a specific cultural goal _ approaching classical music with a wide range of listeners and arousing interest outside its usual audience. Enjoy a spectacle produced by Orf television, which follow millions of viewers around the world in eighty countries. / Iz jedinstvenog dvorskog perivoja Schonbrunn u Beču pogledajte snimku prvog dijela tradicionalnog ljetnog koncerta Bečke filharmonije pod ravnanjem renomiranog maestra Tugana Sokhijeva. Na otvorenoj pozornici, u brižljivo odabranom programu, pridružit će im se rado viđeni gost svjetskih pozornica tenor Piotr Beczala te prvi put i jedan od najpoznatijih dječjih zborova, Bečki dječaci. Programska osnova koncerta je izvođenje popularnih arija iz opera i opereta te djela iz bogatog kulturnog europskog nasljeđa. Ovim besplatnim koncertnom u jedinstvenom ambijentu perivoja palače Schonbrunn u Beču, koji se održava još od 2004. godine, ovaj briljantni orkestar nastavlja slijediti specifičan kulturni cilj _ približavanje klasične glazbe širokom spektru slušatelja i pobuđivanje zanimanja izvan svoje uobičajene publike. Uživajte u spektaklu koji producira televizija ORF, a koji prate milijuni gledatelja diljem svijeta u osamdeset zemalja.

Griffith) and Joey (M. B. Hurt) are difficult to cope with the breakup of their parents' marriage, Eve (G. Page) and Arthur (Eg Marshall). The father found a new woman and the mother is darker and toxic than before. Each of the sisters is also worn with personal problems: Renata is tormented by existential problems, Flyn has become a drug addict, and Joey wants to devote herself to photographing and leave the current job ... / Drama o trima sestrama kojima, čini se, život izmiče kontroli kad saznaju za iznenadni razvod svojih šezdesetogodišnjih roditelja. Renata (D. Keaton), Flyn (K. Griffith) i Joey (M. B. Hurt) teško se nose s raspadom braka svojih roditelja, Eve (G. Page) i Arthura (EG Marshall). Loren) stayed at home while her husband, fascist, and six children were involved in a German guest welcome. Gabriele is a journalist and is away from work because she is an anti -fascist and gay. It will be deported to Saridini. The two of them accidentally meet, start the conversation drawn to a mutual warmth. / Drama o susretu dvoje susjeda na dan kada je Hitler 1938. posjetio Rim. Domaćica Antonietta (S. Loren) ostala je kod kuće dok su se njezin muž, fašist, i šestero djece uključili u doček njemačkog gosta. Zgrada u kojoj žive je prazna, jedino je šarmantni susjed prekoputa, Gabriele (M. programme.title: Ugly, dirty, evil / Ružni, prljavi, zli
programme.desc: In a poor Roman suburbs, a number of Giazint Mazatelle (N. Manfredi) lives in the hills on the hill. In addition to his wife, Matilda (L. Moretti), with one -eyed Giazinth under the same roof, four generations of his family, ten children, closer and further relatives and his old and demented mother, live under the same roof. Giazinto is a too arrogant man who, in humiliating ways and with the contempt, relates to the household, who deal with tiny crime, prostitution and other illegal affairs. Giazinto lost his eye at one job, which is why the state decides to pay him a million lira in compensation. Of course, he does not intend to share that money with the rest of the family, but spends a part on himself and part of the household. This will, in turn, make the other household to start making up different ways to get money. And when he brings the young mistress Iside (M. L. Santella) to the house one day, and when he forces his wife to divide the bed in three, Matilda will start to forge plans for Giazint's poisoning with the rest of the family. / U siromašnom rimskom predgrađu, u trošnim barakama na brežuljku živi brojna obitelj Giazinta Mazatelle (N. Manfredi). Pored supruge Matilde (L. Moretti), s jednookim Giazintom pod istim krovom žive četiri generacije njegove obitelji, desetoro djece, bliža i daljnja rodbina te njegova stara i dementna majka. Giazinto je prijek i arogantan čovjek koji se na ponižavajuće načine i s prijezirom odnosi prema ukućanima, koji se bave sitnim kriminalom, prostitucijom i drugim nezakonitim poslovima. Giazinto je na jednom poslu svojedobno izgubio oko, zbog čega mu država u znak odštete odluči isplatiti milijun lira. Dakako, on taj novac ne namjerava podijeliti s ostatkom obitelji, već dio potroši na sebe a dio sakrije od ukućana. To će pak ostale ukućane nagnati da počnu smišljati različite načine kako bi se domogli novca. A kad on jednog dana u kuću dovede mladu ljubavnicu Iside (M. L. Santella), te kad suprugu prisili da postelju dijele u troje, Matilda će s ostatkom obitelji početi kovati planove za Giazintovo trovanje.

programme.title: What time is it? / Koliko je sati?
programme.desc: The film follows the relationship between the father and the son who meet again after a long time. The son, a young soldier, spends his day off with his father, a lawyer from Rome, in the small town of Civitavecchia. Through their conversations and walks, different life philosophy gradually reveals: the father is successful, but a little cold and prone to rationalization, while the son strives for a simpler, emotional approach to life. The film explores the generation gap, lost closeness and the question of how much parent and child really know each other, with a dose of irony and tenderness typical of Scol. / Film prati odnos oca i sina koji se ponovno susreću nakon dugo vremena. Sin, mladi vojnik, provodi slobodan dan s ocem, odvjetnikom iz Rima, u malom gradu Civitavecchia. Kroz njihove razgovore i šetnje postupno se otkrivaju različite životne filozofije: otac je uspješan, ali pomalo hladan i sklon racionaliziranju, dok sin teži jednostavnijem, emotivnijem pristupu životu. Film istražuje generacijski jaz, izgubljenu bliskost i pitanje koliko se roditelj i dijete doista poznaju, uz dozu ironije i nježnosti tipične za Scolu.

programme.title: Razgovor sa stijenama
programme.desc: Velebit, our longest mountain, 145 kilometers long, leaves no one indifferent with its beauty. But her geological story is also astonishing, to the laymen, sometimes confusing, and to scientists, geologists who study her and today raises a number of new questions and the need for new research. In this story, we explore that the rocks, which mostly build Velebit, created in the shallow sea on the edge of the equatorial belt of Prakontinent Pangeja, found nearly five thousand kilometers of northeast. We are embarking on a big trip, which lasted 300 million years. We start at Zavizan, then through the northern slopes of Velebit in the mountain settlement, we visit the headquarters of the North Velebit National Park. At the Krasno Visitors Center, in a professional and attractive exhibition, we are most interested in the geological past of the mountain, the animated film vividly describes the creation of the Sleelbit of Sea shallows to this day. It's a great starting point for a tour. It has been beautiful since ancient times for pilgrimage visits to the Marian shrine. This is a good starting point for us to go on a pilgrimage to the distant geological past. And at once, in the period of carbon, there are numerous forms of foraminifera, corals, ammoniti, trilling in the seas. With the help of the Paleontologist and we find the fossils of these organisms over 300 million years old. On the Lika side of Velebit, we move to the middle part of the Velebit Nature Park, we are now in the Perm period, huge fern, horsetail, in the sea there are numerous organisms. We discover fossils of marine organisms that lived in the shallow sea, along the edge of the African continent 250 million years ago. Traveling by geological periods, half between Lika and the sea side of Velebit, we arrive at the border of Triassic and Jure. The rocks are rich in microphosils, but also the fossils of visible and naked eye. Following the geological past, we also return to the history of the Velebit Research, in the 1960s, when the deserving scientist of the Croatian Geological Institute of Dr. Sc. Ivo Velić. In conversation with him and his wife, prof. Emerita Josip Velić, we learn a lot about the past of the mountain research as well as how Ivo Velić had the internationally accepted name of the famous Velebit Breče. These Limestone Breče, whose origin is assumed about 34 million years ago, is considered by many to be the most interesting and entertaining unit on Velebit. On a geological pilgrimage, we witness a strong tectonic that broke limestone and raised rocks from the sea. This journey is exceptional because in itself collects the beauty of nature that surrounds us all the time, and at the same time provides a whole new insight into the mountain. To us, laymen, scientists have opened the door towards incredible scientific knowledge and allowed us, in less than an hour, to follow a grand travel for 300 million years for a long time. / Velebit, naša najduža planina, duga 145 kilometara, svojom ljepotom nikoga ne ostavlja ravnodušnim. No, njena je geološka priča također zapanjujuća, laicima ponekad zbunjujuća, a znanstvenicima, geolozima koji je proučavaju i danas otvara brojna nova pitanja i potrebu za novim istraživanjima. U ovoj priči istražujemo kako su se stijene, koje najvećim dijelom grade Velebit, nastale u plitkome moru na rubu ekvatorijalnoga pojasa prakontinenta Pangeje, našle gotovo pet tisuća kilometara sjevernoistočnije. Krećemo na veliko putovanje koje je trajalo 300 milijuna godina. Počinjemo na Zavižanu, pa preko sjevernih obronaka Velebita u planinskom naselju Krasno posjećujemo sjedište Nacionalnog parka Sjeverni Velebit. U Centru za posjetitelje Krasno, u stručnom i atraktivnom postavu, najviše nas zanima geološka prošlost planine, animirani film zorno opisuje stvaranje Velebita od morskih plićaka do danas. To je odlična početna točka za obilazak. Krasno je od davnina poznato po hodočasničkim posjetima marijanskom svetištu. To nam je dobra početna točka da krenemo na hodočašće dalekom geološkom prošlošću. I odjednom smo u razdoblju karbona, u morima žive brojni oblici foraminifera, koralji, amoniti, trilobiti. Uz pomoć paleontologinja i mi nalazimo fosile tih organizama starih više od 300 milijuna godina. S ličke strane Velebita prebacujemo se u srednji dio Parka prirode Velebit, sada smo u razdoblju perma, prevladavaju goleme papratnjače, preslice, u moru žive brojni organizmi. Otkrivamo fosile morskih organizama koji su obitavali u plitkom moru, uz rub afričkoga kontinenta prije 250 milijuna godina. Putujući geološkim razdobljima, na polovici između ličke i morske strane Velebita, stižemo na granicu trijasa i jure. Stijene su bogate mikrofosilima, ali i fosilima vidljivih i golim okom. Prateći geološku prošlost, vraćamo se i u povijest istraživanja Velebita, u šezdesete godine prošloga stoljeća, kada svoja istraživanja započinje zaslužni znanstvenik Hrvatskog geološkog instituta dr. sc. Ivo Velić. U razgovoru s njim i njegovom suprugom, prof. emeritom Josipom Velić, saznajemo mnogo o prošlosti istraživanja planine kao i o tome kako je upravo Ivo Velić nadjenuo međunarodno prihvaćeno ime znamenitim Velebitskim brečama. Ove vapnenačke breče, čiji se postanak pretpostavlja prije oko 34 milijuna godina, mnogi smatraju najzanimljivijom i najzagonetnijom jedinicom na Velebitu. Na geološkom hodočašću svjedočimo snažnoj tektonici koja je razlamala vapnence i izdizala stijene iz mora. Ovo je putovanje iznimno jer u sebi sabire ljepotu prirode koja nas cijelo vrijeme okružuje, a istovremeno pruža potpuno novi uvid u planinu. Nama, laicima, znanstvenici su odškrinuli vrata prema nevjerojatnim znanstvenim spoznajama i omogućili da i mi, u manje od sat vremena, pratimo grandiozno putovanje dugo 300 milijuna godina.

programme.title: As it is said / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The HTV Education and Science Department, in cooperation with the Croatian Language Institute, has recorded thirty videos in which, in addition to linguistic advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language such as the language of young people and foreign words in the Croatian language are addressed. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Stokavian and Chakavian dialects and unusual names of the place, but also of the frequent and unusual personal names. The head of the interview is the Croatian language professor Katarina Marjanovic, who gives numerous followers on Instagram. Her interviewees are experts from the Croatian Language Institute: Maja Matijevic, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidovic, Ivana Kurtovic Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. / Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec.

programme.title: Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore together and discover the world around us, learn about ourselves and others. We learn in play, in songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuh every morning, every day from 6.30am to 1pm. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: Sixty short stories of sound, which are heard through the ears of a small but very active being called "sound collector", which has a passion for sound and all the concepts related to sound, despite the fact that he hears very poorly. This small being spends his days discovering and learning new sounds he finds on his adventures: these are the most common sounds of the sea, sounds that produce beings in the sea, the sounds produced by insects, including snoring his best friend and pet Marta. / Šezdeset kratkih pričica o zvuku, koje se čuju kroz uši malog, ali vrlo aktivnog bića zvanog "Sakupljač zvukova", koji ima strast za zvuk i sve pojmove vezane uz zvuk, unatoč činjenici da on vrlo slabo čuje. To malo biće provodi svoje dane otkrivajući i učeći nove zvukove koje pronalazi na svojim pustolovinama: to su najčešće zvukovi mora, zvuklovi koje proizvode bića u moru, zvukovi koje proizvode kukci, uključujući i hrkanje njegove najbolje prijateljice i kućnog ljubimca Mirte.

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: The mayor dreams that she traveled to mysterious chicken island, a very strange country where the chicken queen is. // The balloon of traveling Travis is stuck on the Iver, and Travis and Captain Turbot flew together in the desert. / Gradonačelnica sanja da je otputovala na misteriozni Kokošji Otok, vrlo čudnu zemlju gdje je Kokoška kraljica. // Balon Putujućeg Travisa zaglavi se na Iverku pa Travis i Kapetan Turbot zajedno odlete u pustinju.

programme.title: Vrijeme je za Timmyja
programme.desc: Timmy is a little lamb eager for new knowledge. He has just been three years old, and since he is the only lamb in the herd, he used to being all over his. But now he is going to kindergarten with other cubs and will have to learn to behave in the company of his peers. In each episode, one day is shown in kindergarten. The daily routine of the only crazy toddler disrupts. Through various events and accidents, Timmy and his friends learn about life and friendship. / Timmy je malo janje željno novih znanja. Upravo je navršio tri godine, a budući da je jedino janje u stadu, navikao je da sve bude po njegovom. No sad kreće u vrtić s drugim mladuncima i morat će se naučiti ponašati u društvu svojih vršnjaka. U svakoj se epizodi prikazuje jedan dan u vrtiću. Svakodnevnu rutinu remete jedino ludorije mališana. Kroz razne zgode i nezgode, Timmy i njegovi prijatelji uče o životu i prijateljstvu.

programme.title: Krceki
programme.desc: Krceki is a small family: squirrel, acorn, coconut and peanuts. They live together in Krcograd and love adventures. Because of their curiosity, they fall into various troubles, and in order to solve the problem, they always invent a machine. The machine does not always work the way they imagined and emerge many humorous and unforeseen situations. We wish you a great party with Krcek! You are also awaiting rhymes and computer games! / Krceki su mala obitelj: vjeverica, žir, kokos i kikiriki. Žive zajedno u Krcogradu i vole avanture. Zbog svoje znatiželje upadaju u razne nevolje, a kako bi riješili problem izmisle uvijek neki stroj. Stroj ne radi uvijek onako kako su zamislili i nastanu mnoge šaljive i nepredviđene situacije. Želimo vam odličnu zabavu s Krcekima! Također vas očekuju i pjesmice i računalna igra!

programme.title: Krceki - song / Krceki - pjesmica
programme.desc: In addition to the animated series of Krceki, we are also coming to us by seven rhymes: bragger, plack, smart, good, angry, shy and brave. Each rhyme sings about the features of one character from the Krceki series. Music, Verses, Performance: David Vurdelja _ Baby Dooks Authors of the series: Denis Alenta, Vjekoslav Zivkovic, Marija Ivsic Editor: Sanja Nakic / Uz animiranu seriju Krceki stiže nam i sedam pjesmica: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljivko i Hrabrica. Svaka pjesmica pjeva o osobinama jednog lika iz serijala Krceki. Glazba, stihovi, izvedba: David Vurdelja _ Baby Dooks Autori serije: Denis Alenti, Vjekoslav Živković, Marija Ivšić Urednica: Sanja Nakić

programme.title: Pussy and puppy / Maca i Psić
programme.desc: Let's learn something about flowers with a cat and a puppy. / Naučimo nešto o cvijeću s Macom i Psićem.

programme.title: Pocoyo
programme.desc: Pocoyo is a curious toddler dressed in blue from head to toe, prone to jokes and tiny mischief. The series follows the fun adventures of Pocoya and his friends, and each episode deals with another topic. The cheerful societies explore the world through play and teaches new words and concepts. And by the way she has a good time. The fourth season introduces us to the new character Nina and her pet robot Robert. / Pocoyo je radoznali mališan odjeven u plavo od glave do pete, sklon šali i sitnim nestašlucima. Serija prati zabavne pustolovine Pocoya i njegovih prijatelja, a svaka se epizoda bavi drugom temom. Veselo društvance kroz igru istražuje svijet i uči nove riječi i pojmove. I usput se dobro zabavlja. Četvrta sezona upoznaje nas s novim likom Ninom i njezinim kućnim ljubimcem robotom Robertom.
