Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec.

programme.title: Razgovor sa stijenama
programme.desc: Velebit, our longest mountain, 145 kilometers long, leaves no one indifferent with its beauty. But her geological story is also astonishing, to the laymen, sometimes confusing, and to scientists, geologists who study her and today raises a number of new questions and the need for new research. In this story, we explore that the rocks, which mostly build Velebit, created in the shallow sea on the edge of the equatorial belt of Prakontinent Pangeja, found nearly five thousand kilometers of northeast. We are embarking on a big trip, which lasted 300 million years. We start at Zavizan, then through the northern slopes of Velebit in the mountain settlement, we visit the headquarters of the North Velebit National Park. At the Krasno Visitors Center, in a professional and attractive exhibition, we are most interested in the geological past of the mountain, the animated film vividly describes the creation of the Sleelbit of Sea shallows to this day. It's a great starting point for a tour. It has been beautiful since ancient times for pilgrimage visits to the Marian shrine. This is a good starting point for us to go on a pilgrimage to the distant geological past. And at once, in the period of carbon, there are numerous forms of foraminifera, corals, ammoniti, trilling in the seas. With the help of the Paleontologist and we find the fossils of these organisms over 300 million years old. On the Lika side of Velebit, we move to the middle part of the Velebit Nature Park, we are now in the Perm period, huge fern, horsetail, in the sea there are numerous organisms. We discover fossils of marine organisms that lived in the shallow sea, along the edge of the African continent 250 million years ago. Traveling by geological periods, half between Lika and the sea side of Velebit, we arrive at the border of Triassic and Jure. The rocks are rich in microphosils, but also the fossils of visible and naked eye. Following the geological past, we also return to the history of the Velebit Research, in the 1960s, when the deserving scientist of the Croatian Geological Institute of Dr. Sc. Ivo Velić. In conversation with him and his wife, prof. Emerita Josip Velić, we learn a lot about the past of the mountain research as well as how Ivo Velić had the internationally accepted name of the famous Velebit Breče. These Limestone Breče, whose origin is assumed about 34 million years ago, is considered by many to be the most interesting and entertaining unit on Velebit. On a geological pilgrimage, we witness a strong tectonic that broke limestone and raised rocks from the sea. This journey is exceptional because in itself collects the beauty of nature that surrounds us all the time, and at the same time provides a whole new insight into the mountain. To us, laymen, scientists have opened the door towards incredible scientific knowledge and allowed us, in less than an hour, to follow a grand travel for 300 million years for a long time. / Velebit, naša najduža planina, duga 145 kilometara, svojom ljepotom nikoga ne ostavlja ravnodušnim. No, njena je geološka priča također zapanjujuća, laicima ponekad zbunjujuća, a znanstvenicima, geolozima koji je proučavaju i danas otvara brojna nova pitanja i potrebu za novim istraživanjima. U ovoj priči istražujemo kako su se stijene, koje najvećim dijelom grade Velebit, nastale u plitkome moru na rubu ekvatorijalnoga pojasa prakontinenta Pangeje, našle gotovo pet tisuća kilometara sjevernoistočnije. Krećemo na veliko putovanje koje je trajalo 300 milijuna godina. Počinjemo na Zavižanu, pa preko sjevernih obronaka Velebita u planinskom naselju Krasno posjećujemo sjedište Nacionalnog parka Sjeverni Velebit. U Centru za posjetitelje Krasno, u stručnom i atraktivnom postavu, najviše nas zanima geološka prošlost planine, animirani film zorno opisuje stvaranje Velebita od morskih plićaka do danas. To je odlična početna točka za obilazak. Krasno je od davnina poznato po hodočasničkim posjetima marijanskom svetištu. To nam je dobra početna točka da krenemo na hodočašće dalekom geološkom prošlošću. I odjednom smo u razdoblju karbona, u morima žive brojni oblici foraminifera, koralji, amoniti, trilobiti. Uz pomoć paleontologinja i mi nalazimo fosile tih organizama starih više od 300 milijuna godina. S ličke strane Velebita prebacujemo se u srednji dio Parka prirode Velebit, sada smo u razdoblju perma, prevladavaju goleme papratnjače, preslice, u moru žive brojni organizmi. Otkrivamo fosile morskih organizama koji su obitavali u plitkom moru, uz rub afričkoga kontinenta prije 250 milijuna godina. Putujući geološkim razdobljima, na polovici između ličke i morske strane Velebita, stižemo na granicu trijasa i jure. Stijene su bogate mikrofosilima, ali i fosilima vidljivih i golim okom. Prateći geološku prošlost, vraćamo se i u povijest istraživanja Velebita, u šezdesete godine prošloga stoljeća, kada svoja istraživanja započinje zaslužni znanstvenik Hrvatskog geološkog instituta dr. sc. Ivo Velić. U razgovoru s njim i njegovom suprugom, prof. emeritom Josipom Velić, saznajemo mnogo o prošlosti istraživanja planine kao i o tome kako je upravo Ivo Velić nadjenuo međunarodno prihvaćeno ime znamenitim Velebitskim brečama. Ove vapnenačke breče, čiji se postanak pretpostavlja prije oko 34 milijuna godina, mnogi smatraju najzanimljivijom i najzagonetnijom jedinicom na Velebitu. Na geološkom hodočašću svjedočimo snažnoj tektonici koja je razlamala vapnence i izdizala stijene iz mora. Ovo je putovanje iznimno jer u sebi sabire ljepotu prirode koja nas cijelo vrijeme okružuje, a istovremeno pruža potpuno novi uvid u planinu. Nama, laicima, znanstvenici su odškrinuli vrata prema nevjerojatnim znanstvenim spoznajama i omogućili da i mi, u manje od sat vremena, pratimo grandiozno putovanje dugo 300 milijuna godina.

programme.title: Klasici narodu
programme.desc: We will replace the briefcases with a school bag, fill the empty pockets with picUles and thumbnails, put a straw hat on your head, and join the cunning boyfriend Tom. With him we will go to adventures by St. Petersburg, a small town on the Mississippi coast, and his surroundings, making sure that Aunt Polly would not catch us with his fingers in the jam. As you could have assumed, in this episode "Classics of the People" we read the novel "Adventure of Tom Sawyer" Mark Twain, which is a kind of outline of optimism, and we optimistically gave it to read body builders and flower beds. Being young or old, the classic always awakens in the heart of a fervor. Hear and hear, pirate hunting begins on HRT3. / Zamijenit ćemo aktovke školskom torbom, prazne džepove napuniti pikulama i sličicama, staviti slamnati šešir na glavu, i pridružiti se lukavom dečku Tomu. S njim ćemo krenuti u pustolovine po St. Petersburgu, gradiću na obali Mississippija, i njegovoj okolici pazeći pri tome da nas teta Polly ne uhvati s prstima u pekmezu. Kao što ste već mogli pretpostaviti, u ovoj epizodi "Klasika narodu" čitamo roman "Pustolovine Toma Sawyera" Marka Twaina, koji je svojevrsna oda optimizmu, a mi smo ga optimistično dali na čitanje body builderima i cvjećarima. Bio mlad ili star, klasika uvijek budi u srcu žar. Čujte i počujte, lov na gusare započinje na HRT3.

programme.title: U posjetu Fortuni
programme.desc: The documentary film is at its core is a modern fairy tale with a happy ending. We follow the story of a colorful Hungarian married couple, Aniko and Lacia. The two of them until 2013 lived a difficult life, marked by numerous traumas that had largely stemmed from poverty. However, they were happy, and their lives were filled with mutual understanding and imagination about distant travel. In 2013, they smiled happiness when Laci won two million euros in the lottery, which is why their life changes abruptly. For her, money meant that he could finally be dedicated to entrepreneurship and embarks on different investments. For him, the goal meant that he no longer had to work and that he could make his dreams of traveling and discovering the world. This contrary to the understanding of material wealth puts their harmonious relationship to a great trial and slowly begin to separate. Will their marriage endure the burden of sudden wealth? / Dokumentarni film u svojoj je srži moderna bajka sa sretnim završetkom. Pratimo priču o živopisnom mađarskom bračnom paru, Aniko i Laciju. Njih dvoje do 2013. živjelo je teškim životom, obilježenim brojnim traumama koje su dobrim dijelom proizlazile iz neimaštine. Međutim, bili su sretni, a život im je bio ispunjen međusobnim razumijevanjem i maštanjem o dalekim putovanjima. Te 2013. godine im se osmjehnula sreća kada je Laci osvojio dva milijuna eura na lutriji, zbog čega im se život naglo mijenja. Za nju, novac je značio da se napokon može posvetiti poduzetništvu te kreće u različita ulaganja. Za njega, zgoditak je značio da više ne mora raditi te da može ostvariti svoje snove o putovanjima i otkrivanju svijeta. Ovakvo suprotno poimanje materijalnog bogatstva stavlja njihov skladan odnos na veliku kušnju te se polako počinju razdvajati. Hoće li njihov brak izdržati teret iznenadnog bogatstva?

programme.title: Ovo je filozofija
programme.desc: In ancient Greece, philosophy was born for knowledge. The philosophers known as the pre -Socrates asked the question that is still unanswered today: how is it possible for things to change and remain the same at the same time? Tales, Anaximen, Anaximanda and Pythagoras, all of them tried to answer that question. The Heraclitus, the defender of the change, and the Parmenide, who claimed that the being remains the same, and the change is a mere illusion. It is a fight that continues to last. In order to better understand her, we talk to philosophers Simon Blackburn and Victor Gomez Pin and musician Ramon Gener. / U antičkoj se Grčkoj iz želje za znanjem rodila filozofija. Filozofi poznati kao predsokratovci postavljali su pitanje koje je i danas bez odgovora: kako je moguće da se stvari mijenjaju i istodobno ostaju iste? Tales, Anaksimen, Anaksimandar i Pitagora, svi su oni pokušali odgovoriti na to pitanje. Pokušali su i Heraklit, branitelj promjene, i Parmenid, koji je tvrdio da biće ostaje isto, a promjena je puka iluzija. Borba je to koja i dalje traje. Kako bismo je bolje razumjeli, razgovaramo s filozofima Simonom Blackburnom i Victorom Gomezom Pinom te s glazbenikom Ramonom Generom.

programme.title: Sedmorica bez izbora
programme.desc: Sheriff Chris Adams settled down in Arizona with his new wife (Mariette Harrley). When she killed her, Chris finds Bandite and share the justice himself, but then reveals that the nearby border town is under attack. The hordes of ruthless robbers killed all men and will return to women _ unless Chris and his brave recruits stop! / Šerif Chris Adams (Lee Van Cleef) skrasio se u Arizoni sa svojom novom suprugom (Mariette Harrley). Kad je ubiju, Chris nađe bandite i sam podijeli pravdu, ali zatim otkrije da je obližnji pogranični gradić pod napadom. Horda nemilosrdnih pljačkaša ubila je sve muškarce i vratit će se po žene _ osim ako ih Chris i njegovi hrabri regruti ne zaustave!

programme.title: AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu
programme.desc: Starting from five vowels and gestures of the screen coloring through autoportrators, TV performance aaaaeeeeeeiiiiooooooouuu is played with the voice, images, subjectivity and perception in the contemporary media environment, offering simultaneously meditative break and the space of critical reflection of usual tempo and content. The work of Karl Stefanek is aired as part of the 60th edition of the Zagreb Salon. / Polazeći od pet samoglasnika i geste bojanja ekrana preko autoportreta, TV performans AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu poigrava se odnosom glasa, slike, subjektiviteta i percepcije u suvremenom medijskom okruženju, nudeći istodobno meditativnu stanku i prostor kritičkog promišljanja uobičajenog tempa i sadržaja. Rad Karla Štefaneka emitira se u sklopu 60. izdanja Zagrebačkog salona.

programme.title: It's time for jazz / Vrijeme je za jazz
programme.desc: It brings shots of Croatian and foreign jazz concerths and festivals, reporting reviews of current events at the Croatian jazz-Cena. / Donosi snimke hrvatskih i inozemnih jazz-koncerata i festivala, reportažne preglede aktualnih događaja na hrvatskoj jazz-sceni.

programme.title: Jedno djelo
programme.desc: The complex of today's "Technical Museum of Nikola Tesla" in Zagreb was built in 1949 for the needs of the Zagreb Fair. Architect Marijan Haberle is selected as the designer, who will design and implement the complex in a record time of three months. Due to the speed of construction, the whole building was carried out in a wooden structure and lined with wood. Roof carriers and grate columns, as well as forged connecting parts, were made parallel with the installation of construction on the construction site, and the whole structure is extremely solid and stable. / Kompleks današnjeg "Tehničkog muzeja Nikola Tesla" u Zagrebu izgrađen je 1949. za potrebe Zagrebačkog velesajma. Za projektanta je odabran arhitekt Marijan Haberle koji će kompleks projektirati i realizirati u rekordnom roku od tri mjeseca. Zbog brzine izgradnje cijela je zgrada izvedena u drvenoj konstrukciji i obložena drvetom. Krovni nosači i rešetkasti stupovi, kao i kovani spojni dijelovi izrađivani su usporedno s montažom konstrukcije na gradilištu, a cijela je konstrukcija iznimno čvrsta i stabilna.

programme.title: Let's take you ... Zagreb Classic / Vodimo vas ... Zagreb Classic
programme.desc: The eighth Zagreb Classic Festival was held from June 19 to July 2, 2025. On the Square of King Tomislav, and the celebration of music under the clear sky on June 22 of the June Symphony Orchestra and the HRT Choir with a thematic concert under the name of the Mediterranean. Mediterranean sun-bathed melodies, fiery rhythms, sea blue, irresistible charm and temperament that erupts from each clock are the backbone of the concert of the Symphony Orchestra and the HRT Assembly under the guidance of one of the most prominent directions of the younger generation on the European scene, Gergely Duboczki. Educated at the Franz Liszt Academy in Budapest, highlighted as a creator of a series of contemporary and multican productions, now joined with HRT ensembles and excellent Croatian soloists who build great international careers. Violinist Sara Domjanic arrived from Germany, where she operates as the second concert master Dusseldorf symphonics, Split Tenor Tomislav Jukic is among the last successes engaging with Cecilia Bartoli on the main stage of the Opera in Zurich, and Bas-Bariton Benjamin Šuran recently performed on the Festival. Baden-Baden with the Berlin Philharmonic and Kirill Petrenka. The program leads us from Spain and Italy to Dalmatia, starting with Andalusia inspired by Españo Emmanuel Chabrier, through orchestral masterpieces, such as virtuoso introducing and Ronda Capriccios Camille Saint-Saëns and the enthusiastic idylls of Blagoje Bersa Roman-Korsakova. Some of the most beautiful human voice tunes belong to the Italian repertoire, so listen to arias, duets and choirs from the opera Cavalleria Rustican Pietra Mascagni, the love drink of Gaetan Donizetti, and Pagliacci Rugger Leoncavall and from the Operation of the Split aquarel of our Ive Tijardovic. With our favorite Kancone Cancone _ non there più and funiculì, Funiculà _ bring us a warm, sunny wing of the south of Italy. The cathartic finish of the opera Ero from that world of James Gotovac reminds us of this masterpiece of our and Slavic opera repertoire of which the 2025 premiere is 90 years old. / Osmi po redu festival Zagreb Classic održao se od 19. lipnja do 2. srpnja 2025. na Trgu kralja Tomislava, a slavlju glazbe pod vedrim nebom 22. lipnja pridružio se i Simfonijski orkestar te Zbor HRT-a tematskim koncertom pod nazivom Sjaj Mediterana. Mediteranskim suncem okupane melodije, vatreni ritmovi, morsko plavetnilo, neodoljivi šarm i temperament koji izbijaju iz svakoga takta okosnica su koncerta Simfonijskog orkestra i Zbora HRT-a pod vodstvom jednoga od najistaknutijih dirigenata mlađe generacije na europskoj sceni, Gergelya Duboczkog. Školovan na Akademiji Franz Liszt u Budimpešti, istaknut kao kreator niza suvremenih i multižanrovskih produkcija, sada se udružio s ansamblima HRT-a i vrsnim hrvatskim solistima koji grade sjajne međunarodne karijere. Violinistica Sara Domjanić stigla je iz Njemačke gdje djeluje kao druga koncertna majstorica Dusseldorfskih simfoničara, splitski tenor Tomislav Jukić među posljednjim uspjesima bilježi angažman uz Ceciliju Bartoli na glavnoj pozornici Opere u Zurichu, a bas-bariton Benjamin Šuran nedavno je nastupio u produkciji opere Madama Butterfly na Festivalu Baden-Baden uz Berlinsku filharmoniju i Kirilla Petrenka. Program nas vodi od Španjolske i Italije do Dalmacije, počevši od Andaluzijom nadahnute rapsodije España Emmanuela Chabriera, preko orkestralnih remek-djela, poput virtuozne Introdukcije i Ronda capricciosa Camillea Saint-Saënsa i zanosne Idile Blagoja Berse, do strastvene suite Španjolski capriccio Nikolaja Rimski-Korsakova. Neke od najljepših melodija za ljudski glas pripadaju dakako talijanskom repertoaru, pa poslušajte arije, duete i zborove iz opera Cavalleria rusticana Pietra Mascagnija, Ljubavni napitak Gaetana Donizettija, I Pagliacci Ruggera Leoncavalla te iz operete Spliski akvarel našega Ive Tijardovića. Uz omiljene napuljske kancone _ Non tamo più i Funiculì, funiculà _ donose nam toplo, osunčano okrilje juga Italije. Katarzična završnica opere Ero s onoga svijeta Jakova Gotovca podsjeća nas na to remek-djelo našega i slavenskog opernog repertoara od čije se praizvedbe 2025. godine navršava 90 godina.

programme.title: All played in Montreux / Svi su svirali u Montreuxu
programme.desc: Starting with music in 1967, practically without any knowledge of the music industry, Claude Nobs turned his dormant hometown on the Lake Geneva Coast into a destination for international music artists. Aretha Franklin, Nina Simone, David Bowie, Miles Davis, Etta James, Prince, Talking Heads ... The list continues, and finally everyone came to Montreux. Claude recorded it all and recorded to the smallest details and created the UNESCO Extraordinary Depth and Quality Archives. From revolutionary performances to stunning and intimate recording of conversations, this film provides an impressive insight into the unique world of Claude Nobs and his love for music. / Počevši se baviti glazbom 1967. godine, praktički bez ikakvog znanja o glazbenoj industriji, Claude Nobs svoj je uspavani rodni grad na obali Ženevskog jezera pretvarao u odredište za međunarodne glazbene umjetnike. Aretha Franklin, Nina Simone, David Bowie, Miles Davis, Etta James, Prince, Talking Heads... popis se nastavlja, i na kraju su svi došli u Montreux. Claude je sve to snimio i zabilježio do najsitnijih detalja i stvorio UNESCO-vu arhivu izvanredne dubine i kvalitete. Od revolucionarnih nastupa do zapanjujućih i intimnih snimaka razgovora, ovaj film pruža impresivan uvid u jedinstveni svijet Claudea Nobsa i njegove ljubavi prema glazbi.

programme.title: Na rubu znanosti
programme.desc: In accordance with trends, the money becomes part of the digital world. Through card and internet business, and with the appearance of cryptocurrencies, digital money already exists. But the novelty in this field is to create digital state currency. Currently, as many as 130 countries, which together make up 98 % of the world GDP, explore, develop or already implement digital currencies in its economies. This raises important questions _ From the freedom of the choice of the individual and the surrender of the monetary system of private corporations, through the anonymity of consumption, to the dependence of the constant availability of modern devices, electricity and the Internet. In a comprehensive rush according to the issuance of the digital money of central banks, it is worth stopping and trying to understand: what brings with it such money and why is it introduced? / U skladu s trendovima, i novac postaje dio digitalnog svijeta. Putem kartičnog i internetskog poslovanja, a i pojavom kriptovaluta, digitalni novac već postoji. No, novost na tom polju jest stvaranje digitalnih državnih valuta. Trenutačno čak 130 zemalja, koje zajedno čine 98 % svjetskog BDP-a, istražuje, razvija ili već implementira digitalne valute u svojim gospodarstvima. Time se otvaraju važna pitanja _ od slobode izbora pojedinca i predaje upravljanja monetarnim sustavom privatnim korporacijama, preko anonimnosti potrošnje, pa sve do ovisnosti o stalnoj dostupnosti modernih uređaja, električne energije i interneta. U sveopćoj žurbi prema izdavanju digitalnog novca središnjih banaka, vrijedi zastati i pokušati razumjeti: što sa sobom donosi takav novac i zašto se uvodi?

programme.title: AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu
programme.desc: Starting from five vowels and gestures of the screen coloring through autoportrators, TV performance aaaaeeeeeeiiiiooooooouuu is played with the voice, images, subjectivity and perception in the contemporary media environment, offering simultaneously meditative break and the space of critical reflection of usual tempo and content. The work of Karl Stefanek is aired as part of the 60th edition of the Zagreb Salon. / Polazeći od pet samoglasnika i geste bojanja ekrana preko autoportreta, TV performans AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu poigrava se odnosom glasa, slike, subjektiviteta i percepcije u suvremenom medijskom okruženju, nudeći istodobno meditativnu stanku i prostor kritičkog promišljanja uobičajenog tempa i sadržaja. Rad Karla Štefaneka emitira se u sklopu 60. izdanja Zagrebačkog salona.

programme.title: I wanted to hide / Htio sam se sakriti
programme.desc: The story of the painter Antonia Ligabueu, Swiss-Italian origin, with flashbacks depicting pieces of his childhood. After being entrusted with foster parents, he immediately begins to have psychophysical disorders, with rachitis, being kicked out of school and hospitalized several times. At the same time, he finds comfort in painting and sculpture, often portraying exotic animals such as lions, gorillas, tigers, which merges with the Emilian landscape, because Antonio will move to Gualtieri in Emilia Romagni, where they call him "El Tudesc" (German). However, Ligabue soon reveals critic Renato Marino Mazzacurati, who encourages him to continue his work and participate in art exhibitions, until the ligabue is slowly discovered by other critics, although some academics call him a naive artist. / Priča o slikaru Antoniju Ligabueu, švicarsko-talijanskog podrijetla, s flashbackovima koji prikazuju djeliće njegova djetinjstva. Nakon što je kao mali povjeren udomiteljima, odmah počinje imati psihofizičke poremećaje, obolijeva od rahitisa, biva izbačen iz škole i nekoliko puta hospitaliziran. Istodobno, pronalazi utjehu u slikarstvu i kiparstvu, često prikazujući egzotične životinje poput lavova, gorila, tigrova, koje spaja s emilijskim krajolikom, jer će se Antonio preseliti u Gualtieri u Emiliji Romagni, gdje ga pogrdno nazivaju "El Tudesc" (Nijemac). Međutim, Ligabuea ubrzo otkriva kritičar Renato Marino Mazzacurati, koji ga potiče da nastavi s radom i sudjeluje na umjetničkim izložbama, sve dok Ligabuea polako ne otkriju i ostali kritičari, iako ga neki akademici nazivaju naivnim umjetnikom.

programme.title: Let's take you ... Zagreb Classic / Vodimo vas ... Zagreb Classic
programme.desc: The eighth Zagreb Classic Festival was held from June 19 to July 2, 2025. At King Tomislav Square, and the celebration of music under the clear sky, on June 2nd, the Symphony Orchestra and the HRT Choir and the Ivan Goran Kovačić Academic Choir, with the thematic concert, called the Summer of the Mediterranean. Mediterranean sun-bathed melodies, fiery rhythms, sea blue, irresistible charm and temperament that erupts from each clock are the backbone of the concert of the Symphony Orchestra and the HRT Assembly under the guidance of one of the most prominent directions of the younger generation on the European scene, Gergely Duboczki. Educated at the Franz Liszt Academy in Budapest, highlighted as a creator of a series of contemporary and multican productions, now joins with HRT ensembles and excellent Croatian soloists who build great international careers. Violinist Sara Domjanic arrives from Germany, where she acts as the second concert master Dusseldorf Symphonics, Split tenor Tomislav Jukic is among the latest successes engaging with Cecilia Bartoli on the main stage of the opera in Zurich, and Bas-Bariton Benjamin Šuran has been produced in the Opera Mada Badani. With the Berlin Philharmonic and Kirill Petrenka. The program leads us from Spain and Italy to Dalmatia, starting with Andalusia inspired by España Emmanuel Chabrier, through orchestral masterpieces such as virtuoso introducing and Ronda Capriccios Camille Saint-Saëns and the enthusiastic idylls Roman-Korsakova. Some of the most beautiful human voice tunes belong to the Italian repertoire, so we will expect aria, duets and choirs from Opera Cavalleria Rustican Pietra Mascagni, the love drink of Gaetan Donizetti and Pagliacci Rugger Leoncavall, but also from the operas of Split aquarel. With our favorite Kancone Cancone _ non there più and funiculì, Funiculà _ bring us a warm, sunny wing of the south of Italy. The cathartic finish of the opera Ero from that world of James Gotovac reminds us of this masterpiece of our and Slavic opera repertoire of which the 2025 premiere was 90 years old. / Osmi po redu festival Zagreb Classic održao se od 19. lipnja do 2. srpnja 2025. na Trgu kralja Tomislava, a slavlju glazbe pod vedrim nebom, 22. lipnja pridružio se i Simfonijski orkestar te Zbor HRT-a te Akademski zbor "Ivan Goran Kovačić" tematskim koncertom pod nazivom Sjaj Mediterana. Mediteranskim suncem okupane melodije, vatreni ritmovi, morsko plavetnilo, neodoljivi šarm i temperament koji izbijaju iz svakoga takta okosnica su koncerta Simfonijskog orkestra i Zbora HRT-a pod vodstvom jednoga od najistaknutijih dirigenata mlađe generacije na europskoj sceni, Gergelya Duboczkog. Školovan na Akademiji Franz Liszt u Budimpešti, istaknut kao kreator niza suvremenih i multižanrovskih produkcija, sada se udružuje s ansamblima HRT-a i vrsnim hrvatskim solistima koji grade sjajne međunarodne karijere. Violinistica Sara Domjanić stiže iz Njemačke gdje djeluje kao druga koncertna majstorica Dusseldorfskih simfoničara, splitski tenor Tomislav Jukić među posljednjim uspjesima bilježi angažman uz Ceciliju Bartoli na glavnoj pozornici Opere u Zurichu, a bas-bariton Benjamin Šuran nastupio je u produkciji opere Madama Butterfly na Festivalu Baden-Baden uz Berlinsku filharmoniju i Kirilla Petrenka. Program nas vodi od Španjolske i Italije do Dalmacije, počevši od Andaluzijom nadahnute rapsodije España Emmanuela Chabriera, preko orkestralnih remek-djela poput virtuozne Introdukcije i Ronda capricciosa Camillea Saint-Saënsa i zanosne Idile Blagoja Berse do strastvene suite Španjolski capriccio Nikolaja Rimski-Korsakova. Neke od najljepših melodija za ljudski glas pripadaju dakako talijanskom repertoaru, pa nas očekuju arije, dueti i zborovi iz opera Cavalleria rusticana Pietra Mascagnija, Ljubavni napitak Gaetana Donizettija i I Pagliacci Ruggera Leoncavalla, ali i iz operete Spliski akvarel našega Ive Tijardovića. Uz omiljene napuljske kancone _ Non tamo più i Funiculì, funiculà _ donose nam toplo, osunčano okrilje juga Italije. Katarzična završnica opere Ero s onoga svijeta Jakova Gotovca, podsjeća nas na to remek-djelo našega i slavenskog opernog repertoara od čije se praizvedbe 2025. godine navršilo 90 godina.

programme.title: Klasici narodu
programme.desc: We will replace the briefcases with a school bag, fill the empty pockets with picUles and thumbnails, put a straw hat on your head, and join the cunning boyfriend Tom. With him we will go to adventures by St. Petersburg, a small town on the Mississippi coast, and his surroundings, making sure that Aunt Polly would not catch us with his fingers in the jam. As you could have assumed, in this episode "Classics of the People" we read the novel "Adventure of Tom Sawyer" Mark Twain, which is a kind of outline of optimism, and we optimistically gave it to read body builders and flower beds. Being young or old, the classic always awakens in the heart of a fervor. Hear and hear, pirate hunting begins on HRT3. / Zamijenit ćemo aktovke školskom torbom, prazne džepove napuniti pikulama i sličicama, staviti slamnati šešir na glavu, i pridružiti se lukavom dečku Tomu. S njim ćemo krenuti u pustolovine po St. Petersburgu, gradiću na obali Mississippija, i njegovoj okolici pazeći pri tome da nas teta Polly ne uhvati s prstima u pekmezu. Kao što ste već mogli pretpostaviti, u ovoj epizodi "Klasika narodu" čitamo roman "Pustolovine Toma Sawyera" Marka Twaina, koji je svojevrsna oda optimizmu, a mi smo ga optimistično dali na čitanje body builderima i cvjećarima. Bio mlad ili star, klasika uvijek budi u srcu žar. Čujte i počujte, lov na gusare započinje na HRT3.

programme.title: It's time for jazz / Vrijeme je za jazz
programme.desc: It brings shots of Croatian and foreign jazz concerths and festivals, reporting reviews of current events at the Croatian jazz-Cena. / Donosi snimke hrvatskih i inozemnih jazz-koncerata i festivala, reportažne preglede aktualnih događaja na hrvatskoj jazz-sceni.

programme.title: Razgovor sa stijenama
programme.desc: This scientific and recipient film takes us through the rich geological past of Istria. We learn that numerous geological processes, rocks, minerals, soils, landscapes and other geological features have significantly influenced and still affect the life of this area from the economy to the rich cultural heritage. The story begins at the top of Vojak, at the Učka Nature Park in white Istria. The name was given to her solid and hard limestones built of the remains of a baptism of different organisms who lived in shallow subtropical and tropical seas. After that we head west, to another relief unit of Istria, to the area of ​​Gray Istria. The name owes the deposits of sedimentary gray rocks, deposited in the eocene period. In the area of ​​Gray Istria, the magical landscapes of Istrian towns on the tops of hills such as Motovun, Buzet or Boljun are famous. They thank their position with the imposing megalosilles of the sandstone on which they were built. Thus, geological material directly influenced the social development of this area. The third color of the Istrian Peninsula is red because of the particular soil, the reds, which is mostly in the world in Croatia, and in Istria the thickest layers are in Istria. A team of geologists presents us with the latest discovery of the world about how the redness actually originated. We will visit Rudokop near Rovinj in the area where the famous Kirmenjak has been removed for centuries, from which Venice and many other cities and monuments were built. In the underground quarry we will get to know the Istrian yellow, the most famous architectural and construction stone from Istria. In the 15th century, Juraj Dalmatinac built it in Italy. The eastern part of the Peninsula, the Labin area, known for coal, will also be an indispensable station. With the abundance of mine resources, we will discover why we proudly call the Boxit a Croatian national mineral. Following the geological traces on the Istrian peninsula, we will pass through four periods of rise in the Adriatic carbonate platform, the periods of its land phases when these different sediments and soil were created. And before the end, the dinosaur pass. You will have the opportunity to meet dinosaurs, herbivores and carnivores, who have been pushed with muddy soil under hot sun period. We will also visit the fertile soil of the Reds in the vicinity of Umag and find out why the first soil is protected as a cultural monument. In the end, we can toast the unbreakable connection between the soil with the cultural heritage and the tradition of this area with a glass of indigenous Istrian Teran or, who is for white, enjoy the rich aroma of Malvasia. Participants: Academician Goran Durn, Ph.D. Ivor Perković, Sergej Zvocak, B.Sc. geol., prof. Ph.D. Alexander Mezga, prof. Ph.D. Bruno Saftić, Milan Mihovilović, B.Sc. geol., Moreno Coronica. / Ovaj znanstveno-popularni film vodi nas kroz bogatu geološku prošlost Istre. Doznajemo kako su brojni geološki procesi, stijene, minerali, tla, pejzaži i druga geološka obilježja bitno utjecala i još utječu na život ovoga kraja od gospodarstva pa do bogate kulturne baštine. Priča započinje na vrhu Vojak, u Parku prirode Učka u Bijeloj Istri. Ime su joj dali čvrsti i tvrdi vapnenci izgrađeni od ostataka kršja različitih organizama koji su živjeli u plitkim suptropskim i tropskim morima. Nakon toga krećemo prema zapadu, u drugu reljefnu cjelinu Istre, na područje Sive Istre. Naziv duguje naslagama sedimentnih sivih stijena, taloženima u razdoblju eocena. Na području Sive Istre znameniti su magični krajolici istarskih gradića na vrhovima brežuljaka poput Motovuna, Buzeta ili Boljuna. Svoj položaj zahvaljuju impozantnim megaslojevima pješčenjaka na kojima su izgrađeni. Tako je geološka građa izravno utjecala na društveni razvoj ovoga kraja. Treća boja Istarskog poluotoka je crvena zbog osobitog tla, crvenice, koje najviše na svijetu ima u Hrvatskoj, a upravo su u Istri najdeblji slojevi. Tim geologa predstavlja nam najnovije svjetsko otkrić o tome kako je zapravo crvenica nastala. Posjetit ćemo rudokop u blizini Rovinja u kraju u kojem se stoljećima vadio slavni kirmenjak, od kojeg je sagrađena Venecija i mnogi drugi gradovi i spomenici. U podzemnom kamenolomu upoznat ćemo Istarski žuti, najpoznatiji arhitektonsko-građevni kamen iz Istre. Njime je u 15. stoljeću Juraj Dalmatinac gradio po Italiji. Nezaobilazna će postaja biti i istočni dio poluotoka, područje Labinštine, poznato po kopanju ugljena. Uz obilje rudnoga bogatstava, otkrit ćemo zbog čega boksit s ponosom zovemo hrvatskim nacionalnim mineralom. Prateći geološke tragove na Istarskom poluotoku proći ćemo četirima razdobljima izdizanja Jadranske karbonatne platforme, razdobljima njezinih kopnenih faza kada su ti različiti sedimenti i tla nastajali. I pred kraj, mimohod dinosaura. Imat ćete prigodu upoznati dinosaure, biljojede i mesojede, koji su gacali muljevitim tlom pod vrućim suncem razdoblja krede. Posjetit ćemo i plodno tlo crvenice u okolici Umaga i doznati zašto je ono prvo tlo zaštićeno kao spomenik kulture. Za kraj možemo nazdraviti neraskidivoj povezanosti tla s kulturnom baštinom i tradicijom ovoga kraja čašom autohtonog istarskoga terana ili, tko je za bijelo, uživati u bogatoj aromi malvazije. Sudjeluju: Akademik Goran Durn, dr. sc. Ivor Perković, Sergej Zvocak, dipl. ing. geol., prof. dr. sc. Aleksandar Mezga, prof. dr. sc. Bruno Saftić, Milan Mihovilović, dipl. ing. geol., Moreno Coronica.

programme.title: As it is said / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The HTV Education and Science Department, in cooperation with the Croatian Language Institute, has recorded thirty videos in which, in addition to linguistic advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language such as the language of young people and foreign words in the Croatian language are addressed. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Stokavian and Chakavian dialects and unusual names of the place, but also of the frequent and unusual personal names. The head of the interview is the Croatian language professor Katarina Marjanovic, who gives numerous followers on Instagram. Her interviewees are experts from the Croatian Language Institute: Maja Matijevic, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidovic, Ivana Kurtovic Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. / Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec.

programme.title: Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore together and discover the world around us, learn about ourselves and others. We learn in play, in songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuh every morning, every day from 6.30am to 1pm. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: Sixty short stories of sound, which are heard through the ears of a small but very active being called "sound collector", which has a passion for sound and all the concepts related to sound, despite the fact that he hears very poorly. This small being spends his days discovering and learning new sounds he finds on his adventures: these are the most common sounds of the sea, sounds that produce beings in the sea, the sounds produced by insects, including snoring his best friend and pet Marta. / Šezdeset kratkih pričica o zvuku, koje se čuju kroz uši malog, ali vrlo aktivnog bića zvanog "Sakupljač zvukova", koji ima strast za zvuk i sve pojmove vezane uz zvuk, unatoč činjenici da on vrlo slabo čuje. To malo biće provodi svoje dane otkrivajući i učeći nove zvukove koje pronalazi na svojim pustolovinama: to su najčešće zvukovi mora, zvuklovi koje proizvode bića u moru, zvukovi koje proizvode kukci, uključujući i hrkanje njegove najbolje prijateljice i kućnog ljubimca Mirte.

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: The show motorcycle tricks comes to town, and with it a famous wild cat, but also a bad pack of puppies on engines. The wild cat joins the patrol to prevent the villains from destroying the city. / Šou motociklističkih trikova dolazi u grad, a s njim i slavni Divlji Mačak, ali i zločesti Čopor psića na motorima. Divlji Mačak se pridružuje ophodnji kako bi spriječili zlikovce da unište grad.

programme.title: Vrijeme je za Timmyja
programme.desc: Timmy is a little lamb eager for new knowledge. He has just been three years old, and since he is the only lamb in the herd, he used to being all over his. But now he is going to kindergarten with other cubs and will have to learn to behave in the company of his peers. In each episode, one day is shown in kindergarten. The daily routine of the only crazy toddler disrupts. Through various events and accidents, Timmy and his friends learn about life and friendship. / Timmy je malo janje željno novih znanja. Upravo je navršio tri godine, a budući da je jedino janje u stadu, navikao je da sve bude po njegovom. No sad kreće u vrtić s drugim mladuncima i morat će se naučiti ponašati u društvu svojih vršnjaka. U svakoj se epizodi prikazuje jedan dan u vrtiću. Svakodnevnu rutinu remete jedino ludorije mališana. Kroz razne zgode i nezgode, Timmy i njegovi prijatelji uče o životu i prijateljstvu.

programme.title: Krceki
programme.desc: Krceki is a small family: squirrel, acorn, coconut and peanuts. They live together in Krcograd and love adventures. Because of their curiosity, they fall into various troubles, and in order to solve the problem, they always invent a machine. The machine does not always work the way they imagined and emerge many humorous and unforeseen situations. / Krceki su mala obitelj: vjeverica, žir, kokos i kikiriki. Žive zajedno u Krcogradu i vole avanture. Zbog svoje znatiželje upadaju u razne nevolje, a kako bi riješili problem izmisle uvijek neki stroj. Stroj ne radi uvijek onako kako su zamislili i nastanu mnoge šaljive i nepredviđene situacije.

programme.title: Krceki - song / Krceki - pjesmica
programme.desc: In addition to the animated series of Krceki, we are also coming to us by seven rhymes: bragger, plack, smart, good, angry, shy and brave. Each rhyme sings about the features of one character from the Krceki series. Music, Verses, Performance: David Vurdelja _ Baby Dooks Authors of the series: Denis Alenta, Vjekoslav Zivkovic, Marija Ivsic Editor: Sanja Nakic / Uz animiranu seriju Krceki stiže nam i sedam pjesmica: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljivko i Hrabrica. Svaka pjesmica pjeva o osobinama jednog lika iz serijala Krceki. Glazba, stihovi, izvedba: David Vurdelja _ Baby Dooks Autori serije: Denis Alenti, Vjekoslav Živković, Marija Ivšić Urednica: Sanja Nakić

programme.title: I love animals zoo / Volim životinje ZOO
programme.desc: Dokumentarno-animirana serija upoznaje najmlađe sa životinjskim vrstama.

programme.title: Pussy and puppy / Maca i Psić
programme.desc: Maca and a puppy celebrate Christmas and learn about the snow. / Maca i Psić slave Božić i uče o snijegu.

programme.title: Pocoyo
programme.desc: Pocoyo is a curious toddler dressed in blue from head to toe, prone to jokes and tiny mischief. The series follows the fun adventures of Pocoya and his friends, and each episode deals with another topic. The cheerful societies explore the world through play and teaches new words and concepts. And by the way she has a good time. The fourth season introduces us to the new character Nina and her pet robot Robert. / Pocoyo je radoznali mališan odjeven u plavo od glave do pete, sklon šali i sitnim nestašlucima. Serija prati zabavne pustolovine Pocoya i njegovih prijatelja, a svaka se epizoda bavi drugom temom. Veselo društvance kroz igru istražuje svijet i uči nove riječi i pojmove. I usput se dobro zabavlja. Četvrta sezona upoznaje nas s novim likom Ninom i njezinim kućnim ljubimcem robotom Robertom.

programme.title: Mališani
programme.desc: In the twenty -two -minute episodes of the series, you are waiting for unprecedented stories and posts: how to wash your paws with your puppy, how to feed it, how to put the laundry on drying and beat the clips, remove the dishes from the washing machine, prepare the orange juice, sweep the house, plant the plants in the garden, or to pack yourself for a trip. Spend the morning in the company of a two -year -old! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey is a lovely and tireless little six -year -old bitch of Australian cattle who lives with his mom, dad and younger sister Bingo. Bluey loves playing and draws all his family and the whole neighborhood into his world of fun and playing. / Bluey je dražesna i neumorna mala šestogodišnja kujica australskog govedara koja živi sa svojom mamom, tatom i mlađom sestrom Bingo. Bluey obožava igranje i uvlači svu svoju obitelj i cijelo susjedstvo u svoj svijet zabave i igranja.

programme.title: Mali Malabar
programme.desc: Little Malabar will learn that cancer can live in both water and land. The ocean will tell them that in ancient times, all living beings lived in the water. Little Malabar and Cancer will travel to the past, at a time when living beings had to learn to live on land ... In ancient times, all living beings lived in the ocean. In the places where the water was retreating, plants and animals eventually adapted to life on land. / Mali Malabar će naučiti da rak može živjeti i u vodi i na kopnu. Ocean će im reći da su u davno doba sva živa bića živjela u vodi. Mali Malabar i rak otputovat će u prošlost, u vrijeme kad su živa bića morala naučiti živjeti na kopnu... U davno su doba sva živa bića živjela u oceanu. Na mjestima na kojima se voda povlačila, biljke i životinje s vremenom su se prilagodile životu na kopnu.

programme.desc: The HTV Education and Science Department, in cooperation with the Croatian Language Institute, has recorded thirty videos in which, in addition to linguistic advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language such as the language of young people and foreign words in the Croatian language are addressed. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Stokavian and Chakavian dialects and unusual names of the place, but also of the frequent and unusual personal names. The head of the interview is the Croatian language professor Katarina Marjanovic, who gives numerous followers on Instagram. Her interviewees are experts from the Croatian Language Institute: Maja Matijevic, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidovic, Ivana Kurtovic Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. / Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec.

programme.title: Razgovor sa stijenama
programme.desc: This scientific and recipient film takes us through the rich geological past of Istria. We learn that numerous geological processes, rocks, minerals, soils, landscapes and other geological features have significantly influenced and still affect the life of this area from the economy to the rich cultural heritage. The story begins at the top of Vojak, at the Učka Nature Park in white Istria. The name was given to her solid and hard limestones built of the remains of a baptism of different organisms who lived in shallow subtropical and tropical seas. After that we head west, to another relief unit of Istria, to the area of ​​Gray Istria. The name owes the deposits of sedimentary gray rocks, deposited in the eocene period. In the area of ​​Gray Istria, the magical landscapes of Istrian towns on the tops of hills such as Motovun, Buzet or Boljun are famous. They thank their position with the imposing megalosilles of the sandstone on which they were built. Thus, geological material directly influenced the social development of this area. The third color of the Istrian Peninsula is red because of the particular soil, the reds, which is mostly in the world in Croatia, and in Istria the thickest layers are in Istria. A team of geologists presents us with the latest discovery of the world about how the redness actually originated. We will visit Rudokop near Rovinj in the area where the famous Kirmenjak has been removed for centuries, from which Venice and many other cities and monuments were built. In the underground quarry we will get to know the Istrian yellow, the most famous architectural and construction stone from Istria. In the 15th century, Juraj Dalmatinac built it in Italy. The eastern part of the Peninsula, the Labin area, known for coal, will also be an indispensable station. With the abundance of mine resources, we will discover why we proudly call the Boxit a Croatian national mineral. Following the geological traces on the Istrian peninsula, we will pass through four periods of rise in the Adriatic carbonate platform, the periods of its land phases when these different sediments and soil were created. And before the end, the dinosaur pass. You will have the opportunity to meet dinosaurs, herbivores and carnivores, who have been pushed with muddy soil under hot sun period. We will also visit the fertile soil of the Reds in the vicinity of Umag and find out why the first soil is protected as a cultural monument. In the end, we can toast the unbreakable connection between the soil with the cultural heritage and the tradition of this area with a glass of indigenous Istrian Teran or, who is for white, enjoy the rich aroma of Malvasia. Participants: Academician Goran Durn, Ph.D. Ivor Perković, Sergej Zvocak, B.Sc. geol., prof. Ph.D. Alexander Mezga, prof. Ph.D. Bruno Saftić, Milan Mihovilović, B.Sc. geol., Moreno Coronica. / Ovaj znanstveno-popularni film vodi nas kroz bogatu geološku prošlost Istre. Doznajemo kako su brojni geološki procesi, stijene, minerali, tla, pejzaži i druga geološka obilježja bitno utjecala i još utječu na život ovoga kraja od gospodarstva pa do bogate kulturne baštine. Priča započinje na vrhu Vojak, u Parku prirode Učka u Bijeloj Istri. Ime su joj dali čvrsti i tvrdi vapnenci izgrađeni od ostataka kršja različitih organizama koji su živjeli u plitkim suptropskim i tropskim morima. Nakon toga krećemo prema zapadu, u drugu reljefnu cjelinu Istre, na područje Sive Istre. Naziv duguje naslagama sedimentnih sivih stijena, taloženima u razdoblju eocena. Na području Sive Istre znameniti su magični krajolici istarskih gradića na vrhovima brežuljaka poput Motovuna, Buzeta ili Boljuna. Svoj položaj zahvaljuju impozantnim megaslojevima pješčenjaka na kojima su izgrađeni. Tako je geološka građa izravno utjecala na društveni razvoj ovoga kraja. Treća boja Istarskog poluotoka je crvena zbog osobitog tla, crvenice, koje najviše na svijetu ima u Hrvatskoj, a upravo su u Istri najdeblji slojevi. Tim geologa predstavlja nam najnovije svjetsko otkrić o tome kako je zapravo crvenica nastala. Posjetit ćemo rudokop u blizini Rovinja u kraju u kojem se stoljećima vadio slavni kirmenjak, od kojeg je sagrađena Venecija i mnogi drugi gradovi i spomenici. U podzemnom kamenolomu upoznat ćemo Istarski žuti, najpoznatiji arhitektonsko-građevni kamen iz Istre. Njime je u 15. stoljeću Juraj Dalmatinac gradio po Italiji. Nezaobilazna će postaja biti i istočni dio poluotoka, područje Labinštine, poznato po kopanju ugljena. Uz obilje rudnoga bogatstava, otkrit ćemo zbog čega boksit s ponosom zovemo hrvatskim nacionalnim mineralom. Prateći geološke tragove na Istarskom poluotoku proći ćemo četirima razdobljima izdizanja Jadranske karbonatne platforme, razdobljima njezinih kopnenih faza kada su ti različiti sedimenti i tla nastajali. I pred kraj, mimohod dinosaura. Imat ćete prigodu upoznati dinosaure, biljojede i mesojede, koji su gacali muljevitim tlom pod vrućim suncem razdoblja krede. Posjetit ćemo i plodno tlo crvenice u okolici Umaga i doznati zašto je ono prvo tlo zaštićeno kao spomenik kulture. Za kraj možemo nazdraviti neraskidivoj povezanosti tla s kulturnom baštinom i tradicijom ovoga kraja čašom autohtonog istarskoga terana ili, tko je za bijelo, uživati u bogatoj aromi malvazije. Sudjeluju: Akademik Goran Durn, dr. sc. Ivor Perković, Sergej Zvocak, dipl. ing. geol., prof. dr. sc. Aleksandar Mezga, prof. dr. sc. Bruno Saftić, Milan Mihovilović, dipl. ing. geol., Moreno Coronica.

programme.title: Indiskrecija
programme.desc: The sworn bachelor pretends to be married until the last in a series of women he seduced him does not decide to learn to mind. Anna Kalman (Ingrid Bergman), an internationally recognized theater actress, returns after a tour to her London apartment. Anna's sister Margaret (Phyllis Calvert) and her husband Alfred (Cecil Parker), a NATO official, come to the city to attend an official event. Margaret has been trying to find her husband for a long time. Philip Adams (Cary Grant), a handsome American who came to Paris, arrives in the city to give a speech at a festive dinner. There is an attraction between Anne and Philip immediately and soon start the relationship. Philip tells her that she lives separately from a woman, but she can't divorce. The two are increasingly getting closer until Philip announced that he was transferred to New York. She suggests to go with him and encourages him to ask for a divorce. While preparing to leave, Philip accidentally discovers Alfred that he is not really married and thus refuses women who want to marry. When Anna announced that he was going with Philip, Alfred revealed to her what he had just found out. Anna decides to punish Philip. He calls on the former courtiers to the apartment to find Philip there when he arrives. Fortunately, this little fraud does not disturb their relationship and they begin to forge plans for the common future. / Zakleti neženja pretvara se da je oženjen sve dok ga posljednja u nizu žena koje je zaveo ne odluči naučiti pameti. Anna Kalman (Ingrid Bergman), međunarodno priznata kazališna glumica, vraća se nakon turneje u svoj stan u Londonu. Annina sestra Margaret (Phyllis Calvert) i njezin suprug Alfred (Cecil Parker), dužnosnik NATO-a, dolaze u grad kako bi prisustvovali službenom događanju. Margaret već dugo neuspješno pokušava sestri naći muža. U grad stiže i Philip Adams (Cary Grant), zgodni Amerikanac koji je došao u Pariz kako bi održao govor na svečanoj večeri. Između Anne i Philipa odmah se rađa privlačnost te ubrzo započinju vezu. Philip joj kaže da živi odvojeno od žene, ali se ne može razvesti. Njih se dvoje sve više zbližava sve dok Philip ne objavi da je prebačen u New York. Ona mu predloži da pođe s njim te ga potiče da zatraži razvod. Dok se sprema za odlazak, Philip slučajno otkrije Alfredu da zapravo nije oženjen i da time odbija žene koje se žele udati. Kad Anna objavi da odlazi s Philipom, Alfred joj otkriva što je upravo saznao. Anna odluči kazniti Philipa. Poziva bivšeg udvarača u stan kako bi ga Philip zatekao ondje kad stigne. Na njihovu sreću, ova mala prevara ne narušava njihovu vezu te oni počnu kovati planove o zajedničkoj budućnosti.

programme.title: Draftsman / Crtač
programme.desc: Documentary film about the great Croatian artist Hrvoje Šercar (1936 _ 2014). The film is structured in "I forms" because Šercar directly addresses the viewer, and the camera follows the cartoonist's hand and the formation of authentic drawings. / Dokumentarni film o velikom hrvatskom umjetniku Hrvoju Šercaru (1936. _ 2014.). Film je strukturiran u "ja formi" jer se Šercar izravno obraća gledatelju, a kamera prati crtačevu ruku i nastajanje autentičnih crteža.

programme.title: Peti dan
programme.desc: In the new edition of the show, we discuss two current topics that cause a wide social echo _ health education and politicians to social networks. Aleksandar Music, Matija Stahan, Ena Katarina Haler and Erik Brezovec, will be presented to her views and arguments. Gabrijela Perišić is edited and run by the show, directed by Kamelija Čančarević, and the producer is Ana Vuić. / U novom izdanju emisije raspravljamo o dvjema aktualnim temama koje izazivaju širok društveni odjek _ zdravstvenom odgoju te odnosu političara prema društvenim mrežama. Svoje će poglede i argumente iznijeti komentatori Aleksandar Musić, Matija Štahan, Ena Katarina Haler i Erik Brezovec. Emisiju uređuje i vodi Gabrijela Perišić, režiju potpisuje Kamelija Čančarević, a producentica je Ana Vuić.

programme.title: Na rubu znanosti
programme.desc: In accordance with trends, the money becomes part of the digital world. Through card and internet business, and with the appearance of cryptocurrencies, digital money already exists. But the novelty in this field is to create digital state currency. Currently, as many as 130 countries, which together make up 98 % of the world GDP, explore, develop or already implement digital currencies in its economies. This raises important questions _ From the freedom of the choice of the individual and the surrender of the monetary system of private corporations, through the anonymity of consumption, to the dependence of the constant availability of modern devices, electricity and the Internet. In a comprehensive rush according to the issuance of the digital money of central banks, it is worth stopping and trying to understand: what brings with it such money and why is it introduced? / U skladu s trendovima, i novac postaje dio digitalnog svijeta. Putem kartičnog i internetskog poslovanja, a i pojavom kriptovaluta, digitalni novac već postoji. No, novost na tom polju jest stvaranje digitalnih državnih valuta. Trenutačno čak 130 zemalja, koje zajedno čine 98 % svjetskog BDP-a, istražuje, razvija ili već implementira digitalne valute u svojim gospodarstvima. Time se otvaraju važna pitanja _ od slobode izbora pojedinca i predaje upravljanja monetarnim sustavom privatnim korporacijama, preko anonimnosti potrošnje, pa sve do ovisnosti o stalnoj dostupnosti modernih uređaja, električne energije i interneta. U sveopćoj žurbi prema izdavanju digitalnog novca središnjih banaka, vrijedi zastati i pokušati razumjeti: što sa sobom donosi takav novac i zašto se uvodi?

programme.title: Austrijska gorska sela
programme.desc: In the valleys such as Gastajna, Klajnarlic and Grosarla, old mountain villages are rooted, rooted in local customs. The Gastajn valley has been marked by mining for centuries. The former miners nurture a special custom: dancing with swords. Willi Huttegger is certainly one of the most innovative mountain peasants. By exploiting his mountain pasture and his trade on the estate in the valley, he managed to switch to full -time agriculture. Markus Schaidreiter is still a young peasant in the Klajnarla valley who, under the motto "One for All, All for One" in cooperation with two other engaged young farmers, managed to achieve the merger of all three rural farms. The three of them want to return to the roots of agriculture. / U dolinama kao što su Gastajnska, Klajnarlska i Grosarlska raštrkana su stara planinska sela, ukorijenjena u lokalnim običajima. Gastajnska dolina stoljećima je bila obilježena rudarstvom. Bivši rudari njeguju poseban običaj: ples s mačevima. Willi Huttegger jamačno je jedan od najinovativnijih gorskih seljaka. Iskorištavanjem svog planinskog pašnjaka i svojom trgovinom na imanju u dolini uspio se prebaciti na poljodjelstvo s punim radnim vremenom. Markus Schaidreiter još je mlad seljak u Klajnarlskoj dolini koji je pod geslom "jedan za sve, svi za jednoga" u suradnji s još dvojicom angažiranih mladih poljodjelaca uspio postići spajanje svih triju seoskih gospodarstava. Njih trojica žele se vratiti korijenima poljodjelstva.

Svirači Tamburaškog orkestra HRT-a i Muzičke akademije u Zagrebu, sjedinjeni u jedinstveni tamburaški korpus, popratili su i nagrađivane vokalne soliste Tenu Lončarević i Mateja Predojevića Petrića, koji su se okušali u arijama velikana Jakova Gotovca, a mlada klarinetistica Ana-Maria Klasan izvela je virtuozne Čardaš varijacije iz Međimurja Emila Cossetta. Uz vrsne soliste na tamburi _ Marina Jurića, Frana Brlekovića i Nikolu Vilusa _ osebujnu aranžersku darovitost donijeli su nam Roberto Hren i Fran Brleković.

programme.title: AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu
programme.desc: Starting from five vowels and gestures of the screen coloring through autoportrators, TV performance aaaaeeeeeeiiiiooooooouuu is played with the voice, images, subjectivity and perception in the contemporary media environment, offering simultaneously meditative break and the space of critical reflection of usual tempo and content. Rad Karla Štefaneka emitira se u sklopu 60. izdanja Zagrebačkog salona.

programme.title: ART
programme.desc: In today's show, we are talking about the novel "Max, Mischa and the offensive of the aunt" by Johan Hartad, who has been proclaimed a book for a decade in Norway. We discover that this extensive work that questions the world of theater, identity, wars and trauma will premiere on the stage of the ZKM on October 17th. He will reveal his vision of this work full of references to the film, theater and music, which is at the center of the life of directors and artists, director Ivica Buljan and music author Darko Rundek in the studio. On the show, we will see a clip from rehearsal and talking to the actors and a conversation recorded in Oslo 2023 with the author of Romana visited by Ivona Haller in his home. / U današnjoj emisiji govorimo o romanu "Max, Mischa i ofenziva Tet" autora Johana Harstada, koji je u Norveškoj proglašen knjigom desetljeća. Otkrivamo kako će to opsežno djelo koje propituje svijet kazališta, identiteta, ratova i trauma 17. listopada premijerno zaživjeti na pozornici ZKM-a. Svoju viziju tog djela prepunog referencija na film, kazalište i glazbu, kojemu je u središtu život redatelja i umjetnika, otkrit će nam u studiju redatelj Ivica Buljan te autor glazbe Darko Rundek. U emisiji ćemo vidjeti isječak s probe i razgovor s glumcima te razgovor snimljen u Oslu 2023. s autorom romana kojeg je u njegovu domu posjetila Ivona Haller.

programme.title: A book or life / Knjiga ili život
programme.desc: Introducing a "great book of lyric poetry", an anthology composed by poet Slobodan Blagojevic in three Tom, which for the first time in history covers the poetic traditions of Serbia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro and Croatia, in a time range of one millennium. The novel by Montenegrin writer Milorad Popovic is also literary fascinating, and already affirmed in Croatia; His new novel is the title "court square" towards the Square of the same name in Cetinje, that old capital of Montenegro. The new, fourth novel by Olja Knezevic "Strada Fortunata" received the Tportal for Best Novel and is dramatized for the third program of Croatian Radio. In it, she reaches for her own life experience, but although the storyteller, the protagonist and author of the novel are partially overlapping, this is not a classic automation. Like Olja Knezevic and Italian author Veronica Raimo play with autobiography and already in the title of the novel he claims "I'm lying when I go." The fourth Roman Veronica Raimo was the finalist for the Straga Award, and won the category presented by the Strga-off bookstore and the one given by young readers of Straga Giovani. / Predstavljamo "Veliku knjigu lirske poezije", antologiju koju je sastavio pjesnik Slobodan Blagojević u tri toma, a koja prvi put u povijesti obuhvaća pjesničke tradicije Srbije, Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore i Hrvatske, i to u vremenskom rasponu od jednog milenija. Književno fascinantan je i roman crnogorskog književnika Milorada Popovića, već otprije afirmiranog i u Hrvatskoj; njegov je novi roman nosi naslov "Dvorski trg" prema istoimenom trgu na Cetinju, toj staroj prijestolnici Crne Gore. Novi, četvrti roman Olje Knežević "Strada fortunata" dobio je nagradu Tportala za najbolji roman i dramatiziran je za Treći program Hrvatskog radija. U njemu ona poseže u vlastito životno iskustvo, ali iako se pripovjedačica, protagonistica i autorica romana djelomično preklapaju, ovdje nije riječ o klasičnoj autofikciji. Poput Olje Knežević i talijanska autorica Veronica Raimo poigrava se s autobiografijom pa već u naslovu romana tvrdi "Lažem kad zinem". Četvrti roman Veronice Raimo bio je finalist za nagradu Strega, a pobijedio je u kategoriji koju dodjeljuju knjižari Strega-off i onoj koju dodjeljuju mladi čitatelji Strega Giovani.

Quentina Hamerhama.

programme.title: Retrospektiva Alaina Delona: Casanovin povratak
programme.desc: Casanova is forbidden to enter Venice, and is forced to wander, old and burdened with debt, through southern French and northern Italy. During this wandering he meets his old friend, who offers him accommodation in his home. Winning the beautiful Marcolina, a friend's niece, will be Casanovina's last battle. / Casanovi je zabranjen ulazak u Veneciju, te je prisiljen lutati, ostario i opterećen dugovima, kroz južnu Francusku i sjevernu Italiju. Tijekom tog lutanja susreće svog starog prijatelja, koji mu nudi smještaj u svom domu. Osvajanje prelijepe Marcoline, prijateljeve nećakinje, bit će Casanovina posljednja bitka.

During this wandering he meets his old friend, who offers him accommodation in his home. Winning the beautiful Marcolina, a friend's niece, will be Casanovina's last battle. / Casanovi je zabranjen ulazak u Veneciju, te je prisiljen lutati, ostario i opterećen dugovima, kroz južnu Francusku i sjevernu Italiju. Tijekom tog lutanja susreće svog starog prijatelja, koji mu nudi smještaj u svom domu. Osvajanje prelijepe Marcoline, prijateljeve nećakinje, bit će Casanovina posljednja bitka.

programme.title: Razgovor sa stijenama
programme.desc: In this story of the growth islands, which are also the youngest and oldest islands on the Adriatic, we will introduce unique geological and geomorphological phenomena of the surplus archipelago. At the same time, we will go through the highest concentration of nature monuments and the protected landscapes of this _ last paradise oasis of the Mediterranean, as the Vis Archipelago proclaimed the World Nature Protection Organization. We will start a journey with the famous travel writer, scientist and geologist Albert Fortis, who sailed 250 years ago and concluded that he was in the middle of a volcanic triangle. But although an apple islet like a black piramid from a volcanic diabetes rose over the sea, Fortis was still fooled. With the professional help of our guide, we will find out that these volcanic rocks of apples, Brussels and Palagruza found themselves there. We will get acquainted with the main feature of the surplus archipelago _ with salt diapins. Find out what an ordinary kitchen salt can do, 220 million years ago, together with magmatic and volcanic rocks deep in the Earth's bark. We will walk around the landscaped geostasis, sail like Tin Ujevic around the island of Saints, visit Brusnik and collect new insights at the Komiš Pirates and Kemenice beaches overlooking the granddiozing natural amphitheater of the Bay of Komiš. We will look for traces of dinosaurs who were pushed by these tidal plains 100 million years ago. In addition to geology, we will be accompanied by a rich cultural heritage of this distant islands. So we will find out how the sand dunes from the younger Stone Age are connected with the best Croatian wine, Mali. Join us on a boat trip, on foot, through the caves of blue and green, on gravel bays and the highest peaks. Participants: Ph.D. Tvrtko Korbar, Scientific Advisor, Croatian Geological Institute; Filip Prelec, geologist in Geopark Vis Archipelago; Lana Schmidt, Executive Director of Geopark Viska Archipelago. / U ovoj priči o otocima koji rastu, koji su ujedno i najmlađi i najstariji otoci na Jadranu upoznat ćemo jedinstvene geološke i geomorfološke pojave Viškoga arhipelaga. Ujedno ćemo proći kroz najveću koncentraciju spomenika prirode i zaštićenih krajolika ove _ posljednje rajske oaze Mediterana, kako je Viški arhipelag proglasila Svjetska organizacija za zaštitu prirode. Započet ćemo putovanje sa znamenitim putopiscem, znanstvenikom i geologom Albertom Fortisom, koji je prije 250 godina plovio ovim krajem i zaključio da se nalazi usred vulkanskoga trokuta. No, premda se otočić Jabuka poput crne piramide od vulkanskoga dijabaza uzdiže nad morem, Fortis se ipak prevario. Uz stručnu pomoć našega vodiča doznat ćemo kako su se te vulkanske stijene Jabuke, Brusnika i Palagruže tu našle. Upoznat ćemo se s glavnim obilježjem Viškoga arhipelaga _ solnim dijapirima. Saznati što sve može napraviti obična kuhinjska sol pokopana prije 220 milijuna godina zajedno s magmatskim i vulkanskim stijenama duboko u Zemljinoj kori. Prošetat ćemo se uređenim geostazama, ploviti poput Tina Ujevića oko otoka Sveca, posjetiti Brusnik i skupljati nove spoznaje na komiškim plažama Gusarica i Kemenice s pogledom na grandiozni prirodni amfiteatar Komiškoga zaljeva. Potražit ćemo tragove dinosaura koji su gacali ovim plimnim ravnicama prije 100 milijuna godina. Uz geologiju, pratit će nas i bogato kulturno nasljeđe ovoga udaljenoga otočja. Tako ćemo doznati kako su povezane pješčane dine iz mlađeg kamenog doba s ponajboljim hrvatskim vinom Plavcem malim. Pridružite nam se na putovanju brodom, pješice, kroz špilje modre i zelene, na šljunčane uvale i najviše vrhove. Sudjeluju: dr. sc. Tvrtko Korbar, znanstveni savjetnik, Hrvatski geološki institut; Filip Prelec, geolog u Geoparku Viški arhipelag; Lana Schmidt, izvršna direktorica Geoparka Viški arhipelag.

programme.title: As it is said / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The HTV Education and Science Department, in cooperation with the Croatian Language Institute, has recorded thirty videos in which, in addition to linguistic advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language such as the language of young people and foreign words in the Croatian language are addressed. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Stokavian and Chakavian dialects and unusual names of the place, but also of the frequent and unusual personal names. The head of the interview is the Croatian language professor Katarina Marjanovic, who gives numerous followers on Instagram. Her interviewees are experts from the Croatian Language Institute: Maja Matijevic, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidovic, Ivana Kurtovic Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. / Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec.

programme.title: Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore together and discover the world around us, learn about ourselves and others. We learn in play, in songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuh every morning, every day from 6.30am to 1pm. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: Sixty short stories of sound, which are heard through the ears of a small but very active being called "sound collector", which has a passion for sound and all the concepts related to sound, despite the fact that he hears very poorly. This small being spends his days discovering and learning new sounds he finds on his adventures: these are the most common sounds of the sea, sounds that produce beings in the sea, the sounds produced by insects, including snoring his best friend and pet Marta. / Šezdeset kratkih pričica o zvuku, koje se čuju kroz uši malog, ali vrlo aktivnog bića zvanog "Sakupljač zvukova", koji ima strast za zvuk i sve pojmove vezane uz zvuk, unatoč činjenici da on vrlo slabo čuje. To malo biće provodi svoje dane otkrivajući i učeći nove zvukove koje pronalazi na svojim pustolovinama: to su najčešće zvukovi mora, zvuklovi koje proizvode bića u moru, zvukovi koje proizvode kukci, uključujući i hrkanje njegove najbolje prijateljice i kućnog ljubimca Mirte.

programme.desc: The garbage collector of the mayor of Humdinger died the beach. Rocky goes to rescue with a new recycling truck. // Princess's gift is scattered all over the city. programme.title: Vrijeme je za Timmyja

But now he is going to kindergarten with other cubs and will have to learn to behave in the company of his peers. In each episode, one day is shown in kindergarten. The daily routine of the only crazy toddler disrupts. Through various events and accidents, Timmy and his friends learn about life and friendship. / Timmy je malo janje željno novih znanja. Upravo je navršio tri godine, a budući da je jedino janje u stadu, navikao je da sve bude po njegovom. No sad kreće u vrtić s drugim mladuncima i morat će se naučiti ponašati u društvu svojih vršnjaka. U svakoj se epizodi prikazuje jedan dan u vrtiću. Svakodnevnu rutinu remete jedino ludorije mališana. Kroz razne zgode i nezgode, Timmy i njegovi prijatelji uče o životu i prijateljstvu.

The machine does not always work the way they imagined and emerge many humorous and unforeseen situations. / Krceki su mala obitelj: vjeverica, žir, kokos i kikiriki. Žive zajedno u Krcogradu i vole avanture. Zbog svoje znatiželje upadaju u razne nevolje, a kako bi riješili problem izmisle uvijek neki stroj. Stroj ne radi uvijek onako kako su zamislili i nastanu mnoge šaljive i nepredviđene situacije.

In this episode, Marko gets the task of helping educators prepare a bird feeding workshop, and she will learn that one of the most important tasks of zoos is precisely education and learning about animals, both children and adults. / U serijalu VOLIM ŽIVOTINJE ZOO upoznajemo životinje u zoološkom vrtu. Volonter Marko voli životinje i uči o njima pomažući djelatnicima vrta. Svaki dan za njega je novi izazov jer dobiva poseban zadatak koji ne može obaviti ako ne nauči ponešto o svakodnevnim aktivnostima u zoološkom vrtu. U ovoj epizodi Marko dobiva zadatak pomoći edukatorima pripremiti radionicu izrade hranilica za ptice, uz to naučit će da je jedna od najvažnijih zadaća zooloških vrtova upravo obrazovanje i učenje o životinjama, i djece i odraslih.

Spend the morning in the company of a two -year -old! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

Bluey obožava igranje i uvlači svu svoju obitelj i cijelo susjedstvo u svoj svijet zabave i igranja.

programme.title: Mali Malabar
programme.desc: In the water the whale is much faster than the little Malebar, and it is slower on the mainland. The Ocean will explain that it was not always the case because in ancient times and whale could run quickly. Little Malabar will go to race with whale ancestors ... In ancient times, four -legged land animals began to swim. After many generations, they evolved into sea mammals like whales, which still exist today. / U vodi je kit puno brži od malog Malabara, a na kopnu je sporiji. Ocean će objasniti da to nije uvijek bilo tako jer je u davno doba i kit mogao brzo trčati. Mali Malabar otići će se utrkivati s kitovim precima... U davno su doba četveronožne kopnene životinje počele plivati. Nakon mnogo naraštaja evoluirale su u morske sisavce poput kitova, koji i danas postoje.

programme.desc: "Peppa Praščić" is a British animated TV series for preschool children. This long -standing series for children is accompanied by the events and accidents of Peppe and her friends, her brother George, their parents and other animal families living in their city. / "Peppa Praščić" je britanska animirana TV serija namijenjena djeci predškolskog uzrasta. Ova dugovječna serija za djecu prati zgode i nezgode Peppe i njezinih prijatelja, njezinog brata Georga, njihovih roditelja i drugih životinjskih obitelji koje žive u njihovom gradu.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Simon is a cute little rabbit that foists the vitalness of childhood. In age, when small bunnies (like small children) are studying in people and experience challenges in relation to their parents, they move to school, learn generally about the world, they face authorities and, of course, learn their language. Children can take Simon for an example of taking care of himself, I can learn from him and from his incompetents, from situations where simon needs to give in in his insistence and spoiling, and always remain polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on books Stephanie Blake in the edition of the French publisher Lecole des loisirs. He was directed by the TV series Julien Cayot, and it was produced by Go-N Productions. The series in France had Prime Minister 17. December 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. / Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta.
