programme.title: Greenwashed? Nutella: Ferrero's green fairy tale / Greenwashed? Nutella: Das grune Marchen von Ferrero
programme.desc: Cocoa, palmol, supply chain - the chocolate industry does not have a good reputation. Ferrero, the inventor of Nutella, promises sustainability. Are they serious? Or is that greenwashing? Cocoa from Africa, palm oil from Asia, nuts from Turkey - that smacks of problems. Ferrero responds to these with sustainability promises. Environmental reporter Sherif wants to know exactly this - and follows the Nutella supply chain. What once began in Michele Ferrero's pastry shop in the tranquil northern Italian town of Alba has now grown into a global chocolate empire. With brands such as Nutella, Ferrero Rocher and Kinder Chocolate, Ferrero has become an integral part of every confectionery shelf in the world. For the procurement of raw materials, in particular cocoa, palm oil and hazelnuts, the company has defined its own sustainability charter, which is intended to ensure a responsible supply chain: no clearing of forests, no children on plantations, compensation areas to protect the Environment. In short: sustainable, social and fair. Ferrero calls this “putting people at the heart of our supply chain.” This is where environmental reporter Sherif Rizkallah comes into play. He sets off to the same "people" at the starting point of the supply chain to see whether Ferrero will comply: to an agricultural cooperative in the Ivory Coast that grows cocoa for Ferrero. To an oil mill in Malaysia that supplies Ferrero with RSPO-certified palm oil. And to Italy. Ferrero is significantly expanding its hazelnut production there. Turkey is the world's main producer of hazelnuts, including for Ferrero. But there are repeated reports of exploitation on plantations on the Turkish Black Sea coast. Ferrero is now increasingly relying on local cultivation in Italy. Local cultivation, that is. Sherif thinks that's good - but he wonders why the residents around Lago di Vico haven't wanted to swim in this beautiful lake in the middle of the hazelnut plantations for some time now. Ultimately, Sherif wants to answer the question of how much sustainability is really in his Nutella? / Kakao, Palmol, Lieferkette - die Schokobranche hat keinen guten Ruf. Ferrero, der Erfinder von Nutella, verspricht Nachhaltigkeit. Meinen die das ernst? Oder ist das Greenwashing?Kakao aus Afrika, Palmol aus Asien, Nusse aus der Turkei - das schmeckt nach Problemen. Denen begegnet Ferrero mit Nachhaltigkeitsversprechen. Das will Umweltreporter Sherif genau wissen - und folgt der Lieferkette von Nutella.Was einst in der Konditorei von Michele Ferrero im beschaulichen norditalienischen Stadtchen Alba begann, ist heute zu einem globalen Schoko-Imperium herangewachsen. Mit Marken wie Nutella, Ferrero Rocher und Kinder Schokolade ist Ferrero aus keinem SuSSwarenregal der Welt mehr wegzudenken.Fur die Beschaffung der Rohstoffe, insbesondere Kakao, Palmol und Haselnusse hat das Unternehmen jeweils eine eigene Nachhaltigkeitscharta definiert, die eine verantwortungsvolle Lieferkette gewahrleisten soll: keine Walder roden, keine Kinder auf Plantagen, Ausgleichsflachen zum Schutz der Umwelt. Kurzum: nachhaltig, sozial und fair. Ferrero nennt das "putting people at the heart of our supply chain".An dieser Stelle kommt Umwelt-Reporter Sherif Rizkallah ins Spiel. Er bricht auf zu eben diesen "People" am Ausgangspunkt der Lieferkette, um zu sehen, ob Ferrero das einhalt: zu einer Landwirtschaftskooperative in der Elfenbeinkuste, die Kakao fur Ferrero anbaut. Zu einer Ölmuhle in Malaysia, die Ferrero mit RSPO-zertifiziertem Palmol beliefert.Und nach Italien. Denn dort baut Ferrero seine Haselnussproduktion stark aus. Zwar ist die Turkei weltweit Hauptproduzent von Haselnussen, auch fur Ferrero. Doch immer wieder gibt es Berichte uber Ausbeutung auf Plantagen an der turkischen Schwarzmeerkuste. Ferrero setzt jetzt vermehrt auf lokalen Anbau in Italien.Lokaler Anbau also. Das findet Sherif gut - fragt sich allerdings, warum die Einwohner um den Lago di Vico seit einiger Zeit in diesem schonen See inmitten der Haselnussplantagen nicht mehr baden wollen.Schlussendlich will Sherif die Frage beantworten, wie viel Nachhaltigkeit denn nun wirklich in seiner Nutella steckt?

programme.title: Solo fur Weiss
programme.desc: Nora Weiss and her colleagues follow a drug transfer at night in which the locally prominent star chef and suspected drug dealer Peter Probek is to be arrested. But the operation goes wrong because there are no drugs to be found and they are left empty-handed. In this way, Probek can avoid arrest. At the same time, the owner of a marine waste disposal fleet, Heiner Jaspers, is murdered on his catamaran. Ben Salawi, who has a common past with the victim's daughter, Leonie, asks his colleague Nora to join the investigation. She is certain: whoever killed Heiner Jaspers is after the missing drug shipment - which means that Peter Probek is once again in the investigators' sights. / Nora Weiss und ihre Kollegen verfolgen eine nachtliche Drogenubergabe, bei der der lokalprominente Sternekoch und mutmaSSliche Drogenhandler Peter Probek dingfest gemacht werden soll.Doch der Einsatz geht schief, denn es sind keine Drogen zu finden, und sie stehen mit leeren Handen da. So kann sich Probek einer Verhaftung entziehen. Parallel wird der Inhaber einer Flotte fur Meeresmullentsorgung, Heiner Jaspers, auf seinem Katamaran ermordet.Ben Salawi, den mit der Tochter des Opfers, Leonie, eine gemeinsame Vergangenheit verbindet, bittet seine Kollegin Nora, in die Ermittlungen einzusteigen. Die ist sich sicher: Wer immer Heiner Jaspers getotet hat, ist hinter der verschwundenen Drogenlieferung her - womit Peter Probek erneut ins Visier der Ermittler gerat.

programme.title: The Diplomat
programme.desc: Mariona questions Sam's intentions after being released from custody. She threatens to tell Laura about Jay Sutherland's death. A serious mistake.Amanda and Richard Watkins from England are tourists in Barcelona. After a fight in a subway station, Richard suffers a heart attack. His wife needs help from the embassy. A serious incident occurs in the Sagrada subway station: British tourist couple Richard (Richard Ridings) and Amanda Watkins (Lindsay Coulson) get into a fight. The crime was filmed on cell phones by two British language school students. A police officer had approached Richard as he was hitting the ticket machine at the metro station. Seemingly for no reason, a wild and dangerous scuffle breaks out between the two men. To defend Richard, Amanda hits his opponent with a shoe. Result: Richard's opponent suffers a concussion and a ruptured eardrum, and Richard suffers a heart attack. He is taken to a city hospital. Amanda needs the embassy's help; the couple is facing charges. Laura's employee Carl (Dylan Brady) looks after Amanda exclusively. Inspector Castells (Isak Ferriz) visits Laura (Sophie Rundle) to discuss the case "Watkins against the rest of the world". Amanda is distracted, she had recently slept with Fabian Hartmann (Philip Boos) and is attracted to the charming German-Spanish man. Fabian visits Laura in her apartment to reassure her that he had nothing to do with the apparently false lead in the Jay Sutherland murder case. He lies to her. He would also like to continue the affair. Jay's father Colin (Danny Sapani) followed Fabian and watched him with Laura. Amy Callaghan (Eukha Akilade), an important witness in the Jay Sutherland case and in possession of his diving watch, is hiding in Ibiza. She was forced to give a false statement by Mariona Cabell (Laia Costa) on behalf of Fabian Hartmann. Two men overpower her in Ibiza and take her back to Barcelona - to the police. Fabian is therefore angry with Mariona; their shared framework of lies is in danger of falling apart. Mariona has been released from custody. She meets again with Consul Sam Henderson (Steven Cree), who sees the "wedding" at risk. The "Wedding" is a coalition of several criminal clans who want to bring down the peace process with terrorist attacks in Ireland and abroad. Sam lets Mariona feel his growing distrust. Mariona, in turn, threatens Sam to tell Laura. Mariona becomes a security risk - for Sam and for Fabian. When she called Laura to her apartment in the evening, the lawyer was suddenly run over by a car on the street on the way to her house. / Mariona zweifelt an Sams Absichten, nachdem sie aus dem Arrest entlassen wurde. Sie droht, bei Laura uber Jay Sutherlands Tod auszupacken. Ein folgenschwerer Fehler.Amanda und Richard Watkins aus England sind in Barcelona als Touristen unterwegs. Nach einer Schlagerei in einer U-Bahnstation erleidet Richard einen Herzinfarkt. Seine Frau benotigt die Hilfe der Botschaft.In der U-Bahn Station Sagrada kommt es zu einem folgenschweren Vorfall: Das britische Touristenpaar Richard (Richard Ridings) und Amanda Watkins (Lindsay Coulson) gerat in eine Schlagerei. Die Tat wurde von zwei britischen Sprachschulerinnen mit dem Handy gefilmt. Ein Polizist war auf Richard zugegangen, als dieser auf den Fahrkartenautomaten der Metrostation einschlug. Scheinbar ohne Grund kommt es zwischen den beiden Mannern zu einem wilden und gefahrlichen Gerangel.Um Richard zu verteidigen, schlagt Amanda mit einem Schuh auf seinen Gegner ein. Resultat: Richards Widersacher erleidet eine Gehirnerschutterung und ein geplatztes Trommelfell, Richard einen Herzinfarkt. Er wird in ein Krankenhaus der Stadt gebracht. Amanda benotigt die Hilfe der Botschaft, dem Paar droht eine Anklage. Lauras Mitarbeiter Carl (Dylan Brady) kummert sich exklusiv um Amanda.Inspector Castells (Isak Ferriz) sucht Laura (Sophie Rundle) auf, um den Fall "Watkins gegen den Rest der Welt" zu besprechen. Amanda ist abgelenkt, sie hatte kurz zuvor mit Fabian Hartmann (Philip Boos) geschlafen und fuhlt sich von dem charmanten Deutsch-Spanier angezogen. Fabian besucht Laura in ihrer Wohnung, um ihr noch mal zu versichern, dass er mit der scheinbar falschen Spur im Mordfall Jay Sutherland nichts zu tun hatte. Er belugt sie. AuSSerdem mochte er die Affare gerne fortsetzen. Jays Vater Colin (Danny Sapani) war Fabian gefolgt und hat ihn gemeinsam mit Laura beobachtet.Amy Callaghan (Eukha Akilade), wichtige Zeugin im Fall Jay Sutherland und im Besitz seiner Taucheruhr, hat sich auf Ibiza versteckt. Sie war von Mariona Cabell (Laia Costa) im Auftrag von Fabian Hartmann zu einer Falschaussage gezwungen wurden. Zwei Manner uberwaltigen sie auf Ibiza und bringen sie nach Barcelona zuruck - zur Polizei. Fabian ist deshalb sauer auf Mariona, ihr gemeinsames Lugengerust droht zu zerbrechen.Mariona wurde aus der Untersuchungshaft entlassen. Sie trifft sich erneut mit Konsul Sam Henderson (Steven Cree), der die "Hochzeit" gefahrdet sieht. Die "Hochzeit" ist ein Zusammenschluss mehrerer krimineller Clans, die den Friedensprozess mit terroristischen Attacken in Irland und im Ausland zu Fall bringen wollen. Sam lasst Mariona sein wachsendes Misstrauen spuren. Mariona wiederum droht Sam, Laura gegenuber auszupacken. Mariona wird zum Sicherheitsrisiko - fur Sam und fur Fabian. Als sie Laura telefonisch abends in ihre Wohnung bestellt, wird die Anwaltin auf offener StraSSe auf dem Weg zu ihrem Haus plotzlich von einem Auto uberrollt.

programme.title: The Diplomat
programme.desc: Laura Simmonds helps British citizen Jenna Tyler protect herself from a stalker. Colin Sutherland finally learns how his son Jay died. Sam Henderson drops the mask after the violent death of Mariona Cabell. - Exciting finale of the mini-series. Laura Simmonds (Sophie Rundle) and her team have to take care of Jenna Tyler (Natalie Spence). The English influencer is in Barcelona for a presentation. She is stalked by her compatriot Stuart Baron (Will Attenborough), who accuses her of stealing his ideas and passing them off as her own. Alba Ortiz (Serena Manteghi) wants to protect Jenna and gets into a heated argument with Stuart and is stabbed by him. She survives seriously injured. Inspector Castells (Isak Ferriz) was able to locate Amy Callaghan (Eukha Akilade) in Ibiza and bring her to Barcelona. She is the witness who worked at the bar with Jay Sutherland on Fabian Hartmann's (Philipp Boos) yacht on the night of the murder. Consul Sam Henderson (Steven Cree) ensures that Castells cannot question Amy at first, his own agenda takes priority. Henderson comes out of the cover of Laura Simmonds. He works for the British secret service. Sam Henderson is supposed to arrest Irish terrorist Eoin McKinley. McKinley is the head of a group that is sabotaging the peace process in Ireland and preparing attacks. At the "wedding" in Barcelona, ​​the group wants to expand and join forces with Dutch gangsters, including Peter Van Der Meer (Edon Rizvanolli) - the man who had an argument with Jay on the yacht about Amy. Fabian Hartmann is the mediator between the criminal parties and is generously rewarded financially for this. Laura has to realize that Fabian is not only responsible for the death of Mariona Cabell, but also told her the untruth about the evening on the yacht.Henderson has the police surround the tapas bar where the meeting between Irish and Dutch people, the "wedding" arranged by Fabian, is supposed to take place. When Hartmann, Van Der Meer and McKinley, accompanied by two other people, arrive on site, the handcuffs click. Fabian Hartmann remains unmolested. Castells is finally able to question Amy Callaghan in the presence of Laura and Colin Sutherland (Danny Sapani), Jay's father. Amy reveals that she was sexually assaulted by Peter Van Der Meer on that fateful evening. Jay came to her aid. Van der Meer took this as an insult and beat Jay and his friends to death. Fabian Hartmann had the men noticed. Amy gives Colin Sutherland his son's watch. Colin forgives Amy for keeping silent for so long out of fear.Last repeat episode "The Diplomat" / Laura Simmonds hilft der britischen Staatsburgerin Jenna Tyler dabei, sich vor einem Stalker zu schutzen. Colin Sutherland erfahrt endlich, wie sein Sohn Jay zu Tode gekommen ist.Sam Henderson lasst nach dem gewaltsamen Tod von Mariona Cabell die Maske fallen. - Spannendes Finale der Mini-Serie.Laura Simmonds (Sophie Rundle) und ihr Team mussen sich um Jenna Tyler (Natalie Spence) kummern. Die englische Influencerin ist zu einer Prasentation in Barcelona. Sie wird von ihrem Landsmann Stuart Baron (Will Attenborough) gestalkt, der ihr vorwirft, seine Ideen gestohlen zu haben und als ihre eigenen auszugeben. Alba Ortiz (Serena Manteghi) will Jenna beschutzen und gerat in eine heftige Auseinandersetzung mit Stuart, wird von diesem niedergestochen. Sie uberlebt schwer verletzt.Inspector Castells (Isak Ferriz) konnte Amy Callaghan (Eukha Akilade) in Ibiza ausfindig machen und nach Barcelona bringen. Sie ist die Zeugin, die in der Mordnacht mit Jay Sutherland auf Fabian Hartmanns (Philipp Boos) Yacht an der Bar gearbeitet hat. Konsul Sam Henderson (Steven Cree) sorgt dafur, dass Castells Amy zunachst nicht befragen kann, seine eigene Agenda hat Prioritat.Henderson kommt Laura Simmonds gegenuber aus der Deckung. Er arbeitet fur den britischen Geheimdienst. Sam Henderson soll den irischen Terroristen Eoin McKinley verhaften. McKinley ist der Kopf einer Gruppe, die den Friedensprozess in Irland sabotiert und Anschlage vorbereitet. Bei der "Hochzeit" in Barcelona will sich die Gruppe vergroSSern und mit hollandischen Gangstern zusammen schlieSSen, zu denen Peter Van Der Meer (Edon Rizvanolli) gehort - der Mann, der mit Jay auf der Yacht wegen Amy Streit hatte.Fabian Hartmann ist der Vermittler zwischen den kriminellen Parteien, wird dafur finanziell groSSzugig entlohnt. Laura muss erkennen, dass Fabian nicht nur fur den Tod von Mariona Cabell verantwortlich ist, sondern ihr gegenuber die Unwahrheit uber den Abend auf der Yacht gesagt hat.Henderson lasst die Tapas-Bar, in der das Treffen zwischen Iren und Hollandern, die von Fabian arrangierte "Hochzeit" stattfinden soll, von der Polizei umstellen. Als Hartmann, Van Der Meer und McKinley in Begleitung von zwei weiteren Personen vor Ort sind, klicken die Handschellen. Fabian Hartmann bleibt unbehelligt.Endlich kann Castells Amy Callaghan in Anwesenheit von Laura und Colin Sutherland (Danny Sapani), Jays Vater, befragen. Amy erzahlt, dass sie an dem schicksalhaften Abend von Peter Van Der Meer sexuell belastigt wurde. Jay kam ihr zu Hilfe. Van der Meer empfand das als Beleidigung und prugelte Jay mit seinen Freunden zu Tode. Fabian Hartmann lieSS die Manner gewahren. Amy ubergibt Colin Sutherland die Uhr seines Sohnes. Colin verzeiht Amy, dass sie aus Angst so lange schwieg.Letzte Wiederholungsfolge "The Diplomat"

programme.title: Fruhling
programme.desc: There is no sign of a contemplative Christmas season: Katja Baumann witnesses a serious skiing accident in which a girl is critically injured. Only Professor Gabriel can carry out the complicated operation that is supposed to save little Emily's life. But it seems to have been swallowed up by the earth. Together with her daughter Kiki, Katja goes looking for him. A race against time begins. At the same time, Katja also takes care of the person who caused the accident, Lutz Engel, whose family has been in trouble for a long time. Financial problems, arguments and alcohol abuse threaten to destroy the family. Will Katja find a way so that Christmas can be celebrated behind all doors in spring? / Von besinnlicher Weihnachtszeit keine Spur: Katja Baumann wird Zeugin eines schweren Skiunfalls, bei dem ein Madchen lebensbedrohlich verletzt wird.Die komplizierte Operation, die das Leben der kleinen Emily retten soll, kann nur Professor Gabriel ausfuhren. Doch der ist wie vom Erdboden verschluckt. Gemeinsam mit ihrer Tochter Kiki begibt sich Katja auf die Suche nach ihm. Ein Wettlauf gegen die Zeit beginnt.Gleichzeitig kummert sich Katja auch um den Unfallverursacher Lutz Engel, in dessen Familie schon seit Langerem der Haussegen schief hangt. Finanzielle Probleme, Streit und Alkoholmissbrauch drohen die Familie zu zerstoren. Wird Katja einen Weg finden, dass am Ende hinter allen Turen in Fruhling Weihnachten gefeiert werden kann?

programme.title: Notruf Hafenkante
programme.desc: During a raid, Mattes and Melanie come across the heavily pregnant Sandra Beyer, who wanted to get a fake ID. It soon becomes clear that Sandra has been on the run for years. It turns out that Sandra has been wanted for nine years as the main suspect in a case of arson resulting in death. Although she protests her innocence, the evidence speaks against her. But Franzi also has doubts about Sandra's perpetrator. Suddenly Sandra goes into labor and is taken to the EKH by Hans and Franzi. Due to a slight fever, a more detailed examination will be carried out. However, before Jasmin can tell Sandra that her baby's life is in danger due to an infection, she has disappeared from the EKH. In order to find Sandra as quickly as possible and save her child's life, the police officers have to deal with Sandra's past. They get caught up in a web of lies, intrigue and disappointed feelings. / Wahrend einer Razzia stoSSen Mattes und Melanie auf die hochschwangere Sandra Beyer, die sich einen gefalschten Ausweis besorgen wollte. Bald wird klar, Sandra ist seit Jahren auf der Flucht.Es stellt sich heraus, dass Sandra seit neun Jahren als Hauptverdachtige in einem Fall wegen Brandstiftung mit Todesfolge gesucht wird. Sie beteuert zwar ihre Unschuld, aber die Beweislage spricht gegen sie. Doch auch Franzi hat Zweifel an Sandras Taterschaft.Plotzlich setzen bei Sandra Wehen ein, und sie wird von Hans und Franzi ins EKH gebracht. Aufgrund von leichtem Fieber wird eine genauere Untersuchung durchgefuhrt. Bevor Jasmin Sandra jedoch mitteilen kann, dass ihr Baby durch eine Infektion in Lebensgefahr schwebt, ist diese aus dem EKH verschwunden. Um Sandra so schnell wie moglich zu finden und das Leben ihres Kindes zu retten, mussen die Polizisten sich mit Sandras Vergangenheit auseinandersetzen. Sie geraten in ein Geflecht von Lugen, Intrigen und enttauschten Gefuhlen.

programme.title: SOKO Wismar
programme.sub-title: Harbor of marriage / Hafen der Ehe
programme.desc: Harbor crane operator Piet Lasseck is rescued dead from the marina. What happened? Judging by his head wound, the father of the family was killed. Lasseck's wife Thea is shocked. She claims to have had no problems with her husband. But an anonymous emergency call recently received by the police about domestic violence in the Lasseck family gives a completely different impression. As the investigators learn, Thea Lasseck used to suffer from her violent father. Has the former victim now become the perpetrator herself? When it becomes apparent that it was not Thea but Piet who was abused by his wife, everything appears in a different light. Apparently Piet Lasseck wanted to get a divorce and gain sole custody of the children. Did Thea Lasseck, who already makes an unstable impression on the inspectors, put up with this? But Thea Lasseck is not the only suspect: Piet's colleague, the harbor crane operator Heiner Klausen, is said to have had an ongoing argument with him. Allegedly Klausen violated security precautions. So did Klausen kill his colleague because Piet Lasseck threatened his professional existence? / Hafenkranfuhrer Piet Lasseck wird tot aus dem Jachthafen geborgen. Was ist vorgefallen? Seiner Kopfwunde nach zu urteilen, ist der Familienvater erschlagen worden.Lassecks Ehefrau Thea ist schockiert. Sie behauptet, keine Probleme mit ihrem Mann gehabt zu haben. Doch ein vor Kurzem bei der Polizei eingegangener anonymer Notruf wegen hauslicher Gewalt bei Familie Lasseck liefert einen ganz anderen Eindruck.Wie die Ermittler erfahren, litt Thea Lasseck fruher unter ihrem gewalttatigen Vater. Ist das ehemalige Opfer nun selbst zur Taterin geworden? Als sich zeigt, dass jedoch nicht Thea, sondern Piet von seiner Frau misshandelt wurde, erscheint alles in einem anderen Licht. Offenbar wollte Piet Lasseck sich scheiden lassen und das alleinige Sorgerecht fur die Kinder erstreiten. Hatte sich Thea Lasseck, die auf die Kommissare ohnehin einen labilen Eindruck macht, das gefallen lassen?Doch Thea Lasseck bleibt nicht die einzige Verdachtige: Piets Kollege, der Hafenkranfuhrer Heiner Klausen, soll einen andauernden Streit mit ihm gehabt haben. Angeblich hat Klausen gegen Sicherheitsvorkehrungen verstoSSen. Hat also Klausen seinen Kollegen auf dem Gewissen, weil Piet Lasseck seine berufliche Existenz gefahrdete?

programme.title: Die Rosenheim-Cops
programme.sub-title: A surprise for Mohr / Eine Überraschung fur Mohr
programme.desc: Fritz Moser, head of a bird sanctuary, is found strangled. A model airplane leads the cops to Moritz Hamm, the chairman of a model flying club. Hamm and Moser were constantly arguing because the airplanes circling over the forest disturbed the birds' peace. Has the dispute now reached its deadly climax? Biotechnician Thomas Egger, who, much to Moser's displeasure, has achieved a lot, also comes under suspicion. Egger was able to convince Lothar Kreilling, the owner of the KreiTec company, to invest in the reserve on a large scale. Hansen and Hartl can well imagine that an argument arose because Moser saw the birds in danger. As the detectives get closer and closer to the perpetrator, a surprise awaits police officer Michi Mohr at the police station: he is promoted to police chief. / Fritz Moser, Chef eines Vogelschutzreservats, wird erdrosselt aufgefunden. Hat der Streit nun seinen todlichen Hohepunkt erreicht? Unter Verdacht gerat auch Biotechniker Thomas Egger, der, zu Mosers Unmut, viel erreicht hat.Egger konnte Lothar Kreilling, den Inhaber der Firma KreiTec dafur gewinnen, in groSSem Stil in das Reservat zu investieren. Dass es daruber zum Streit kam, weil Moser die Vogel gefahrdet sah, konnen sich Hansen und Hartl gut vorstellen.Wahrend die Kommissare dem Tater immer naher kommen, wartet im Kommissariat auf Polizist Michi Mohr eine Überraschung: Er wird zum Polizeihauptmeister befordert.

programme.desc: A former team member on four paws is causing excitement for the SOKO: Vanessa is bringing back the dog Mata Hari. Can she stay as a temporary office dog? The debate about Mata Hari is suddenly interrupted when Valeria Greco is found dead in her apartment building. According to her friend Benjamin Krei, she was stalked by a Maxim Dowbyk, whom she met through the neighborhood app "Nebendir". Was he her murderer? Maxim denies the allegations, but his behavior raises questions. Shortly before Valeria's death, he got into a heated argument with her that threatened to escalate. At the last moment, Valeria's neighbor Christina Lobricht, who happened to be nearby with her daughter, intervened. Did Maxim follow her home later and murder her there? Or does the trail lead in a completely different direction? Because suddenly Valeria's boyfriend becomes the focus of the investigation: Valeria wanted to separate from Benjamin because he was always jealous. Did he push his girlfriend off the basement stairs out of anger? / Ein ehemaliges Teammitglied auf vier Pfoten sorgt fur Aufregung der SOKO: Vanessa bringt die Hundin Mata Hari zuruck. Im letzten Moment griff Valerias Nachbarin Christina Lobricht ein, die mit ihrer Tochter zufallig in der Nahe war. Ist Maxim ihr spater nachhause gefolgt und er-mordete sie dort? Oder fuhrt die Spur in eine ganz andere Richtung? Denn plotzlich gerat Valerias Freund in den Fokus der Ermittlungen: Valeria wollte sich von Benjamin trennen, da er immer eifersuchtig war. Hat er seine Freundin aus Wut von der Kellertreppe gestoSSen?

programme.title: Die Rosenheim-Cops
programme.desc: Shortly before the opening of a special exhibition in the Rosenheim “Museum der Kunste”, director Dr. Johannes Lechhuber found dead. Inspectors Hansen and Stadler are investigating. The suspect is the director's wife, Sabine Lechhuber, who is said to have become tired of her husband. Did she kill her husband to get his inheritance early? But Lechhuber's deputy Maximilian Metzl also has a motive. Metzl had an affair with his wife. Did the museum director have to die because he wanted to fire Metzl? And what role does Pascal Osterkamp, ​​the curator of the current special exhibition, play? Did he want to cover up crooked business with the murder? Meanwhile, Hansen's cousin Wiebke Diepenbrock is visiting Rosenheim with her best friend Olivia Theis. Olivia, wanting to make her boyfriend jealous, pretends to be Hansen's new girlfriend. / Kurz vor der Eroffnung einer Sonderausstellung im Rosenheimer "Museum der Kunste" wird Direktor Dr. Johannes Lechhuber tot aufgefunden. Die Kommissare Hansen und Stadler ermitteln.Tatverdachtig ist die Ehefrau des Direktors, Sabine Lechhuber, von der es heiSSt, sie sei ihres Mannes uberdrussig geworden. Hat sie ihren Gatten umgebracht, um vorzeitig an sein Erbe zu kommen? Doch auch Lechhubers Stellvertreter Maximilian Metzl hat ein Motiv.Metzl hatte eine Affare mit dessen Ehefrau. Musste der Museumsdirektor sterben, weil er Metzl entlassen wollte? Und welche Rolle spielt Pascal Osterkamp, der Kurator der aktuellen Sonderausstellung? Wollte er mit dem Mord krumme Geschafte vertuschen?Unterdessen ist Hansens Cousine Wiebke Diepenbrock mit ihrer besten Freundin Olivia Theis zu Besuch in Rosenheim. Olivia, die ihren Freund eifersuchtig machen will, gibt vor, Hansens neue Freundin zu sein.

programme.title: DDR genial
programme.desc: Super-strong glass, a ski jumping mat for the summer and a kind of navigation system for space: the documentary shows clever, sometimes bizarre inventions from the GDR, commented on by prominent guests. Take: a state with a shortage economy and clever citizens who come up with something. The result is often amazing ideas for everyday life and research. The documentary remembers these forgotten treasures from another time and tells their story. Whether presenter Wolfgang Lippert, actress Anja Kling, actor Pierre Sanoussi-Bliss, musician Burger Lars Dietrich or boxer Axel Schulz - they all look back on their childhood in the GDR and the inventions that caused a sensation back then: glaziers that were almost indestructible thanks to a chemical process, robust ones Materials that are still used in international aviation today, or the ASTRO 1 star sensor, a GDR innovation that helps you find your way in space. Ski jumping legend Jens WeiSSflog remembers the invention of the ski jumping mat, which made training in the summer possible and helped make the GDR an international winter sports giant. The influencers Olivia Schneider and Tina Goldschmidt also comment on the clever ideas that are almost forgotten today: like the mysterious substance SHP from starch, which was used as a fat substitute and not only saved expensive vegetable oils, but also calories. The film not only tells about extraordinary inventions, but also about attitude: about people who have to deal with the constant shortage and their everyday lives Master improvisation. “Do instead of complaining” is the motto - inventiveness between state mandate, spontaneous idea and pure pragmatism. / Superfestes Glas, eine Skisprungmatte fur den Sommer und eine Art Navi fur den Weltraum: Die Doku zeigt clevere, teils skurrile Erfindungen aus der DDR, kommentiert von prominenten Gasten.Man nehme: Einen Staat mit Mangelwirtschaft und schlaue Burger, die sich etwas einfallen lassen. Heraus kommen oftmals verbluffende Ideen fur Alltag und Forschung. Die Doku erinnert an diese vergessenen Schatze aus einer anderen Zeit und erzahlt ihre Geschichte.Ob Moderator Wolfgang Lippert, Schauspielerin Anja Kling, der Schauspieler Pierre Sanoussi-Bliss, der Musiker Burger Lars Dietrich oder Boxer Axel Schulz - sie alle blicken auf ihre Kindheit in der DDR zuruck und die Erfindungen, die damals Furore gemacht haben: Glaser, die durch ein chemisches Verfahren fast unkaputtbar waren, robuste Stoffe, die heute noch in der internationalen Luftfahrt verwendet werden, oder den Sternsensor ASTRO 1, eine DDR-Innovation, mit der man sich im Weltall zurechtfindet.Skisprunglegende Jens WeiSSflog erinnert sich an die Erfindung der Skisprungmatte, die das Training im Sommer moglich machte und dazu beitrug, die DDR zur internationalen WintersportgroSSe werden zu lassen. Auch die Influencerinnen Olivia Schneider und Tina Goldschmidt kommentieren die cleveren Ideen, die heute fast vergessenen sind: Wie die geheimnisvolle Substanz SHP aus Starke, die als Fettersatz genutzt wurde und nicht nur teure Pflanzenole einsparte, sondern auch Kalorien.Der Film erzahlt aber nicht nur von auSSergewohnlichen Erfindungen, sondern auch von Haltung: Von Menschen, die mit dem standigen Mangel umgehen mussen und ihren Alltag mit Improvisation meistern. "Machen statt meckern" lautet die Devise - Erfindergeist zwischen Staatsauftrag, Spontanidee und purem Pragmatismus.

programme.title: Together, loud and wild: Open Flair Festival / Gemeinsam, laut und wild: Open Flair Festival
programme.desc: For 40 years, over 20,000 fans have been coming to the small town of Eschwege for the Open Flair Festival - which can only take place because the residents work together across all borders. It wasn't always like this: at the beginning, many of the 20,000 residents feared complete chaos. This film shows how and why everything turned out differently and what efforts have to be made every year so that fans and residents can celebrate together. Alexander, festival founder from the very beginning, is considered cool and calm, but goes through many emotional waves: "Nothing, absolutely nothing, about joy and suffering is foreign to me." He started with the idea in 1985 as a young student in the "fringe area" because more and more young people were migrating to metropolitan areas. With the support of the city and district, the circus tent with a bit of cabaret and a few guitars became a non-profit organization and annual open-air festivals. "Instead of dead trousers on the wall, dead trousers came to the Eschweg stage."The cultural orientation of the Open Flair in the more conservative East Hesse has remained the same over the years: anti-fascist, anti-racist, left-wing liberal. But “the specter of insolvency” and the lack of acceptance of the burgers always hung over everything. Then the big offensive into the city. Education at civic meetings, free entry for all pensioners as well as guided tours of the festival grounds for residents of the retirement home. “That was the big breakthrough,” says Alexander. The oldest visitor was registered as 106 years old. Nowadays, ordinary citizens are selling drinks from their living room windows, ordinary people are clearing out their ground floor apartments to run them as bars for the five wild days, or the roofers are clearing out their depot so that vegan doners and vegetable balls can be sizzled there. Gitte, mother of nine children, is now an institution around the festival. Since the last child left the house, she has set up a bar in an empty shop for the festival week, which has long since become the myth “Bei Gitte”. "It hasn't always been easy for me, eight boys and a girl, you have to get them through first," she says and of course knows how to politely but firmly send rock and rollers to the campsite at three in the morning. A week like this with 100 punks and rock fans in their living room bar every day is "child's play" because "they are all so friendly." Mayor Alexander Heppe underlines the "special nature of this event, which means a state of emergency" because it is not on the green meadow outside the city, but "in the middle of the old town with closed streets, four stages, big volume, unusual people and a lot Tolerance of the population takes place". And this has to be worked out anew every year. He knows that the 20,000 visitors from all over Germany "leave a lot of money here that is good for the structurally weak region." That's why he runs "from Pontius to Pilate so that it stays that way and always goes well." The success story that the Open Flair e.V. association fits in with this. V. creates jobs and training positions in the event sector. “But all of this is threatened every year,” because the financing is always on shaky ground. / Über 20.000 Fans kommen seit 40 Jahren in das kleine Stadtchen Eschwege zum Open Flair Festival - das nur stattfinden kann, weil die Einwohner uber alle Grenzen hinweg zusammenarbeiten.Das war nicht immer so: Anfangs befurchteten viele der 20.000 Einwohner das vollige Chaos. Wie und warum alles anders kam und welche Anstrengungen jedes Jahr neu unternommen werden mussen, damit Fans und Einwohner gemeinsam feiern konnen, zeigt dieser Film.Alexander, Festivalgrunder der ersten Stunde, gilt als cool und abgeklart, geht aber durch viele Gefuhlsbader: "Nichts, aber auch gar nichts an Freud und Leid ist mir fremd." Angefangen hat er 1985 mit der Idee als junger Student im "Zonenrandgebiet", weil immer mehr junge Leute abwanderten in die Ballungsgebiete. Aus dem Zirkuszelt mit ein bisschen Kleinkunst und ein paar Klampfen, wurde mit Unterstutzung von Stadt und Kreis ein gemeinnutziger Verein und jahrliche Open-Air-Festivals. "Statt tote Hose an der Mauer kamen die Toten Hosen auf die Eschweger Buhne."Die kulturelle Ausrichtung des Open Flair im eher konservativen Osthessen ist uber all die Jahre gleich geblieben: antifaschistisch, antirassistisch, linksliberal. Über allem schwebte aber "stets das Insolvenz-Gespenst" und die fehlende Akzeptanz der Burger. Dann die groSSe Offensive in die Stadt hinein. Aufklarung in Burgerversammlungen, freier Eintritt fur alle Rentner sowie Fuhrungen und Touren fur die Bewohner des Altersheimes uber das Festivalgelande. "Das war der groSSe Durchbruch", sagt Alexander. Die alteste Besucherin wurde mit 106 Jahren registriert.Inzwischen verkaufen ganz normale Burger Getranke aus ihren Wohnzimmerfenstern, raumen einfache Leute ihre Erdgeschosswohnungen leer, um sie fur die funf wilden Tage als Kneipen zu betreiben oder raumen die Dachdecker ihren Betriebshof frei, damit dort vegane Doner und Gemuseballchen gebrutzelt werden konnen.Gitte, Mutter von neun Kindern, ist mittlerweile eine Institution rund um das Festival. Seit das letzte Kind aus dem Haus ist, hat sie fur die Festivalwoche eine Kneipe in einem leer stehenden Laden eingerichtet, die langst zum Mythos "Bei Gitte" geworden ist. "Ich habe es nicht immer leicht gehabt, acht Jungs und ein Madchen, die musst du erst mal durchbringen", sagt sie und weiSS selbstverstandlich wie man auch RocknRoller nachts um drei hoflich, aber bestimmt auf den Campingplatz schickt. So eine Woche mit taglich 100 Punks und Rockfans in ihrer Wohnzimmer-Kneipe sei "ein Kinderspiel", weil die "alle so freundlich" sind.Burgermeister Alexander Heppe unterstreicht die "Besonderheit dieses Ereignisses, das Ausnahmezustand bedeutet", weil es eben nicht auf der grunen Wiese auSSerhalb der Stadt, sondern "mittendrin in der Altstadt mit abgesperrten StraSSen, vier Buhnen, groSSer Lautstarke, ungewohnlichen Menschen und viel Toleranz der Bevolkerung stattfindet". Und die muss jedes Jahr aufs Neue erarbeitet werden. Dabei weiSS er, dass die 20.000 Besucher aus ganz Deutschland "jede Menge Geld hier lassen, das der strukturschwachen Region guttut". Deshalb rennt auch er "von Pontius zu Pilatus, damit das so bleibt und immer gut geht". Dazu passt die Erfolgsgeschichte, dass der Verein Open Flair e. V. Arbeits- und Ausbildungsplatze im Veranstaltungsbereich schafft. "Das alles ist aber jedes Jahr aufs neue bedroht", weil die Finanzierung immer auf tonernen FuSSen steht.

programme.title: The Chelsea Detective
programme.desc: A gallery manager is found murdered after an opening in Chelsea. The team led by Detective Inspector Max Arnold investigates the victim's professional and private environment. The valuable painting "In the Blue Room" was stolen from the exhibition rooms. Insurance fraud does not seem to be ruled out. The police take a close look at gallery owner Rebekah Chaban and her husband Benoit. The gallery manager Chris Milton-Elwes (Samuel Holmes) is found dead in the exhibition room after a vernissage. He was apparently strangled. DI Max Arnold (Adrian Scarborough) begins the investigation with his new colleague DS Layla Walsh (Vanessa Emme). It turns out that the back door of the gallery was broken into. Four pictures from the exhibition of works by East German artists were stolen, including "In the Blue Room" by Friedrich Gustav. This painting alone is worth £1.3 million.Police officers saw a man leaving the crime scene shortly after the murder. He is Benoit (Felicien Juttner), the husband of gallery owner Rebekah Chaban (Rachael Stirling). This raises many questions: Was the victim himself possibly the robber, and did Benoit catch him in the act? Or did the two even work together? Max is suspicious that the insurance sum for “In the Blue Room” is more than twice the purchase price. But Rebekah emphasizes emphatically that she and Benoit had enough money and therefore did not have to rely on fraud. Meanwhile, the police become aware of a man who is said to have behaved strangely at the opening. Rebekah identifies him as her personal fitness trainer, Toby Hansard (Jack Ashton). Former police officer Roy Colin (Kevin Eldon) also makes a dubious impression. He works for the Chabans as a driver and security officer. Layla has a shared past with him that she doesn't have good memories of. Four episodes of "The Chelsea Detective" are repeated on Tuesday nights. / Ein Galeriemanager wird nach einer Vernissage in Chelsea ermordet aufgefunden. Das Team um Detective Inspector Max Arnold ermittelt im beruflichen und privaten Umfeld des Opfers.Aus den Ausstellungsraumen ist das wertvolle Gemalde "Im blauen Zimmer" gestohlen worden. Ein Versicherungsbetrug scheint nicht ausgeschlossen. Die Polizisten nehmen Galeriebesitzerin Rebekah Chaban und deren Mann Benoit genauestens unter die Lupe.Der Galeriemanager Chris Milton-Elwes (Samuel Holmes) wird nach einer Vernissage tot im Ausstellungsraum aufgefunden. Er wurde offenbar erwurgt. DI Max Arnold (Adrian Scarborough) nimmt mit seiner neuen Kollegin DS Layla Walsh (Vanessa Emme) die Ermittlungen auf. Es stellt sich heraus, dass die Hintertur der Galerie aufgebrochen wurde.Vier Bilder aus der Ausstellung mit Werken ostdeutscher Kunstler wurden gestohlen, darunter "Im blauen Zimmer" von Friedrich Gustav. Allein dieses Gemalde ist 1,3 Millionen Pfund wert.Polizisten haben gesehen, wie ein Mann kurz nach dem Mord den Tatort verlieSS. Bei ihm handelt es sich um Benoit (Felicien Juttner), den Ehemann der Galeriebesitzerin Rebekah Chaban (Rachael Stirling). Das wirft viele Fragen auf: War das Todesopfer womoglich selbst der Rauber, und hat Benoit ihn auf frischer Tat ertappt? Oder haben die beiden gar gemeinsame Sache gemacht?Max kommt es verdachtig vor, dass die Versicherungssumme fur "Im blauen Zimmer" mehr als das Doppelte des Kaufpreises betragt. Doch Rebekah betont mit Nachdruck, dass sie und Benoit genug Geld hatten und daher nicht auf Betrug angewiesen seien.Unterdessen werden die Polizisten auf einen Mann aufmerksam, der sich bei der Vernissage seltsam verhalten haben soll. Rebekah identifiziert ihn als ihren personlichen Fitnesstrainer Toby Hansard (Jack Ashton). Auch der ehemalige Polizist Roy Colin (Kevin Eldon) macht einen dubiosen Eindruck. Er arbeitet fur die Chabans als Fahrer und Sicherheitsbeauftragter. Layla verbindet eine gemeinsame Vergangenheit mit ihm, an die sie keine guten Erinnerungen hat.Vier Folgen "The Chelsea Detective" werden dienstagnachts wiederholt.

programme.title: Around the world in 80 days / In 80 Tagen um die Welt
programme.desc: In 1872, the British eccentric Phileas Fogg bets against his old friend Bellamy that, given new modern means of transport, he could circumnavigate the earth in 80 days. He got the idea from a newspaper article. It says that it is theoretically possible to circumnavigate the world in 80 days. Fogg is spurred on by a mysterious postcard whose message consists of just one word: "Coward". This postcard is the trigger for Phileas Fogg (David Tennant) to make the daring bet: Given new global transport routes, he wants to manage to circumnavigate the world in under 80 days and be back in time for Christmas. 20,000 pounds - which corresponds to a today's value of over 250,000 euros - are at stake. And Fogg knows that he is expecting a lot with the bet: The wealthy English gentleman prefers to spend his free time in the London Reform Club, an upper-class salon frozen in formality, where old companions meet to chat about world events they read in their newspapers. A comfort zone for snobbish couch potatoes - of course women are not welcome here. The bachelor's longest journey with lofty dreams and nagging self-doubt has only taken him to a wedding in Edinburgh. Even the preparations for the trip are difficult: Fogg's servant Grayson (Richard Wilson) is too old and too frail to accompany him on this journey into the unknown. Therefore, let Fogg request suitable candidates from an agency. When Jean Passepartout (Ibrahim Koma), a waiter at the Reform Club and a restless bon vivant, finds out about Fogg's request, he follows Fogg and introduces himself as the chosen servant. Packing takes place in no time and the journey begins shortly afterwards. First stop: by boat to France with the destination Paris. Also on the ship is Abigail Fix (Leonie Benesch), a young, ambitious journalist who smells the story of her life and has decided to follow Fogg and Passepartout's heels. What's piquant: Abigail is the daughter of Fogg's good friend Bernard Fortescue (Jason Watkins), the publisher of the Daily Telegraph. Abigail took her mother's maiden name in order to become an author and step out of the shadow of her father, who viewed her participation in the trip with a worried eye, but gave her a regular column in his newspaper. From the start the trip goes differently than planned. In Paris, Passepartout meets his brother, who wants to avenge the destruction of the Paris Commune in 1871 and, together with a handful of co-conspirators, is in the process of carrying out an assassination attempt on the French president. It is Phileas Fogg who foils this assassination attempt by chance. As the city descends into chaos, Fogg, Passepartout and Abigail Fix are cornered by the police. Will they manage to escape and continue their race against time?Eight episodes of “Around the World in 80 Days” will be repeated on Tuesday nights. / Im Jahr 1872 wettet der britische Exzentriker Phileas Fogg gegen seinen alten Freund Bellamy, dass er angesichts neuer moderner Verkehrsmittel die Erde in 80 Tagen umrunden konne.Die Idee hat er aus einem Zeitungsartikel. Darin steht, dass es theoretisch moglich sei, die Welt in 80 Tagen zu umrunden. Angestachelt wird Fogg von einer ratselhaften Postkarte, deren Botschaft nur aus einem Wort besteht: "Feigling".Diese Postkarte ist fur Phileas Fogg (David Tennant) der Ausloser, die wagemutige Wette einzugehen: Angesichts neuer globaler Verkehrswege will er es schaffen, die Welt in unter 80 Tagen zu umrunden und punktlich zu Weihnachten zuruck zu sein. 20 000 Pfund - die immerhin einem heutigen Wert von uber 250 000 Euro entsprechen - stehen auf dem Spiel.Und Fogg weiSS, dass er sich mit der Wette viel zumutet: Denn der wohlhabende englische Gentleman verbringt seine Freizeit vorzugsweise im Londoner Reform-Klub, einem in Formlichkeit erstarrten Upperclass-Salon, wo sich alte Weggefahrten treffen, um uber das Weltgeschehen zu palavern, von dem sie in ihren Zeitungen gelesen haben. Eine Komfortzone fur snobistische Couch Potatoes - naturlich sind Frauen hier unerwunscht. Seine weiteste Reise fuhrte den Junggesellen mit hochfliegenden Traumen und nagenden Selbstzweifeln bisher nur zu einer Hochzeit nach Edinburgh.Schon die Reisevorbereitungen gestalten sich schwierig: Foggs Diener Grayson (Richard Wilson) ist zu alt und zu gebrechlich, um ihn auf dieser Reise ins Ungewisse zu begleiten. Deshalb lasst Fogg bei einer Agentur geeignete Kandidaten anfragen. Als Jean Passepartout (Ibrahim Koma), seines Zeichens Kellner im Reform-Klub und unsteter Lebemann, von Foggs Gesuch erfahrt, folgt er Fogg und stellt sich als auserwahlter Diener vor. In Windeseile wird gepackt und schon kurz darauf beginnt die Reise. Erste Station: per Fahre nach Frankreich mit dem Ziel Paris.Auf dem Schiff befindet sich auch Abigail Fix (Leonie Benesch), eine junge, ehrgeizige Journalistin, die die Story ihres Lebens wittert und beschlossen hat, sich an die Fersen Foggs und Passepartouts zu heften. Pikant daran: Abigail ist die Tochter von Foggs gutem Freund Bernard Fortescue (Jason Watkins), dem Verleger des Daily Telegraph.Abigail hat den Madchennamen ihrer Mutter angenommen, um als Autorin aus dem Schatten ihres Vaters zu treten, der ihre Teilnahme an der Reise mit sorgenvollem Blick betrachtet, ihr jedoch eine regelmaSSige Kolumne in seiner Zeitung eingeraumt hat.Von Anfang an verlauft die Reise anders als geplant. In Paris trifft Passepartout auf seinen Bruder, der die Zerschlagung der Pariser Kommune von 1871 rachen will und dabei ist, gemeinsam mit einer Handvoll Mitverschworern, ein Attentat auf den franzosischen Prasidenten zu veruben. Es ist Phileas Fogg, der dieses Attentat per Zufall vereitelt. Als die Stadt im Chaos versinkt, werden auch Fogg, Passepartout und Abigail Fix von der Polizei in die Enge getrieben. Wird es ihnen gelingen zu entkommen und ihren Wettlauf gegen die Zeit fortzusetzen?Acht Folgen "In 80 Tagen um die Welt" werden dienstagsnachts wiederholt.

programme.title: Greenwashed? Nutella: Ferrero's green fairy tale / Greenwashed? Nutella: Das grune Marchen von Ferrero
programme.desc: Cocoa, palmol, supply chain - the chocolate industry does not have a good reputation. Ferrero, the inventor of Nutella, promises sustainability. Are they serious? Or is that greenwashing? Cocoa from Africa, palm oil from Asia, nuts from Turkey - that smacks of problems. Ferrero responds to these with sustainability promises. Environmental reporter Sherif wants to know exactly this - and follows the Nutella supply chain. What once began in Michele Ferrero's pastry shop in the tranquil northern Italian town of Alba has now grown into a global chocolate empire. With brands such as Nutella, Ferrero Rocher and Kinder Chocolate, Ferrero has become an integral part of every confectionery shelf in the world. For the procurement of raw materials, in particular cocoa, palm oil and hazelnuts, the company has defined its own sustainability charter, which is intended to ensure a responsible supply chain: no clearing of forests, no children on plantations, compensation areas to protect the Environment. In short: sustainable, social and fair. Ferrero calls this “putting people at the heart of our supply chain.” This is where environmental reporter Sherif Rizkallah comes into play. He sets off to the same "people" at the starting point of the supply chain to see whether Ferrero will comply: to an agricultural cooperative in the Ivory Coast that grows cocoa for Ferrero. To an oil mill in Malaysia that supplies Ferrero with RSPO-certified palm oil. And to Italy. Ferrero is significantly expanding its hazelnut production there. Turkey is the world's main producer of hazelnuts, including for Ferrero. But there are repeated reports of exploitation on plantations on the Turkish Black Sea coast. Ferrero is now increasingly relying on local cultivation in Italy. Local cultivation, that is. Sherif thinks that's good - but he wonders why the residents around Lago di Vico haven't wanted to swim in this beautiful lake in the middle of the hazelnut plantations for some time now. Ultimately, Sherif wants to answer the question of how much sustainability is really in his Nutella? / Kakao, Palmol, Lieferkette - die Schokobranche hat keinen guten Ruf. Ferrero, der Erfinder von Nutella, verspricht Nachhaltigkeit. Meinen die das ernst? Oder ist das Greenwashing?Kakao aus Afrika, Palmol aus Asien, Nusse aus der Turkei - das schmeckt nach Problemen. Denen begegnet Ferrero mit Nachhaltigkeitsversprechen. Das will Umweltreporter Sherif genau wissen - und folgt der Lieferkette von Nutella.Was einst in der Konditorei von Michele Ferrero im beschaulichen norditalienischen Stadtchen Alba begann, ist heute zu einem globalen Schoko-Imperium herangewachsen. Mit Marken wie Nutella, Ferrero Rocher und Kinder Schokolade ist Ferrero aus keinem SuSSwarenregal der Welt mehr wegzudenken.Fur die Beschaffung der Rohstoffe, insbesondere Kakao, Palmol und Haselnusse hat das Unternehmen jeweils eine eigene Nachhaltigkeitscharta definiert, die eine verantwortungsvolle Lieferkette gewahrleisten soll: keine Walder roden, keine Kinder auf Plantagen, Ausgleichsflachen zum Schutz der Umwelt. Kurzum: nachhaltig, sozial und fair. Ferrero nennt das "putting people at the heart of our supply chain".An dieser Stelle kommt Umwelt-Reporter Sherif Rizkallah ins Spiel. Er bricht auf zu eben diesen "People" am Ausgangspunkt der Lieferkette, um zu sehen, ob Ferrero das einhalt: zu einer Landwirtschaftskooperative in der Elfenbeinkuste, die Kakao fur Ferrero anbaut. Zu einer Ölmuhle in Malaysia, die Ferrero mit RSPO-zertifiziertem Palmol beliefert.Und nach Italien. Denn dort baut Ferrero seine Haselnussproduktion stark aus. Zwar ist die Turkei weltweit Hauptproduzent von Haselnussen, auch fur Ferrero. Doch immer wieder gibt es Berichte uber Ausbeutung auf Plantagen an der turkischen Schwarzmeerkuste. Ferrero setzt jetzt vermehrt auf lokalen Anbau in Italien.Lokaler Anbau also. Das findet Sherif gut - fragt sich allerdings, warum die Einwohner um den Lago di Vico seit einiger Zeit in diesem schonen See inmitten der Haselnussplantagen nicht mehr baden wollen.Schlussendlich will Sherif die Frage beantworten, wie viel Nachhaltigkeit denn nun wirklich in seiner Nutella steckt?

programme.title: Igram svoju igru
programme.desc: The series intended for our youngest population is conceived to popularize and propagate a healthy lifestyle through sports and proper nutrition. Episodes intended for children engaged in sports, irrelevant at which success level, will show the essential advantages that provide sports and proper nutrition. We are of the opinion that in Montenegro has many talented children who do not have adequate conditions for the development of their talent. The series would be a modest initiator to raise the current situation on a bar for one step higher level. We want to draw attention to the potential belonging to us, which is indisputable, the potential that deserves much more. / Serijal namijenjen našoj najmlađoj populaciji koncipiran je da popularizuje i propagira zdrav način života kroz sport i pravilnu ishranu. Epizode namijenjene djeci koje se bave sportom, nebitno na kom nivou uspjeha, prikazaće suštinske prednosti koje pružaju sport i pravilna ishrana. Mišljenja smo da u Crnoj Gori ima mnogo talentovane djece koja nemaju adekvatne uslove za razvoj njihovog talenta. Serijal bi bio skroman inicijator da se trenutna situacija podigne na bar za jednu stepenicu veći nivo. Želimo da skrenemo pažnju na potencijal koji pripada samo nama, koji je neosporan, potencijal koji zaslužuje mnogo više.

programme.desc: World War II, a small island of Mamula in the Adriatic Sea serves as a prison for political prisoners. After the capitulation of Italy, the control of the prisoners took over the Germans who give them the task of dismantling mine. The tractor of hope occurs after the release of the first prisoners. / Drugi svjetski rat, malo ostrvo Mamula u Jadranskom moru služi kao zatvor za političke zatvorenike. programme.title: Pod naponom
programme.desc: Montenegro is under voltage every day, between humor and seriousness, between reality and satire, music and story. That's why the show comes that rhythm. programme.desc: Eurocup was created in 2002. as a second competition "Euroleague Basketball". programme.title: Muzika

Como muitas crianças de cinco anos, Alice gosta muito de falar e de se expressar. Quer sempre contar o que aconteceu no seu dia, o que aprendeu, as ideias que teve e as suas opiniões sobre tudo!

programme.title: As Ferias do Menino Nicolau
programme.desc: Join Nicolau and his happy group on their vacation, as they build sand castles, explore new playgrounds and go treasure hunting! programme.title: Radar XS
programme.desc: Radar XS is a news program for children aged 8 to 12 that aims to encourage critical thinking and conscious citizenship. We will bring together politics and culture, economics and sport, science and children's literature, national and international current affairs in a simple and objective language. / Radar XS e um telejornal para crianças dos 8 aos 12 anos onde se pretende incentivar o pensamento crítico e a cidadania consciente. Vamos juntar a política e a cultura, a economia e desporto, a ciencia e a literatura infantil, a atualidade nacional e internacional numa linguagem simples e objetiva.

programme.title: Good Morning Portugal Weekend / Bom Dia Portugal Fim de Semana
programme.desc: A space where current national and international news, sports, weather, traffic and economics are highlighted during your weekend mornings. / Espaço em que se dá relevo às notícias da atualidade nacional e internacional, desporto, meteorologia, trânsito e economia nas manhas do seu fim de semana.

programme.title: Eucaristia Dominical
programme.sub-title: Porto XXVIII Domingo do Tempo Comum
programme.desc: The Sunday celebration of the Lord's Day and the Eucharist is at the center of the life of the Catholic Church. / A celebraçao dominical do Dia e da Eucaristia do Senhor está no centro da vida da Igreja Catolica.

programme.title: To Peninsula / A Península
programme.desc: The mountains define the morphology of the Iberian Peninsula and are the cradle of the rivers that distribute life throughout the territory. The mountains are also the location of several forests, each with its own distinct ecosystem. The Iberian mountain ranges have different facets and their own personalities. / As montanhas definem a morfologia da Península Iberica e sao o berço dos rios que distribuem a vida pelo territorio. As montanhas sao tambem o local de várias florestas, cada uma com o seu ecossistema distinto. As cadeias montanhosas ibericas tem facetas diferentes e personalidades proprias.

programme.title: Fauna Iberica
programme.desc: Climate change is a reality and is seriously affecting the environment. Fauna is subject to a series of changes that can sometimes be overcome by habitat changes. Migrating to colder areas or changing your activity rhythms. / A mudança climática e uma realidade e está a afetar seriamente o meio ambiente. A fauna está sujeita a uma serie de mudanças que às vezes podem ser superadas pela mudança de habitat. Migrando para áreas mais frias ou mudando seus ritmos de atividade.

programme.title: Jornal da Tarde
programme.desc: Every day, at 1pm, your lunch hour is completed with updates on national and global news, from politics, economics, society and not forgetting sport. With Jornal da Tarde, be well informed about what is happening in the country and the world! / Todos os dias, às 13h, a sua hora de almoço e completada com a atualizaçao das notícias que marcam a atualidade nacional e mundial, desde a política, a economia, a sociedade e sem esquecer o desporto. Com o Jornal da Tarde, esteja bem informado sobre o que acontece no país e no mundo!

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Lost Temple / Indiana Jones e o Templo Perdido
programme.desc: Accompanied by the singer “Willie” and little Short Round, Indiana Jones tries to recover a sacred stone and save hundreds of children who are enslaved by a violent and mysterious cult in India. / Acompanhado pela cantora “Willie” e pelo pequeno Short Round, Indiana Jones tenta recuperar uma pedra sagrada e salvar centenas de crianças que se encontram escravizadas por um violento e misterioso culto na Índia.

programme.title: Domingo Há Desgarrada
programme.desc: "Domingo Há Desgarrada" will highlight the songs: whether Minhotos, Alentejanos or Beirões and also prove that Cantares ao Desafio are present around the world. We will have mentors who bring pairs to compete and we will choose the best singers from afar. / "Domingo Há Desgarrada" vai dar destaque aos cantares: quer seja Minhotos, Alentejanos ou Beirões e ainda provar que os Cantares ao Desafio estao presentes pelo mundo. Teremos mentores que trazem duplas para competir e vamos eleger os melhores cantadores à desgarrada.

programme.title: Local Elections 2025 - Election Night / Eleições Autárquicas 2025 - Noite Eleitoral
programme.desc: The Portuguese went to votes to choose mayors for the next four years. Follow the special broadcast conducted by Jose Rodrigues dos Santos, Ana Lourenço, Joao Adelino Faria and Carlos Daniel and learn about all the details that mark the election night. / Os portugueses foram a votos para escolher os autarcas para os proximos quatro anos. Acompanhe a emissao especial conduzida por Jose Rodrigues dos Santos, Ana Lourenço, Joao Adelino Faria e Carlos Daniel e conheça todos os pormenores que marcam a noite eleitoral.

If it's important, it's on Telejornal. / A mais rigorosa seleçao de notícias, todos os dias às 20h00. programme.title: Procissao das Velas
programme.desc: After the blessing of the candles in the Chapel of Apparitions and the recitation of the Rosary, the Procession of Candles begins between the Chapel and the Sanctuary. It is a small route taken by the Virgin of Fátima accompanied by thousands of pilgrims holding lit candles and singing songs of praise. / Apos a bençao das velas na Capelinha das Aparições e da recitaçao do Rosário, inicia-se a Procissao das Velas entre a Capelinha e o Santuário. Trata-se de um pequeno percurso efetuado pela Virgem de Fátima acompanhada por milhares de peregrinos segurando velas acesas e entoando cânticos de louvor.

programme.title: Eurodeputados

programme.title: Contagem Decrescente para Caçar
programme.desc: From leopards and wolves to sharks and snakes, witness the brutal power and tenacity of nature's most extraordinary predators on a journey through Australia, Africa, North America and South America. / De leopardos e lobos a tubarões e cobras, testemunhe o poder brutal e a tenacidade dos predadores mais extraordinários da natureza numa jornada pela Austrália, África, America do Norte e America do Sul.

programme.title: Filhas do Fogo
programme.desc: Basque Country, 1609. After judge Pierre de Lancre burns a wise woman on suspicion of witchcraft, her three daughters are threatened with suspicion, misogyny and religious fanaticism. / País Basco, 1609. programme.title: Sergio Varella Cid - A Prodigy on a Razor's Edge / Sergio Varella Cid - Um Prodígio no Fio da Navalha
programme.desc: Sergio Varella Cid, a piano prodigy since he was 3 years old, was compared to Mozart. At 15, he moved to London, facing challenges and opportunities. With talent and a taste for risk, he became one of the greatest international pianists. / Sergio Varella Cid, prodígio do piano desde os 3 anos, foi comparado a Mozart. Aos 15, mudou-se para Londres, enfrentando desafios e oportunidades. Com talento e gosto pelo risco, tornou-se um dos maiores pianistas internacionais.

programme.title: Sacavem
programme.desc: It is not the routine documentary about an artist, in this case the filmmaker Pedro Costa, nor is it a balanced view of his work. Among other merits, "Sacavem" dialogues with this greatest figure in contemporary cinema without resorting to the usual guarantees. / Nao e o rotineiro documentário sobre um artista, neste caso o cineasta Pedro Costa, nem tao pouco uma visao equilibrada da sua obra. Entre outros meritos, "Sacavem" dialoga com essa figura maior do cinema contemporâneo sem recorrer às habituais cauções.

programme.title: Outra Goa
programme.desc: The social atmosphere is captured, in interviews with the generations that lived through Portuguese colonialism and the transition to the Indian nation and those that live in post-colonial Goa, whose rhythms we will follow and whose forms of sociability we will record. / A atmosfera social e captada, em entrevistas com as gerações que viveram o colonialismo portugues e a transiçao para a naçao indiana e as que vivem a Goa pos-colonial, cujos ritmos acompanharemos e cujas formas de sociabilidade registaremos.

programme.title: ABC Direito
programme.desc: Public service program, which functions as a manual on the laws of life. Through an original, artistic and informative format, each episode aims to inform citizens about their rights and responsibilities under Portuguese law. / Programa de serviço público, que funciona como um manual de leis da vida. Atraves de um formato original, artístico e informativo, cada episodio tem como objetivo informar os cidadaos sobre os seus direitos e responsabilidades ao abrigo da lei portuguesa.

programme.title: Biosfera
programme.sub-title: On the Wildlife Trafficking Route / Na Rota do Tráfico de Vida Selvagem
programme.desc: The island of Porto Santo is a candidate for UNESCO biosphere reserve, an award that emphasizes, above all, the harmony of the relationship between Man and his activities and the surrounding environment. / A ilha do Porto Santo e candidata a reserva da biosfera da UNESCO, galardao que enfatiza, sobretudo a harmonia da relaçao entre o Homem e as suas atividades e o meio envolvente.

programme.title: Come Rain Come Sunshine / Faça Chuva Faça Sol
programme.desc: In the 1960s and 1970s Portugal was self-sufficient in hop production, today it only produces around 5% of its needs. Discover this raw material that is responsible for the bitter taste of traditional beer. The hop flower grows in the lands of Bragança and Braga. / Na decada de 1960 e 1970 Portugal era autossuficiente na produçao de lúpulo, hoje produz apenas cerca de 5% das suas necessidades. Conheça esta materia-prima que e responsável pelo travo amargo da cerveja tradicional. A flor de lúpulo cresce nas terras de Bragança e Braga.

programme.title: Calm Waters / Águas Calmas
programme.sub-title: Hungary - The Balaton / Hungria - O Balaton
programme.desc: In southeastern Finland, close to the border with Russia, lies Lake Saimaa, the fourth largest in Europe and a vital part of the Karelian ecosystem. This beautiful freshwater system is home to the rare freshwater seal. / No sudeste da Finlândia, junto à fronteira com a Rússia, encontra-se o lago Saimaa, o quarto maior da Europa e parte vital do ecossistema da Carelia. Este belo sistema de águas doces alberga a rara foca-de-água doce.

Em cada episodio, a equipa de resgate da vila salva alguns dos habitantes.

programme.desc: The Lemmings scribble all over the “Snow White” book on the living room sofa. programme.title: Betclic Basketball League 2025-26 - Sporting CP x Benfica / Liga de Basquetebol Betclic 2025-26 - Sporting CP x Benfica

programme.title: Caminhos
programme.desc: Weekly informative program dedicated to the activities of the different Churches represented in Portugal. programme.title: 70x7
programme.desc: Weekly update of activities and topics related to the Catholic Church. In each episode, it presents a report that looks for signs of the religious in the human person. We seek to expand initiatives that contribute to a quality life and counteract what does not dignify the human person. / Atualizaçao semanal das atividades e assuntos relacionados com a igreja catolica. Em cada episodio, apresenta uma reportagem que procura sinais do religioso na pessoa humana. Procura-se ampliar iniciativas que contribuem para uma vida com qualidade e contrariar o que nao dignifica a pessoa humana.

programme.title: Ecuador: A University in the Heart of the Amazon / Equador : Uma Universidade no Coraçao da Amazonia
programme.desc: At a time when two hectares of Amazon rainforest are being devastated every minute, Ecuador is betting on the knowledge economy to exploit its natural resources. / Numa altura em que dois hectares de floresta amazonica estao a ser devastados a cada minuto, o Equador aposta na economia do conhecimento para explorar os seus recursos naturais.

programme.title: Temos Programa
programme.desc: We have a program and a TV poster dedicated only to RTP2's programming, in other words, we're really going to turn the heat on our sardines. It is broadcast every Sunday at 7pm and we will go on a journey from Monday to Sunday highlighting the programs we want viewers not to miss. / Temos programa e um cartaz TV dedicado apenas à programaçao da RTP2, ou seja, vamos mesmo puxar a brasa à nossa sardinha. É emitido todos os domingos pelas 19.00 e faremos uma viagem de segunda a domingo destacando os programas que queremos que os telespectadores nao percam.

programme.title: Sex Symbols
programme.desc: Four friends entering pre-adolescence begin to have their first doubts about their physical changes and their sexuality. Together with them, young people will learn about sexual and emotional education through animation and entertainment. / Quatro amigos a entrar na pre-adolescencia começam a ter as primeiras dúvidas sobre as suas mudanças físicas e a sua sexualidade. Junto com eles, os jovens aprenderao sobre educaçao sexual e emocional atraves de animaçao e entretenimento.

programme.title: Olhares - Afrodescendentes no Portugal Contemporâneo
programme.sub-title: Afro-descent (What does it mean to be Afro-descendant?) / Afrodescendencia (O que e Ser Afrodescendente?)
programme.desc: This episode asks different people of African descent, of different ages, from different cultural backgrounds and of both genders, what the role of African descent means and how they live it. / Este episodio indaga junto de diferentes afrodescendentes, de diferentes idades, de diferentes meios culturais e de ambos generos, o que significa e como vivem na pele o papel de afrodescendente.

programme.title: Selvas do Mundo
programme.desc: The most incredible forests and jungles in the world in a 26-episode documentary series. A trip around the world to discover the abundant biodiversity that the last great forests and jungles on the planet are home to: from the strangest inhabitants to the most beautiful and unexplored regions. / As florestas e selvas mais incríveis do mundo numa serie documental de 26 episodios. Uma viagem à volta do mundo à descoberta da abundante biodiversidade que as últimas grandes florestas e selvas do planeta albergam: desde os habitantes mais estranhos ate às regiões mais belas e inexploradas.

programme.title: Room Sheet / Folha de Sala
programme.desc: A cultural agenda that highlights theater, music and other shows, not forgetting the launch of books and records, cinema and other events, such as exhibitions, open-air shows and conferences. Text and voiceover by Manuela Silva Reis. / Uma agenda cultural que destaca espectáculos de teatro, música e outros, nao esquecendo o lançamento de livros e discos, o cinema e ainda a realizaçao de outros eventos, como exposições, espectáculos ao ar livre, conferencias. Texto e locuçao de Manuela Silva Reis.

programme.title: I'll Give You All This / Dar-te-ei Tudo Isto
programme.desc: Manuel, a famous Parisian writer, discovers that Aymeric, her husband, has just died in a car accident near Aix-en-Provence. / Manuel, um famoso escritor parisiense, descobre que Aymeric, o seu marido, acaba de falecer num acidente de carro perto de Aix-en-Provence.

programme.title: Newspaper 2 / Jornal 2
programme.desc: The world in 30 minutes. In Jornal 2 we analyze facts and cross-reference opinions. With each passing day we read the country and the world with data, explanations and interpretations in the most diverse areas, such as Politics, Science, Economy and Culture. / O mundo em 30 minutos. No Jornal 2 analisamos factos e cruzamos opiniões. A cada dia que passa fazemos leitura do país e do mundo com dados, explicações e interpretações nas mais diversas áreas, como Política, Ciencia, Economia e Cultura.

programme.title: Kafka
programme.desc: The first episode is about Kafka's friend, Max Brod. He is a renowned writer, full of energy and ideas, but his biggest project is achieving fame for his friend Franz. / O primeiro episodio e sobre o amigo de Kafka, Max Brod. Ele e um escritor reconhecido, cheio de energia e ideias, mas o seu maior projeto e alcançar a fama para o seu amigo Franz.

programme.title: Jakub Jozef Orlinski: Facce dAmore
programme.desc: "Facce dAmore" is the second solo album by Polish countertenor Jakub Jozef Orlinski. All the songs tell a story, which illustrates the male figure of the Baroque period, not only the positive aspect such as the pleasure of mutual love, but also anger and even madness. / "Facce dAmore" e o segundo álbum a solo do contratenor polaco Jakub Jozef Orlinski. Todas as canções contam uma historia, que ilustra a figura masculina da epoca barroca, nao apenas o aspeto positivo como o prazer do amor mútuo, mas tambem a raiva e ate a loucura.

programme.title: Voz do Cidadao
programme.desc: Program under the responsibility of the Viewer's Ombudsman, being shown regularly across all channels of the Public Television Service, reflects the treatment of the most significant cases brought to the attention of the Provider by viewers each week. / Programa da responsabilidade do Provedor do Telespectador, sendo exibido regularmente atraves de todos os canais do Serviço Público de Televisao, reflete o tratamento dos casos mais significativos trazidos à apreciaçao do Provedor pelos telespetadores em cada semana.

programme.title: Capitalismo Americano: O Culto da Riqueza
programme.desc: At the end of the 19th century, a club of millionaires - John D. Rockefeller and his oil monopoly, the steel king and philanthropist Andrew Carnegie or the banker J. P. Morgan who, from Wall Street, financed the industrial revolution - emerged from America. / No final do seculo XIX, um clube de milionários - John D. Rockefeller e o seu monopolio petrolífero, o rei do aço e filantropo Andrew Carnegie ou o banqueiro J. P. Morgan que, a partir de Wall Street, financiou a revoluçao industrial - emergiu da America.

programme.title: Cinemax
programme.desc: Cinemax is a program dedicated to the universe of short films and the relevance of this format in discovering new talents and valuing classic authors. Cinemax guarantees the regular screening of short films, complemented by brief interviews that introduce their authors. / Cinemax e um programa dedicado ao universo da curta-metragem e à relevância deste formato na descoberta de novos talentos e valorizaçao de autores clássicos. O Cinemax garante a exibiçao regular de curtas-metragens, complementada por breves entrevistas que apresentam os seus autores.

programme.title: Insolaçao Mortal
programme.desc: Ted and Amanda's intense work finally shows results and Jong Min's remains are found in the river. Amanda is convinced that there is a connection between this death and that of her friend Lars. / O intenso trabalho de Ted e Amanda finalmente mostra resultados e sao encontrados no rio os restos mortais de Jong Min. Amanda está convencida de que há uma ligaçao entre esta morte e a do seu amigo Lars.

programme.title: Sergio Varella Cid - A Prodigy on a Razor's Edge / Sergio Varella Cid - Um Prodígio no Fio da Navalha
programme.desc: Sergio Varella Cid, a piano prodigy since he was 3 years old, was compared to Mozart. At 15, he moved to London, facing challenges and opportunities. With talent and a taste for risk, he became one of the greatest international pianists. / Sergio Varella Cid, prodígio do piano desde os 3 anos, foi comparado a Mozart. Aos 15, mudou-se para Londres, enfrentando desafios e oportunidades. Com talento e gosto pelo risco, tornou-se um dos maiores pianistas internacionais.

programme.title: Outra Goa
programme.desc: The social atmosphere is captured, in interviews with the generations that lived through Portuguese colonialism and the transition to the Indian nation and those that live in post-colonial Goa, whose rhythms we will follow and whose forms of sociability we will record. / A atmosfera social e captada, em entrevistas com as gerações que viveram o colonialismo portugues e a transiçao para a naçao indiana e as que vivem a Goa pos-colonial, cujos ritmos acompanharemos e cujas formas de sociabilidade registaremos.

programme.title: On the Edge of the Deep Sea / À Beira do Mar Profundo
programme.desc: During the month of July 2018, the Madeira Oceanic Observatory carried out another scientific expedition, this time to explore the deep and unknown areas adjacent to Madeira Island. / Durante o mes de Julho de 2018, o Observatorio Oceânico da Madeira levou a cabo mais uma expediçao científica, desta vez para explorar as zonas profundas e desconhecidas adjacentes à Ilha da Madeira.

programme.title: ABC Direito
programme.desc: Public service program, which functions as a manual on the laws of life. Atraves de um formato original, artístico e informativo, cada episodio tem como objetivo informar os cidadaos sobre os seus direitos e responsabilidades ao abrigo da lei portuguesa.

programme.title: Sea of ​​Letters / Mar de Letras
programme.desc: His name is Eugenio Costa Almeida, but when it comes to signing his poetic work, he returns to his origins and signs as Lobitino Almeida Ngola, a literary pseudonym that derives from the land where he was born: Lobito. "Mazuí - poems, stories and other words" is his first poetic work. / Chama-se Eugenio Costa Almeida mas na hora de assinar a sua obra poetica regressa às origens e assina como Lobitino Almeida Ngola, um pseudonimo literário que deriva da terra que o viu nasceu: o Lobito. "Mazuí - poesias, contos e outras palavras" e a sua primeira obra poetica.

It is broadcast every Sunday at 7pm and we will go on a journey from Monday to Sunday highlighting the programs we want viewers not to miss. / Temos programa e um cartaz TV dedicado apenas à programaçao da RTP2, ou seja, vamos mesmo puxar a brasa à nossa sardinha. É emitido todos os domingos pelas 19.00 e faremos uma viagem de segunda a domingo destacando os programas que queremos que os telespectadores nao percam.

programme.title: Tommy the Little Dragon / Tommy, o Pequeno Dragao
programme.desc: Tommy is a stuffed animal who lives with a family of pandas. With the help of his magical soap bubbles, Tommy takes children on wonderful adventures to help them discover a vast and captivating world, combat their fears and inhibitions and learn family values. / Tommy e um peluche que vive com uma família de pandas. Com a ajuda das suas bolhas de sabao mágicas, Tommy leva as crianças a viver aventuras maravilhosas para ajudá-las a descobrir um mundo vasto e cativante, a combater os seus medos e inibições e a aprender valores familiares.

programme.title: Robocar Poli
programme.desc: In Broom, a small village with a strong rescue team, there are always accidents and problems such as a car crashing into a ravine on a rainy day, a child locked in a house, among other dangerous situations. In each episode, the village's rescue team saves some of the inhabitants. / Em Broom, uma pequena vila com uma forte equipa de resgate, existem sempre acidentes e problemas como um carro que se despista numa ravina num dia de chuva, uma criança fechada numa casa, entre outras situações de perigo. Em cada episodio, a equipa de resgate da vila salva alguns dos habitantes.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing Bunny is a series based on children's books by author and illustrator Ted Dewan. It celebrates the realities, learning and adventure of being a preschooler when life is full of everyday dramas for both children and adults. / Bing Bunny e uma serie baseada nos livros infantis do autor e ilustrador Ted Dewan. Celebra as realidades, a aprendizagem e a aventura de ser uma criança do pre-escolar quando a vida está repleta de dramas quotidianos, tanto para as crianças como para os adultos.

programme.title: Ana Ladina
programme.desc: Ana Ladina is a very mischievous and mischievous 5-year-old girl who finds it really fun to look for Ladina solutions for her daily adventures, sometimes surprising, but always fun! / Ana Ladina e uma menina de 5 anos, muito traquinas e marota que acha muito divertido procurar soluções ladinas para as suas aventuras diárias, por vezes surpreendentes, mas sempre divertidas!

programme.title: Ana Ladina
