programme.title: Gus the Minorca Knight / Gus, o Cavaleiro Minorca
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a little boy, Gus, who wanted to be a great knight. Sorry, not a great knight... The greatest knight in the entire kingdom of Karamel. The problem is that Gus is... minorca! He's three apples tall, but he has a heart the size of a house! / Era uma vez um rapazinho, Gus, que queria ser um grande cavaleiro. Desculpem, nao um grande cavaleiro... O maior cavaleiro de todo o reino de Karamel. O problema e que Gus e... minorca! Ele tem tres maças de altura, mas tem um coraçao do tamanho de uma casa!

programme.title: Petit
programme.desc: Discover Petit's unique and imaginative perspective on everyday situations that become fantastic adventures that he will live together with his friends. Based on the award-winning book "Petit El Monstruo" by Isol. / Descubra a perspetiva única e imaginativa de Petit sobre situações do quotidiano que se tornam aventuras fantásticas que ele irá viver, juntamente com os seus amigos. Baseado no premiado livro "Petit El Monstruo" de Isol.

programme.title: Grizzy E Os Lemingues
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings discover an archaic indigenous table with the power to reveal the past and relive the first confrontations of their prehistoric ancestors and discover that chocolate spread was invented a long, long time ago. / Grizzy e os Lemingues descobrem uma mesa indígena arcaica com o poder de mostrar o passado e revivem os primeiros confrontos dos seus ancestrais pre-historicos e descobrem que o chocolate de barrar foi inventado há muito, muito tempo.

programme.title: Radar XS
programme.desc: Radar XS is a news program for children aged 8 to 12 that aims to encourage critical thinking and conscious citizenship. We will bring together politics and culture, economics and sport, science and children's literature, national and international current affairs in a simple and objective language. / Radar XS e um telejornal para crianças dos 8 aos 12 anos onde se pretende incentivar o pensamento crítico e a cidadania consciente. Vamos juntar a política e a cultura, a economia e desporto, a ciencia e a literatura infantil, a atualidade nacional e internacional numa linguagem simples e objetiva.

programme.title: Academia de Super-Herois
programme.desc: A group of teenagers attend a special school for future superheroes where they try to master deadly obstacle courses and create their own super costumes! / Um grupo de adolescentes frequenta uma escola especial para futuros super-herois onde tentam dominar pistas de obstáculos mortais e criar as suas proprias super-roupas!

programme.title: Sempre Atrasados
programme.desc: Every morning, Nuno and Malika leave home 30 minutes early to go to school and they still arrive late every morning! This is because every morning, something incredible happens along the way. But even though their stories are always true, the school principal never believes them... / Todas as manhas, Nuno e Malika saem de casa 30 minutos mais cedo para ir à escola e ainda assim todas as manhas chegam atrasados! Isto porque todas as manhas, algo incrível acontece no caminho. Mas mesmo que as suas historias sejam sempre verdadeiras, a diretora da escola nunca acredita nelas...

programme.title: Escola de Herois
programme.desc: Hero School is a school for budding superheroes, where children learn to master their innate powers to help people, solve problems and try to make the world a better place. / A Escola de Herois e uma escola para super-herois principiantes, onde as crianças aprendem a dominar os seus poderes inatos para ajudar as pessoas, resolver problemas e tentar tornar o mundo num lugar melhor.

programme.title: Lobito's Tales / Os Contos do Lobito
programme.desc: Lobito dreams of being like the heroes of the storybooks he loves to read, traveling from story to story to live their adventures. But as the intrepid little wolf quickly discovers, reaching a happy ending is no easy task and he will have to learn from his mistakes. / Lobito sonha ser como os herois dos livros de historias que mais gosta de ler, viajando de conto em conto para viver as suas aventuras. Mas como o intrepido lobinho depressa descobre, chegar ao final feliz nao e tarefa fácil e terá de aprender com os seus erros.

programme.title: Rev and Roll
programme.desc: Join Rev, an 8-year-old boy, and his best friend, Rumble, a boisterous and powerful truck who thinks he's a dog, and live big, fun adventures with them in their hometown of Fender Bend! / Junta-te Rev, um menino de 8 anos, e ao seu melhor amigo, Rumble, um camiao turbulento e poderoso que pensa que e um cachorro, e vive com eles grandes e divertidas aventuras na sua cidade natal, Fender Bend!

programme.title: A Escola dos Roaridos / A Escola dos Rugidos
programme.desc: Going to school for the first time is one of the biggest challenges we have to face. Roaring School helps children prepare for school life by exploring a child's first year through the relationships and experiences of our mini monsters. / Ir para a escola pela primeira vez e um dos maiores desafios que temos de enfrentar. A Escola dos Rugidos ajuda as crianças a prepararem-se para a vida escolar explorando o primeiro ano da criança atraves dos relacionamentos e experiencias dos nossos mini monstros.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Numberblocks are a really fun group of numbers that work together to solve big and small problems and will teach you to count in a really fun way! / Os Numberblocks sao um grupo de números muito divertido que trabalham juntos para resolver grandes e pequenos problemas e vao ensinar-te a contar de uma forma muito divertida!

programme.title: Kiwi
programme.desc: Let's learn English with Twiki and Twini! Each episode will be an adventure to discover new words and new sounds. / Vamos aprender Ingles com Twiki e Twini! Cada episodio será uma aventura para descobrir novas palavras e novos sons.

programme.title: A Grande Descoberta
programme.desc: Hugo, like all children, has a curious personality, and constantly questions himself on a journey in search of knowledge, logic and understanding the meaning of things. / Hugo, tal como todas as crianças, tem uma personalidade curiosa, e questiona-se constantemente numa jornada em busca de conhecimento, da logica e de compreender o significado das coisas.

programme.title: Ziggy and the Zootram
programme.desc: Ziggy is a friendly freshwater crocodile from Australia. He and his friends live in their eccentric houses located in a crater on an island. Ziggy and his friends have a very special secret - besides walking like people, talking like people - they all work in a zoo! / Ziggy e um simpático crocodilo-de-água-doce da Austrália. Ele e os seus amigos vivem nas suas excentricas casas situadas numa cratera de uma ilha. Ziggy e os seus amigos tem um segredo muito especial - alem de andarem como gente, falarem como gente - todos trabalham num jardim zoologico!

programme.title: Dimitri
programme.desc: Dimitri, a small bird, was lost from his family during migration and now roams the African continent, very different from his home continent, Europe. Deprived of his family and friends, Dimitri learns to overcome his fears to explore the extraordinary world of the savannah. / Dimitri, um pequeno pássaro, perdeu-se da sua família durante a migraçao e agora vagueia pelo continente africano, muito diferente do seu continente natal, a Europa. Privado da sua família e amigos, Dimitri aprende a superar os seus medos para explorar o mundo extraordinário da savana.

programme.title: Mia Go
programme.desc: Mia is a girl whose enthusiasm infects everyone around her. With her fearless sense of adventure, she tries things for the first time with a fearless attitude. Mia lives in the busy city Everyday with her closest friends and together they go on great adventures. / Mia e uma menina cujo entusiasmo contagia todos ao seu redor. Com seu destemido sentido de aventura, ela tenta as coisas pela primeira vez com uma atitude destemida. Mia mora na movimentada cidade Todososdias com os seus amigos mais proximos e juntos vao viver grandes aventuras.

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: Silly, fun and lots of surprises! The ever-curious Twirlywoos seek adventure and fun wherever they go. programme.title: The Art of Healing / A Arte da Cura
programme.sub-title: Right to Health / Direito à Saúde
programme.desc: In the beginning, medicine was magical. The darkness of the night was feared, nature was venerated. Illness was a punishment from the Gods, and only a few had the power to heal. Buddha, Imhothep, Hippocrates, Galen, are the references. / Nos primordios, a medicina era mágica. Temia-se a escuridao da noite, a natureza era venerada. A doença era castigo dos Deuses, e so alguns detinham o poder da cura. Buda, Imhothep, Hipocrates, Galeno, sao as referencias.

programme.desc: RTP2's new format, "Always in Time / O novo formato da RTP2, "Sempre a Tempo

programme.title: Marconi, the Man who United the World / Marconi, o Homem que Uniu o Mundo
programme.desc: 1937. In a climate of international tension, the fascist regime expects Guglielmo Marconi to contribute to the creation of a new weapon. A journalist is sent to discover their plans. / 1937. No clima de tensao internacional, o regime fascista espera que Guglielmo Marconi contribua para a criaçao de uma nova arma. Uma jornalista e enviada para descobrir os seus planos.

programme.title: E2 - Higher School of Social Communication / E2 - Escola Superior de Comunicaçao Social
programme.desc: Tragic events occur unexpectedly and dramatically. Although the news and reports that portray them must meet criteria that meet the ethics and deontology of journalism, the way in which their coverage is carried out is often called into question. / Os acontecimentos trágicos ocorrem de maneira inesperada e dramática. Embora as notícias e reportagens que os retratam devam cumprir criterios que vao ao encontro da etica e deontologia do jornalismo, a forma como a sua cobertura e feita e muitas vezes colocada em causa.

programme.title: Do yare to laponia / Do Algarve à Laponia
programme.desc: From the Nordic countries to the Mediterranean, passing through the Balkan region, the program will reveal projects that have received European funds in areas as diverse as agriculture, job creation, new energy sources, combating poverty, climate change and the integration of refugees. / Dos países nordicos ao mediterrâneo, passando pela regiao dos balcas, o programa vai revelar projetos que receberam fundos europeus em áreas tao diversas como a agricultura, a criaçao de emprego, as novas fontes de energia, o combate à pobreza, as alterações climáticas e a integraçao de refugiados.

programme.title: Room Sheet / Folha de Sala
programme.desc: A cultural agenda that highlights theater, music and other shows, not forgetting the launch of books and records, cinema and other events, such as exhibitions, open-air shows and conferences. Text and voiceover by Manuela Silva Reis. / Uma agenda cultural que destaca espectáculos de teatro, música e outros, nao esquecendo o lançamento de livros e discos, o cinema e ainda a realizaçao de outros eventos, como exposições, espectáculos ao ar livre, conferencias. Texto e locuçao de Manuela Silva Reis.

programme.title: Sociedade Civil
programme.desc: Sociedade Civil is a program with History that wants to be increasingly part of the daily lives of all Portuguese people. These are public issues debated by different people, private themes presented clearly. Presented by journalist Luís Castro, from Monday to Friday, at 2 pm. / O Sociedade Civil e um programa com Historia que quer fazer cada vez mais parte do dia-a-dia de todos os portugueses. Sao questões públicas debatidas por gente distinta, temas particulares apresentados de forma clara. Apresentado pelo jornalista Luís Castro, de segunda a sexta-feira, às 14h00.

programme.desc: Space dedicated to the different religions recognized in Portugal and established through its own Church. / Espaço dedicado às diferentes religiões reconhecidas em Portugal e instituídas atraves de uma Igreja propria.

programme.desc: A year after April 25th, autonomy reached the Azores, a region with its own unique heritage identity. Ao longo de bilhões de anos, os vulcões ajudaram a forjar o mundo que conhecemos. Dos continentes ao ar que respiramos e ate mesmo a propria vida, tudo foi moldado pela energia vulcânica.

programme.title: Crias
programme.desc: Come and learn about bedtime for some of the most beloved and mysterious species in the animal world. / Vem conhecer como e a hora de deitar de algumas das especies mais acarinhadas e misteriosas do mundo animal.

programme.title: The Hidden Side / O Lado Oculto
programme.desc: Iraq immediately brings us to images of war, danger and religious extremism. Karina Marceau aims to demystify these prejudices by traveling to Baghdad, where she discovers trendy bars, peaceful bikers and artists. / O Iraque remete-nos de imediato para imagens de guerra, perigo e extremismo religioso. Karina Marceau pretende desmistificar estes preconceitos ao viajar para Bagdad, onde descobre bares da moda, motociclistas pacíficos e artistas.

programme.title: Newspaper 2 / Jornal 2
programme.desc: The world in 30 minutes. In Jornal 2 we analyze facts and cross-reference opinions. With each passing day we read the country and the world with data, explanations and interpretations in the most diverse areas, such as Politics, Science, Economy and Culture. / O mundo em 30 minutos. No Jornal 2 analisamos factos e cruzamos opiniões. programme.title: My Faith in Sport
programme.desc: Ramadan is a crucial period in the Islamic calendar but fasting (Sawm) can provide complications for athletes who are trying to compete at the highest level. But to what extent is fasting a negative or can it actually aid performance? We look at the life and adaptation throughout Ramadan of Adam Azim – an unbeaten professional boxer from the UK, Fares El Bakh – a weightlifter who won Qatar’s first ever Olympic gold medal, and Zainab Alema – a rugby player who is aiming to become the first player to represent England wearing a hijab.Experts in Sports Science and Nutrition from Aspetar Clinic, Qatar also add detail of the physical impact athletes encounter during Ramadan

programme.title: Grand Prix of Rome - Longines Global Champions Tour - Rome, ITA
programme.desc: The 1.60m LGCT Grand Prix: one round plus jump-off for big championship points and a golden ticket to the Prague Playoffs Super Grand Prix. Huge oxers, delicate verticals and a demanding time allowed reward brave riding and perfect stride control in a high-stakes Roman finale.

programme.desc: Exploring the importance of prayer within Islam, the episode begins with an overview of our seven athletes as they introduce themselves and why Islam is so important to them. The life and career of Sofyan Amrabat is explored, showcasing his role as a key part of the Fenerbahce team in Turkey and the Moroccan national side. programme.title: My Faith in Sport - Sawm
programme.desc: Ramadan is a crucial period in the Islamic calendar but fasting (Sawm) can provide complications for athletes who are trying to compete at the highest level. But to what extent is fasting a negative or can it actually aid performance? We look at the life and adaptation throughout Ramadan of Adam Azim – an unbeaten professional boxer from the UK, Fares El Bakh – a weightlifter who won Qatar’s first ever Olympic gold medal, and Zainab Alema – a rugby player who is aiming to become the first player to represent England wearing a hijab. Experts in Sports Science and Nutrition from Aspetar Clinic, Qatar also add detail of the physical impact athletes encounter during Ramadan.

programme.title: My Faith in Sport - Salah
programme.desc: Exploring the importance of prayer within Islam, the episode begins with an overview of our seven athletes as they introduce themselves and why Islam is so important to them. We are also introduced to Omar Sulieman, a notable Imam, who acts as narration throughout the series and a guiding voice on the key principles of Islam. The life and career of Sofyan Amrabat is explored, showcasing his role as a key part of the Fenerbahce team in Turkey and the Moroccan national side. The Atlas Lions’ run to the semi-finals of the FIFA World Cup Qatar 2022 is explored, with the impact that Salah played in the team’s belief and positivity throughout the tournament.

programme.title: My Faith in Sport - Taffakur
programme.desc: Islam teaches Muslims about ‘Tawakkul’ meaning trusting in God’s plan. Muslims believe in the idea that with anything in life we put forward our best efforts but ultimately the rest is left to God and believing whatever the outcome, it was pre-written. Omar Marmoush is the feature athlete in the final episode of the series – from the outskirts of the Eintracht Frankfurt side to an $80m move to Premier League Manchester City, his last 18 months has seen an incredible rise. His love of Ramadan and belief that fasting elevates his game is a central theme of the final episode alongside detail of his early life, career and his unfaltering belief in Islam. programme.title: M3-ATP 250 - European open 2025 - Brussels
programme.desc: ATP 250 European Open 2025 (10th edition) debuts in Brussels after nine years in Antwerp, staged on indoor-hard courts at Brussels Expo (Palais 12), 13–19 Oct. Draw sizes: 28-player singles / 16-team doubles. Prize money: €706,850. Expect fast, first-strike tennis, sharp returns and tie-break pressure as contenders fight for late-season ranking points and momentum toward Turin.

programme.title: Beauty UFC 40 / MMA UFC 40
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.desc: See the study show that is dedicated to the current struggles organized by UFC. This association was founded in 1993. in Las Vegas. / Pogledajte studijsku emisiju koja je posvećena aktuelnim borbama koje organizuje UFC. Ovo udruženje je osnovano 1993. godine u Las Vegasu.

programme.title: Beauty UFC 10 / MMA UFC 10
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.desc: Brasileirao Seria A was the first Brazilian league founded in 1959. years. Due to geographical reasons, the history of the unique league in the area of ​​Brazil is relatively short. U ligi trenutno u;estvuje 20 ekipa u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Tokom svog postojanja Serija A je fudbalskom svetu dala neke od najboljih igrača u Istoriji. programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League: Ephesus - Merkezefendi / Košarka - Turska liga: Efes - Merkezefendi
programme.desc: The beginnings of the Turkish basketball dwell back before the League founding in 1966. years. Ear even early 20. The centuries of hoops under the hoops were known in Turkey. Students with Rober College in Istanbul in 1904. They first discovered the charms of this team sport. The first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs started the year after the founding of the league. The second league was launched three years later. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams playing each with every twice in the regular part after which the plejof is the eight best teams. The two weakest placed teams fall out of the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko pre osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plejof osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Fenerbahce - Red Star / Košarka - Euroleague: Fenerbahce - Crvena zvezda
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that started its journey into the world of European basketball under the name Cup of European Champions in 1958. years, and the first trophy won the KSK Riga team from the then USSR and today's Latvia. The FIBA ​​led the main word in this competition until 2000. when clubs took control of the competition through its Euregation Basketball Association. The format of the competition changed through history and contained a part of the groups after which elimations in the playoffs followed. The most successful clubs of this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathianos, Varese, Olympiacos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva Final Four. Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

programme.title: Football - Scotland League: Falkirk - Rangers / Fudbal - Škotska liga: Falkirk - Rangers
programme.desc: The Scottish Football Championship in its first season has set out in 1890. years and has already been set up by one rarity. Two teams then divided the champion title because of the same number of points at the end of the season. These were today the world-famous Glazegov Rangers, a team with more than 50 championship titles and today a relatively unknown club Dumbarton. The League itself has changed the names and format in a couple of occasions, but since 2013. it is officially called Scottish Professional Football League and is the highest rank of Scottish football. League also marks one of the largest derbies in the history of football between the two Glasgovske teams of Celtic and Rangers. / Škotsko fudbalsko prvenstvo u svoju prvu sezonu su krenuli 1890. godine i već tada je postavljen jedan raritet. Dve ekipe su tada podelile šampionsku titulu zbog istog broja bodova na kraju sezone. To su bili danas svetski poznati Glazgov Rendžersi, ekipa sa više od 50 šampionskih titula i danas relativno nepoznati klub Dumbarton. Sama liga je kroz godine u par navrata menjala nazive i format, no od 2013. se službeno zove Scottish Professional Football League i najviši je rang škotskog fudbala. Ligu isto obeležava jedan od najvećih derbija u istoriji fudbala između dve glazgovske ekipe Seltika i Rendžersa.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League: Petkim Display - Galatasaray / Košarka - Turska liga: Petkim Spor - Galatasaray
programme.desc: The beginnings of the Turkish basketball dwell back before the League founding in 1966. years. Ear even early 20. The centuries of hoops under the hoops were known in Turkey. Students with Rober College in Istanbul in 1904. They first discovered the charms of this team sport. The first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs started the year after the founding of the league. The second league was launched three years later. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams playing each with every twice in the regular part after which the plejof is the eight best teams. The two weakest placed teams fall out of the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko pre osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plejof osam najboljih ekipa. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Bayern - Zalgiris / Košarka - Euroleague: Bayern - Zalgiris
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that started its journey into the world of European basketball under the name Cup of European Champions in 1958. years, and the first trophy won the KSK Riga team from the then USSR and today's Latvia. The FIBA ​​led the main word in this competition until 2000. when clubs took control of the competition through its Euregation Basketball Association. The format of the competition changed through history and contained a part of the groups after which elimations in the playoffs followed. The winner of this competition decides on the final tournament called Final Four. The most successful clubs of this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathianos, Varese, Olympiacos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva Final Four. Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

programme.title: Basketball - Germany League: Syntainics - Ulm / Košarka - Nemačka liga: Syntainics - Ulm
programme.desc: The history of the German club basketball dates back to 1939. years, but the German basketball Bundesliga was founded in 1964. while only the competition sets two years later. The last two of the regular part of the regular part drop out in the lower rank, while the Plejofor gets the Best of Five format where the teams must receive minimum 3 matches from 5 to eject the rivals. The interestingness of the league is that each team must have a hall of a minimum of 3000 places for the audience. / Istorija nemačke klupske košarke datira još iz 1939. godine, no Nemačka košarkaška Bundesliga osnovana je 1964. godine dok samo takmičenje je krenulo dve godine kasnije. Takmičenje se sastoji od 18 timova, a sezona je podeljena na regularni deo u kojem svako igra sa svakim dvokružno i plejof deo koji stupa nakon završenog regularnog dela. Zanimljivost lige je da svaka ekipa mora imati dvoranu od minimalno 3000 mesta za publiku.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League: Illyria - Zadar / Košarka - ABA liga: Ilirija - Zadar
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. programme.title: Basketball - ABA League: FMP - SC DERBY / Košarka - ABA liga: FMP - SC Derby
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. Football (M): Maribor - Domzale, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Domzale, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.desc: The Euro was created in 2002 as the second "Euroleague Basketball" competition. This competition is fighting the strongest basketball clubs that have failed to qualify for the Euroleague, mostly involved in the Top 15 most powerful European leagues. Clubs are provided by national championships and trophies and through invitations, i.e. "Wildcards". / Evrokup je nastal leta 2002 kot drugo tekmovanje "Evrolige Basketball". V tem tekmovanju se borijo najmočnejši košarkarski klubi, ki se niso uspeli uvrstiti v Evroligo, v njem pa večinoma sodelujejo klubi iz top 15 najmočnejših evropskih lig. Uvrstitev v Evrokup si klubi zagotovijo preko nacionalnih prvenstev in pokalov ter preko povabil, t.i. "wildcards".

programme.title: Nogomet (m): E Frankfurt - B. Munchen, Bundesliga 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): E Frankfurt - B. Munchen, Bundesliga 2025/2026
programme.desc: With all that Germany has given us throughout history, the Bundesliga proudly stands. In the highest rank of a football competition founded in 1963, 18 teams compete, which start matches for a popular plate every year in August. It was most often won by Bayern Munich, as many as 24 times. The cheerleading culture, full of tribes and top football is what Bundesliga adorns from its beginnings to the present day. Don't miss the opportunity to enjoy the Bundesliga matches. You will definitely not be sorry. / Ob vsem, kar nam je Nemčija skozi zgodovino dala, ponosno stoji tudi Bundesliga. V najvišjem rangu nogometnega tekmovanja, ustanovljenega leta 1963, se pomeri 18 ekip, ki vsako leto v avgustu pričnejo tekme za priljubljeni krožnik. Največkrat ga je osvojil Bayern Munchen, in sicer kar 24-krat. Kultura navijanja, polnih tribin in vrhunskega nogometa je tisto, kar Bundesligo krasi od njenih začetkov do današnjih dni. Ne zamudite priložnosti, da uživate v tekmah Bundeslige. Zagotovo vam ne bo žal.

programme.title: Nogomet (m): E Frankfurt - B. Munchen, Bundesliga 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): E Frankfurt - B. Munchen, Bundesliga 2025/2026
programme.desc: With all that Germany has given us throughout history, the Bundesliga proudly stands. Ne zamudite priložnosti, da uživate v tekmah Bundeslige. Zagotovo vam ne bo žal.

programme.title: Witnesses: Valentina Kogoj, Mon. / Pričevalci: Valentina Kogoj, pon.
programme.sub-title: Valentina Kogoj, born Mikuš in Budanje, grew up during fascism, war and post -war communist repression. Her childhood was characterized by a lack of, a partisan school and refugee, but also an outstanding teacher who gave her a love of knowledge. / Valentina Kogoj, rojena Mikuš v Budanjah, je odraščala v času fašizma, vojne in povojne komunistične represije. Otroštvo so ji zaznamovali pomanjkanje, partizanska šola in begunstvo, a tudi izjemna učiteljica, ki ji je vlila ljubezen do znanja.
programme.desc: The interviewee recalls that they always supported the partisans at home, mainly because of their language, they wanted a Slovenian school and the end of the Italian authorities. The father was collecting food for the partisans, his mother was active in the anti -fascist front of women (AFZ), had secret meetings. The children were taught to remain silent and hide information - the skills that the interviewee has maintained all their lives. Also, one homeowner who returned home after the war were supposed to capture, torture and kill. His family was never allowed to bury him or find out where he was buried. Who often dreamed of being hunted by the Germans. Anxious dreams also accompanied her in adulthood until she went to Sweden. Like a pressure and graduated in 1953 at the Tolmin School and got a job as a teacher. There, as a teacher, she worked with immigrant children from all over the world, learned languages, learned other cultures, and lived her faith and inner freedom. The Slovene language remained committed, even as a mother. After returning home, she became involved in the prayer community and collected stories from the past. Faith and language were its fundamental guides; The fondest memory, however, remains a plebiscite for an independent Slovenia. / Intervjuvanka se spominja, da so doma vedno podpirali partizane, predvsem zaradi jezika, želeli so slovensko šolo in konec italijanske oblasti. Oče je zbiral hrano za partizane, mama je bila aktivna v Antifašistični fronti žena (AFŽ), imela je skrivne sestanke. Otroke so učili molčati in skrivati informacije - veščine, ki jih je intervjuvanka ohranila vse življenje.Spominja se revolucionarnega nasilja – partizani so v kraju ubili moškega, ki je dvomil v njihovo oboroženo moč. Tudi enega domobranca, ki se je po vojni vračal domov, naj bi zajeli, mučili in ubili. Njegova družina ga nikoli ni smela pokopati ali izvedeti, kje je pokopan.Kot otrok je pogosto sanjala, da jo lovijo Nemci. Tesnobne sanje so jo spremljale tudi v odrasli dobi, vse dokler ni odšla na Švedsko.Kljub pritiskom in je leta 1953 maturirala na učiteljišču v Tolminu in se zaposlila kot učiteljica.V 60. letih je odšla na Švedsko, kjer je ostala več desetletij. Tam je kot učiteljica delala z otroki priseljencev z vsega sveta, se učila jezikov, spoznavala druge kulture ter živela svojo vero in notranjo svobodo. Slovenskemu jeziku je ostala predana, tudi kot mati.Po vrnitvi v domovino se je vključila v molitveno skupnost in zbirala zgodbe iz preteklosti. Vera in jezik sta bila njena temeljna vodila; najlepši spomin pa ji ostaja plebiscit za samostojno Slovenijo.

programme.title: One hundred years from the Carinthian plebiscite, a documentary, Mon. / Sto let od koroškega plebiscita, dokumentarni film, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Roast Valentin ... Carinthian plebiscite on Sunday 10. October 1920, when Carinthia, cradle of Slovene, lost for us, contemporaries felt as a national disaster. / R: Pečenko Valentin... Koroški plebiscit v nedeljo 10. oktobra 1920, ko je bila Koroška, zibelka slovenstva, za nas izgubljena, so sodobniki občutili kot narodno katastrofo.
programme.desc: The documentary film narrative focuses on the lesser known facts and the political background of the plebiscite. In June 1919, Slovenian politicians met with the most powerful man in the world, US President Woodrow Wilson, but failed to persuade him to abandon the intention of the Carinthian plebiscite. The narrative also reveals lesser -known details of the work and role of General Rudolf Maister in plebiscite time. In particular, it focuses on the operation of the intact plebiscite commission, in charge of performing a plebiscite in Zone A, consisting of the constituencies Rožek, Borovlje, Pliberk and Velikovec. The decisions of Britain's Sydney Capel Peck, the chairman of the commission and its members, Frenchman Charles de Chambruna and Italian Livia Borghese, had a significant impact on the outcome of the plebiscite and marked the fate of Carinthian Slovenes. The film, signed by director and screenwriter Valentin Pečenko, featured renowned domestic and foreign historians and other history examiners, dr. Theodor Domej, dr. Andrej Rahten, Ph.D. Wilhelm Wadl, Marjan Kos, Ph.D. Gregor Antoličič, Augustine Malle, dr. Tina Bahovec, M.Sc. Hanzi Filipič and Horst Ogris. / Dokumentarna filmska pripoved se osredotoči na manj znana dejstva in politično ozadje plebiscita. Slovenski politiki so se junija 1919 sicer sestali z najmogočnejšim človekom na svetu, ameriškim predsednikom Woodrowom Wilsonom, a jim ga ni uspelo pregovoriti, da bi opustil namero o koroškem plebiscitu. Pripoved razkrije tudi manj znane podrobnosti o delovanju in vlogi generala Rudolfa Maistra v plebiscitnem času. Posebej pa se posveti delovanju medzavezniške plebiscitne komisije, zadolžene za izvedbo plebiscita v coni A, ki so jo sestavljali volilni okraji Rožek, Borovlje, Pliberk in Velikovec. Odločitve Britanca Sydneyja Capela Pecka, predsednika komisije in njenih članov, Francoza Charlesa de Chambruna ter Italijana Livia Borgheseja, so pomembno vplivale na izid plebiscita in zaznamovale usodo koroških Slovencev. V filmu, ki ga je podpisal režiser in scenarist Valentin Pečenko, so nastopili priznani domači in tuji zgodovinarji ter drugi preučevalci zgodovine, dr. Teodor Domej, dr. Andrej Rahten, dr. Wilhelm Wadl, Marjan Kos, dr. Gregor Antoličič, Avguštin Malle, dr. Tina Bahovec, mag. Hanzi Filipič in Horst Ogris.

programme.desc: Marguerites and Margot are twelve years old, each has their own family, friends, problems ... and their time. One lives in 1942, the other in 2020. The mysterious magic chests unexpectedly connect them - and so Margot and Marguerite find themselves in a time that is not theirs. In addition to a sudden journey through time, they are also linked by both lost their fathers - one disappeared in World War II and the other no longer lives at home. Despite the 70-year difference, Marguerite and Margot embark on a big adventure to find their way back to their time, not only exploring family memories and secrets. The Laventure Des Marguerite / French Film, 2019 / Director: Pierre Core / Screenplay: Vincent Cavellier, Benoît Robin Cast: Lile Gueneau, Alice Polo, Clovis Cornillac ...... / Marguerite in Margot sta stari dvanajst let, vsaka ima svojo družino, prijatelje, težave … in svoj čas. Ena živi v letu 1942, druga v 2020. Skrivnostna čarobna skrinja ju nepričakovano poveže – in tako se Margot in Marguerite znajdeta v času, ki ni njun. Poleg nenadnega potovanja skozi čas ju povezuje tudi to, da sta obe izgubili očeta – eden je izginil v drugi svetovni vojni, drugi pa ne živi več doma. Kljub 70-letni razliki se Marguerite in Margot podata na veliko pustolovščino, da bi našli pot nazaj v svoj čas, pri tem pa ne raziskujeta le zgodovine, temveč tudi družinske spomine in skrivnosti.Izvirni naslov: LAVENTURE DES MARGUERITE / Francoski film, 2019 / Režija: Pierre Core / Scenarij: Vincent Cuvellier, Benoît Robin, Stephane Kazandjian / Igrajo: Lile Gueneau, Alice Pol, Clovis Cornillac......

programme.title: Environments, pon. / Ambienti, pon.
programme.sub-title: Ambients; In the vicinity of Olimje, with a beautiful view, they boast personal wooden houses, which, with their design, relate to the Kozjansko tradition. Their final image is the merit of heartwarmers with a lot of sense of aesthetics. / Ambienti; V bližini Olimja se s čudovitim razgledom ponašajo lične lesene hiške, ki se s svojo zasnovo navezujejo na kozjansko tradicijo. Njihova končna podoba je zasluga srčnih lastnikov z veliko občutka za estetiko.
programme.desc: The spirits on the facades returns to architecture as aesthetic and sustainable solution - especially since it offers natural chemicals without chemicals while creating a rustic and elegant look. Especially in the Gorenjska region, farmers used to burn wooden buildings intentionally to protect them from weather and pests. Architects followed the materiality of riparian objects in this part of Slovenia at the renovation of the boatmill on the western edge of Lake Bled. In the charming village above Litija, we visited the Green Paradise, which impresses with more than 2000 varieties of plants from around the world. It extends on a half -hectaric hectare of carefully entrenched terrain, where you will find an instructive walk between magnificent trees and shrubs and a stunning view of the surrounding hills. / Žgani les na fasadah se vrača v arhitekturo kot estetska in trajnostna rešitev – še posebej , ker ponuja naravno zaščito brez kemikalij, hkrati pa ustvarja rustikalen in eleganten videz. Predvsem na Gorenjskem, so kmetje nekoč lesene objekte namerno ožgali, da bi jih zaščitili pred vremenskimi vplivi in škodljivci. Arhitekti so pri prenovi čolnarne na zahodnem robu Blejskega jezera sledili materialnosti obrežnih objektov v tem delu Slovenije. V očarljivi vasici nad Litijo smo obiskali Zeleni raj, ki navdušuje z več kot 2000 sortami rastlin z vsega sveta. programme.sub-title: Keeping it up; The documentary series shows the discovery and development of Viagra, the first pills for the treatment of erection disorder, which, according to many, caused a second sexual revolution, comparable to the invention of contraceptive pills. Farmacevt
programme.desc: Part 1: A hard -learning early 90s. British experts from the Pfizer Pharmaceutical Company tested a new medicine for heart disease on the Wales Volunteer Group. Most men who took him reported an unexpected side effect: frequent erections. Research has shown that this substance could be treated with impotence. However, because the word had a worse tone, it was renamed to erectile. Critics accuse Pfizer that he recommended taking a pill to all men who are not entirely satisfied with their sex life. In the pharmaceutical company, however, they defend that they only wanted to help with the viagra and that they even received the Vatican approval before the sale in 1998.Keeping It Up / UK / 2023 / Director: Stephen Bennett. / 1. del: Trda spoznanjaNa začetku 90. let prejšnjega stoletja so britanski strokovnjaki iz farmacevtske družbe Pfizer na skupini prostovoljcev iz Walesa preizkušali novo zdravilo za srčne bolezni. Večina moških, ki so ga jemali, je poročala o nepričakovanem stranskem učinku: pogostih erekcijah. Raziskave so pokazale, da bi s to učinkovino lahko zdravili impotenco. Ker pa je imela beseda slabšalni prizvok, so jo preimenovali v motnjo erekcije. Kritiki Pfizerju očitajo, da je priporočal jemanje tabletke vsem moškim, ki niso povsem zadovoljni s svojim spolnim življenjem. V farmacevtski družbi pa se branijo, da so z viagro želeli le pripomoči k trdnejšim zakonskim zvezam in da so pred začetkom prodaje leta 1998 dobili celo odobritev Vatikana.KEEPING IT UP / Velika Britanija / 2023 / Režija: Stephen Bennett.

programme.desc: Lalex sassabenta that two 12 -year -old children have fled the house, and have a parent's gun, a military man returned from Mali. programme.title: 30 minutes: Masies, a legacy that sensor / 30 minuts: Masies, un llegat que sensorra
programme.desc: There are fewer and fewer farmhouses and many of which are in danger. The crisis in the primary sector, urban growth, the fall of the figure of LHEREU or real estate speculation, among others, threaten a key legacy to tell the history of Catalonia. / Cada vegada hi ha menys masies i moltes de les que hi ha estan en perill. La crisi del sector primari, el creixement urbà, la caiguda de la figura de lhereu o lespeculacio immobiliària, entre daltres, amenacen un llegat clau per explicar la història de Catalunya.

programme.title: Night of play / Nit de jocs
programme.desc: A dimic group that usually gathered to spend a night of games are immersed in a mystery of real life when the charismatic brother ofun is abducted by dangerous criminals.The film couple formed by John Francis Daley (which some will remember as Lance Sweets of the series Bon All of the box office hits such as Spider-Man: Homecoming, they are from the direction of a ribbon for once on a ribbon for the second time. Of really comic situations that at the same time knows how to handle the codes of the suspense, having several unexpected turns that make it not very predictable. Jason Bateman and Rachel McADAMS, two interpreters expert in the genre, interpret the protagonist couple, but curiously, the only time they had worked together was the dramatic thriller lombra of power. / Un grup damics que acostuma a reunir-se per passar una nit de jocs es veuen immers en un misteri de la vida real quan el germà carismàtic dun es segrestat per uns perillosos delinquents.La parella cinematogràfica formada per John Francis Daley (als quals alguns recordaran com Lance Sweets de la sèrie Bones) i Jonathan Goldstein, reconeguts guionistes de comèdies com Com acabar amb el teu cap o fins i tot dautèntics èxits de taquilla com Spider-Man: Homecoming, sencarreguen de la direccio duna cinta per una vegada en una cinta per segona vegada. de situacions realment còmiques que al mateix temps sap manejar amb mestria els codis del suspens, tenint diversos girs inesperats que la fan poc predictible.Jason Bateman i Rachel McAdams, dos intèrprets experts en el gènere, interpreten la parella protagonista, però curiosament, lúnica vegada que havien treballat junts va ser al dramàtic thriller Lombra del poder.

programme.sub-title: 104 houses for 104 families – Patricia Scarpatetti and her new village / 104 Hauser fur 104 Familien – Patricia Scarpatetti und ihr neues Dorf
programme.desc: Nino Schurter wants to achieve even more great results in his last year in the mountain bike World Cup. At almost 40 years old, he once again faces the tough professional routine, straining his body, despite knowing that many opponents are even 20 years younger than him and that victories are becoming rarer. Florian Zutt's documentary follows the Graubünden mountain bike legend from the start of the season at the Cape Epic in South Africa, through the World Championships in Valais, up to his last participation in a World Cup race at his home. Once again Nino Schurter gives everything to make his dream of winning in Lenzerheide come true. At the same time, the film allows us to get to know Nino Schurter in his private life, discovering who he is as a person and a father. It's a dive into the environment and family that shaped him. How will the champion be able to detach himself from the life of the professional he has lived for almost 25 years? / Nino Schurter anche nel suo ultimo anno nella Coppa del Mondo di mountain bike vuole raggiungere una volta di più grandi risultati. A quasi 40 anni, affronta ancora una volta la dura routine professionale, sforzando il suo corpo, pur sapendo che molti avversari hanno anche 20 anni meno di lui e che le vittorie diventano più rare.Il documentario di Florian Zutt segue la leggenda grigionese della mountain bike dall’inizio della stagione alla Cape Epic in Sudafrica, passando per i Campionati del Mondo in Vallese, fino alla sua ultima partecipazione a una gara di Coppa del Mondo a casa sua. Ancora una volta Nino Schurter dà tutto per realizzare il sogno di vincere a Lenzerheide.Allo stesso tempo, il film permette di conoscere Nino Schurter nella sua vita privata, scoprendo il suo essere persona e padre. È un tuffo nell’ambiente e nella famiglia che lo hanno plasmato.Come potrà il campione staccarsi dalla vita del professionista che ha vissuto per quasi 25 anni?

programme.desc: Heidi goes to live in her grandfather's cabin surrounded by breathtaking views of the Swiss Alps. Everyone will rely on his goodness and energy; his friendliness and innocence are contagious and will even prevail over the closed and grumpy character of the old man. / Heidi va a vivere nella baita del nonno immersa in panorami mozzafiato sulle Alpi svizzere. Tutti faranno affidamento sulla sua bontà ed energia; la sua simpatia e linnocenza sono contagiose e avranno la meglio a - nche sul carattere chiuso e scontroso del vecchio.

programme.title: Albert's garden - The Romans conquered the Alps / Il giardino di Albert - I Romani alla conquista delle alpi
programme.sub-title: I Romani alla conquista delle alpi
programme.desc: In 15 BC, Emperor Augustus launched one of the most ambitious military campaigns of antiquity: the conquest of the Alps. What for centuries had been a natural barrier between the Mediterranean and Central Europe thus became the scene of an extraordinary undertaking, which would mark the destiny of the continent. Recent archaeological investigations conducted in the Canton of Grisons have made it possible to reconstruct, with previously unpublished details, the stages of this advance. Thousands of nails from the sandals of the legionaries, lead bullets used by the slingers and remains of camps over two thousand meters above sea level, on the Settimo Pass, testify to the scope and complexity of the operation. These finds tell of the effort, discipline and ingenuity of men who, thanks to perfect military organisation, were able to face extreme conditions and overcome natural and human obstacles. The conquest of the Alps represented not only a military victory, but also a triumph of Roman logistics and strategy. The opening of new communication routes favored the birth of the province of Rhaezia and contributed significantly to the political and cultural transformation of Europe. Today, archaeological research and discoveries give voice to this page of history, offering new perspectives on an undertaking that continues to arouse interest and amazement. / Nel 15 a.C., limperatore Augusto diede avvio a una delle più ambiziose campagne militari dellantichità: la conquista delle Alpi. Quella che per secoli era stata una barriera naturale tra il Mediterraneo e lEuropa centrale divenne così teatro di una straordinaria impresa, che avrebbe segnato il destino del continente. Le recenti indagini archeologiche condotte nel Canton Grigioni hanno permesso di ricostruire, con dettagli inediti, le tappe di questa avanzata. Migliaia di chiodi provenienti dai sandali dei legionari, proiettili di piombo utilizzati dai frombolieri e resti di accampamenti a oltre duemila metri daltitudine, sul Passo del Settimo, testimoniano la portata e la complessità delloperazione. Questi reperti raccontano la fatica, la disciplina e lingegno di uomini che, grazie a una perfetta organizzazione militare, seppero affrontare condizioni estreme e superare ostacoli naturali e umani. La conquista delle Alpi rappresentò non solo una vittoria militare, ma anche un trionfo della logistica e della strategia romana. Lapertura di nuove vie di comunicazione favorì la nascita della provincia della Rezia e contribuì in modo determinante alla trasformazione politica e culturale dellEuropa. Oggi, le ricerche e le scoperte archeologiche restituiscono voce a questa pagina di storia, offrendo nuove prospettive su unimpresa che continua a suscitare interesse e stupore.

programme.title: Paganini
programme.desc: "Magical art is that which gives us back the marvelous at the heart of everyday life": this is how the writer Andre Breton expressed himself and - thanking the father of surrealism for the quote and the inspiration - it is precisely the dimension of the magical that the Paganini episode on Sunday 5 October, from 10.30 on RSI LA1, addresses. The "Livermore Svò" - starring Davide Livermore, now an acclaimed opera director - was one of the funniest and wittiest serial productions in the RSI music sector. In the episode entitled "Magic Music" alongside the histrionic host, the Orchestra of the Teatro Regio of Turin directed by Carlo Boccadoro, a group of madrigalists, the musicians Oliviero Giovannoni and Diego Fasolis alternated. Sorcellerie - literally: witchcraft - is a recent French show featuring the pianist duo Jatekok (with works by Hector Berlioz, Franz Liszt, Camille Saint-Saëns and Paul Dukas) and two mimes/magicians engaged in an evocative dombre theatre. Finally, Fantasymphony is the imaginative symphonic program of the Danish National Symphony Orchestra conducted by Christian Schumann which - with the subtitle "a concert of magic and fire" - offers a selection of songs from films, series and video games that address the theme of the magical and the fantastic. Some examples? The Harry Potter soundtrack written by John Williams, the music by Lorne Balfe for the BBC/HBO series His Dark Materials, the song Breath of Life by Florence and the Machine for the film Snow White and the Huntsman, the famous theme by Ramin Djawadi for Game of Thrones or even the musical suite from the series Netflix The Witcher written by Sonya Belousova together with Giona Ostinelli from Ticino. - Livermore Svò - Magical music - Sorcellerie for two pianos - Fantasymphony - A concert of magic and fire / "Larte magica è quella che ci restituisce il meraviglioso al cuore della vita quotidiana": così si esprimeva lo scrittore Andre Breton e - ringraziando il padre del surrealismo per la citazione e lo spunto - è proprio alla dimensione del magico che si rivolge la puntata di Paganini di domenica 5 ottobre, dalle 10.30 su RSI LA1. Il "Livermore Sciò" - con protagonista Davide Livermore, oggi acclamato regista operistico - è stata una delle produzioni seriali più divertenti e argute del settore musicale RSI. Nellepisodio intitolato "Musica magica" si alternavano, accanto allistrionico padrone di casa, lOrchestra del Teatro Regio di Torino diretta da Carlo Boccadoro, un gruppo di madrigalisti, i musicisti Oliviero Giovannoni e Diego Fasolis. Sorcellerie - letteralmente: stregoneria - è invece un recente spettacolo francese che vede protagonisti il duo di pianiste Jatekok (con opere di Hector Berlioz, Franz Liszt, Camille Saint-Saëns e Paul Dukas) e due mimi/maghi impegnati in un suggestivo teatro dombre. Fantasymphony è infine limmaginifico programma sinfonico della Danish National Symphony Orchestra diretta da Christian Schumann che - con il sottotitolo «un concerto di magia e fuoco» - propone una selezione di brani da film, serie e videogiochi che affrontano il tema del magico e del fantastico. Alcuni esempi? La colonna sonora di Harry Potter scritta da John Williams, le musiche di Lorne Balfe per la serie BBC/HBO His Dark Materials - Queste oscure materie, il brano Breath of Life di Florence and the Machine per il film Biancaneve e il cacciatore, il celebre tema di Ramin Djawadi per Game of Thrones o ancora la Suite musicale dalla serie Netflix The Witcher scritta da Sonya Belousova assieme al ticinese Giona Ostinelli. - Livermore Sciò - Musica magica - Sorcellerie per due pianoforti - Fantasymphony - Un concerto di magia e fuoco

programme.title: Storie
programme.desc: The story of two young people and kindred spirits, leading a queer collective. In a Ticino still closed to the LGBTQIA+ scene, the two carry out a small but intense revolution, made up of DJ sets, performances and acts of daily resistance. Inspired by the cities in which they lived, Buenos Aires and London, they try to transform the reality that surrounds them, bringing the radical energy of the queer metropolises to the heart of Italian Switzerland. The film accompanies them in a crucial moment: the discovery of themselves, the beginning of new loves and the organization of a great event to celebrate the first year of the collective. A dream that collides with economic barriers and prejudices. Dolls on the Block is the intimate and vital portrait of a generation that fights to be seen, between shared dreams and the search for a space to exist. In a historical moment marked by the re-emergence of repressive policies and hate campaigns against the queer community, their commitment takes on an even more urgent force. A documentary by Patrik Soergel For further information we refer you to the following support sites: www.lgbtiq-helpline.ch/it puntodicontattoticino.wordpress.com / La storia di due giovani e anime affini, alla guida di un collettivo queer. In un Ticino ancora chiuso verso la scena LGBTQIA+, lə due portano avanti una piccola ma intensa rivoluzione, fatta di DJ set, performance e atti di resistenza quotidiana. Ispiratə dalle città in cui hanno vissuto, Buenos Aires e Londra, provano a trasformare la realtà che lə circonda, portando nel cuore della Svizzera italiana l’energia radicale delle metropoli queer.Il film lə accompagna in un momento cruciale: la scoperta di se, l’inizio di nuovi amori e l’organizzazione di un grande evento per celebrare il primo anno del collettivo. Un sogno che si scontra con barriere economiche e pregiudizi.Dolls on the Block è il ritratto intimo e vitale di una generazione che lotta per essere vista, tra sogni condivisi e la ricerca di uno spazio dove esistere. In un momento storico segnato dal riemergere di politiche repressive e campagne d’odio contro la comunità queer, il loro impegno assume una forza ancora più urgente.Un documentario di Patrik SoergelPer maggiori informazioni vi rimandiamo ai seguenti siti di supporto: www.lgbtiq-helpline.ch/it puntidicontattoticino.wordpress.com

programme.title: Yukon Mission - Sixth episode / Missione Yukon - Sesto episodio
programme.desc: Increasingly independent and increasingly at ease in the wilderness, the heroes of Mission Yukon have settled in a new camp on the banks of the Hess River. After weeks of intense rain they can finally dedicate themselves to various hunter-gatherer activities, and learn ancient and extraordinary techniques with the help of Kim, an expert on life in the woods. Arianne and Jessica's families have fun together and free their imaginations in the immense spaces of Canada in the sixth and penultimate episode of the series. / Sempre più indipendenti e sempre più a loro agio nella natura selvaggia gli eroi di Missione Yukon si sono sistemati in un nuovo accampamento sulle rive del fiume Hess. Dopo settimane di pioggia intensa possono finalmente dedicarsi a varie attività da cacciatori-raccoglitori, e apprendere antiche e straordinarie tecniche con laiuto di Kim, esperto della vita nei boschi. Le famiglie di Arianne e Jessica si divertono insieme e liberano la propria immaginazione negli immensi spazi del Canada nella sesta e penultima puntata della serie.

programme.title: The lady in yellow / La signora in giallo
programme.desc: Murder, She Wrote (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American crime drama series starring Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. It aired weekly on CBS from 1984 to 1996 and continued, with several TV movies, until 2003 (such as Sleeper Murder, The Rime of the Lost Boy and Appointment with Death). Angela Lansbury served as executive producer of the show in its final seasons. Jessica Fletcher is a perspicacious crime writer, who often finds herself dealing with mysterious murders, for which she always manages to discover the culprit. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small town, the fictional Cabot Cove in Maine. Although much of the success of Murder, She Wrote is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the producer's first choice. The part was initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however turned it down. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. È andato in onda settimanalmente sulla CBS dal 1984 al 1996 e continuò, con diversi TV-movie, fino al 2003 (come Vagone letto con omicidio, La ballata del ragazzo perduto e Appuntamento con la morte). Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni.Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. La parte era stato offerta inizialmente a Jean Stapleton e Doris Day, che però rifiutarono.

programme.title: The lady in yellow / La signora in giallo
programme.desc: Murder, She Wrote (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American crime drama series starring Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. It aired weekly on CBS from 1984 to 1996 and continued, with several TV movies, until 2003 (such as Sleeper Murder, The Rime of the Lost Boy and Appointment with Death). Angela Lansbury served as the show's executive producer in its final seasons. Jessica Fletcher is a perspicacious mystery writer, who often finds herself dealing with mysterious murders, for which she always manages to discover the culprit. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small town, the fictional Cabot Cove in Maine. Although much of the success of Murder, She Wrote is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the producer's first choice. The part was initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however turned it down. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. È andato in onda settimanalmente sulla CBS dal 1984 al 1996 e continuò, con diversi TV-movie, fino al 2003 (come Vagone letto con omicidio, La ballata del ragazzo perduto e Appuntamento con la morte). Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni. Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. La parte era stato offerta inizialmente a Jean Stapleton e Doris Day, che però rifiutarono.

Nella vita quotidiana si trova alle prese con una famiglia composta quasi esclusivamente da donne: la moglie Vanessa e le tre figlie Mandy, Eve e Kristin.

programme.title: Bonfire / Falò
programme.desc: The disputed gold of Gorla by Marco Tagliabue An important precious metals refinery, MKS PAMP, and the hardship of the neighborhood that hosts it: Gorla, a small hamlet of Castel San Pietro. A story that, between protests and discussions, has continued for forty years, animating two generations of citizens. The fumes that come out of the company's chimneys and the smells that sometimes invade the neighborhood have become the symbol of a difficult coexistence. Behind those fumes accumulate doubts, protests, silences and requests that often go unanswered. Meanwhile, a recent question in the Grand Council rekindles the case and calls for solutions. The Falò investigation recounts the fears of the residents, reports the timely responses of the company managers and documents the air controls carried out by the Canton. Antwerp, the refinery of discord by Mattia Pacella and Simon BrazzolaThe Value Trading gold refinery in Antwerp, Belgium, definitively ceased operations in 2024 after years of controversy. Located in the city, in the Jewish quarter, it was accused by residents of causing serious health problems. The Belgian Ministry of the Environment ultimately refused to renew the environmental license despite the absence of clear scientific evidence. The Falò reportage reconstructs the citizens' battle, the experts' assessments and the reactions of politicians. The dust of Cama by Gianluca Monnier In Cama, in Val Mesolcina, a group of inhabitants protests against a waste disposal and recycling center located close to the Moesa river. For some time, neighboring citizens have been bothered by the dust and loud noises that come from the recycling center that has been active for decades. In addition to complaints, neighboring residents also raise questions about the company's location and its compliance with the current planning zone. A long-standing and complex situation to which the municipal and cantonal authorities respond. / L’oro conteso di Gorla di Marco Tagliabue Un’importante raffineria di metalli preziosi, la MKS PAMP, e il disagio del quartiere che la ospita: Gorla, piccola frazione di Castel San Pietro. Una vicenda che, tra proteste e discussioni, si protrae da quarant’anni, animando due generazioni di cittadini. I fumi che escono dai camini dell’azienda e gli odori che a tratti invadono il quartiere, sono diventati il simbolo di una convivenza difficile. Dietro a quei fumi si accumulano dubbi, proteste, silenzi e richieste che spesso non trovano riscontro. Intanto, una recente interrogazione in Gran Consiglio riaccende il caso e chiede soluzioni. L’inchiesta di Falò racconta i timori dei residenti, riferisce le puntuali risposte dei manager dell’azienda e documenta i controlli sull’aria effettuati dal Cantone. Anversa, la raffineria della discordia di Mattia Pacella e Simon BrazzolaLa raffineria d’oro Value Trading di Anversa in Belgio nel 2024 ha cessato definitivamente l’attività dopo anni di polemiche. Situata in città, nel quartiere ebraico, veniva accusata dai residenti di causare gravi problemi sanitari. Il ministero dell’ambiente belga ha infine rifiutato di rinnovare la licenza ambientale nonostante l’assenza di prove scientifiche univoche. Il reportage di Falò ricostruisce la battaglia dei cittadini, le valutazioni degli esperti e le reazioni della politica.Le polveri di Cama di Gianluca MonnierA Cama, in Val Mesolcina, un gruppo di abitanti protesta contro un Centro di smaltimento e riciclaggio dei rifiuti che sorge a ridosso del fiume Moesa. Da diverso tempo i cittadini confinanti sono infastiditi dalle polveri e dai rumori molesti che provengono dal Centro di riciclaggio attivo da decenni. Oltre alle lamentele, i vicini residenti sollevano anche domande sull’ubicazione dell’azienda e la sua conformità con l’attuale zona di pianificazione. Una situazione annosa e complessa alla quale rispondono le autorità comunali e cantonali.

programme.title: Jane Got a Gun
programme.desc: Director: Gavin OConnor Cast: Natalie Portman, Joel Edgerton, Noah Emmerich, Ewan McGregor, Rodrigo Santoro, Boyd Holbrook Genre: Western Country: USA Year: 2015 In the West Jane Hammond and her husband Bill are hunted by the gang of the outlaw John Bishop, a very rich and powerful man, and live on a remote property on the prairie. Unfortunately, Bill is seriously injured and Jane finds herself alone against the imminent threat. To face Bishop and his men, Jane asks for help from Dan Frost, an ex-boyfriend of hers with whom she had lost contact due to the war. Initially Dan refuses to help Jane, by whom he still feels betrayed, but then he decides to stay by her side and the two prepare for the final battle. / Regia: Gavin OConnor Cast: Natalie Portman, Joel Edgerton, Noah Emmerich, Ewan McGregor, Rodrigo Santoro, Boyd Holbrook Genere: Western Nazione: USA Anno: 2015 Nel West Jane Hammond e suo marito Bill sono braccati dalla banda del fuorilegge John Bishop, un uomo molto ricco e potente, e vivono in una remota proprietà nella prateria. Sfortunatamente Bill viene gravemente ferito e Jane si ritrova sola contro limminente minaccia. Per affrontare Bishop e i suoi Jane chiede aiuto a Dan Frost, un suo ex fidanzato con cui aveva perso i contatti a causa della guerra. Inizialmente Dan rifiuta di aiutare Jane, dalla quale si sente ancora tradito, poi però decide di starle accanto e i due si preparano allo scontro finale.

programme.title: Locked Down
programme.desc: Paxton (Chiwetel Ejiofor) and Linda (Anne Hathaway) are about to break up but the arrival of Covid and the resulting lockdown forces them into a regime of forced cohabitation. She works as a manager for a multinational that trades in luxury goods, while he is the driver of an armored car. Neurotic, in a deep existential crisis, the two will find an unexpected complicity when, due to a series of circumstances, the opportunity arises to come into possession of a very precious diamond. / Paxton (Chiwetel Ejiofor) e Linda (Anne Hathaway) sono in procinto di lasciarsi ma larrivo del Covid e il conseguente lockdown li costringe a un regime di convivenza forzata. Lei lavora come manager per una multinazionale che commercia in beni di lusso, mentre lui fa lautista di un portavalori. Nevrotici, in profonda crisi esistenziale, i due ritroveranno uninaspettata complicità quando per una serie di circostanze si presenterà loccasione di entrare in possesso di un preziosissimo diamante.

programme.title: Bonfire / Falò
programme.sub-title: The agriculture of the future - Raid on the Atlantic / L’agricoltura del futuro - Razzia sull’Atlantico
programme.desc: Thousands of civilians killed while waiting for a food parcel. In the Gaza Strip people are not dying only from Israeli bombs. For months now, an increasing number of Palestinians have been targeted as they desperately try to grab food for their families. The very few food distribution points have turned into gigantic militarized traps. Exactly two years after the start of the war in response to the Hamas massacre of 7 October 2023, Falò returns to Israel again this time to document the traps of the food aid system, amidst the complaints of international organizations and Israel which denies it. According to the Swiss Philippe Lazzarini, general commissioner of UNRWA, the UN agency for aiding Palestinian refugees: "Gaza is becoming the cemetery of international humanitarian law." / Migliaia di civili uccisi in attesa di un pacco alimentare. Nella Striscia di Gaza non si muore solo per le bombe israeliane. Da mesi ormai un numero crescente di palestinesi viene colpito mentre cerca disperatamente di accaparrarsi del cibo per la propria famiglia. I pochissimi punti di distribuzione alimentare si sono trasformati in gigantesche trappole militarizzate. A due anni esatti dallinizio della guerra in risposta al massacro di Hamas del 7 ottobre 2023, Falò torna di nuovo in Israele questa volta per documentare le trappole del sistema degli aiuti alimentari, tra le denunce delle organizzazioni internazionali e Israele che nega. Secondo lo svizzero Philippe Lazzarini, commissario generale dellUNRWA, lAgenzia ONU per il soccorso ai profughi palestinesi: "Gaza sta diventando il cimitero del diritto umanitario internazionale."

programme.title: The lady in yellow / La signora in giallo
programme.desc: Murder, She Wrote (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American crime drama series starring Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. It aired weekly on CBS from 1984 to 1996 and continued, with several TV movies, until 2003 (such as Sleeper Murder, The Rime of the Lost Boy and Appointment with Death). Angela Lansbury served as executive producer of the show in its final seasons. Jessica Fletcher is a perspicacious crime writer, who often finds herself dealing with mysterious murders, for which she always manages to discover the culprit. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small town, the fictional Cabot Cove in Maine. Although much of the success of Murder, She Wrote is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the producer's first choice. The part was initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however turned it down. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. È andato in onda settimanalmente sulla CBS dal 1984 al 1996 e continuò, con diversi TV-movie, fino al 2003 (come Vagone letto con omicidio, La ballata del ragazzo perduto e Appuntamento con la morte). Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni.Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. La parte era stato offerta inizialmente a Jean Stapleton e Doris Day, che però rifiutarono.

programme.title: Paganini
programme.desc: Radiorchestra, Orchestra della Radiotelevisione Svizzera, Orchestra della Svizzera italiana are some of the names used over the years to indicate the only symphonic ensemble, stable, professional and with public functions that has ever existed in Italian Switzerland: the OSI - as it is commonly called today. The background against which the orchestra was born was that of the Lugano Belle Époque and the first stable musical ensemble was the little orchestra set up by the Kursaal SA company and the Hoteliers Society with the precise aim of providing the entertainment desired by tourists of Germanic culture. In 1933 the newly formed national radio organization partially took over - acquiring some services from the orchestra for its own radio programs - and in 1935 the transformation was completed, with the official birth of the Radioorchestra. Paganini celebrates - in his episode on Sunday 12 October, from 10.30 on RSI LA1 - the 90th anniversary of the Orchestra della Svizzera italiana, underlining its "internal" origins at RSI. On the one hand with two historic television productions: Symphony no. 3 Scozzese by Felix Mendelssohn conducted by Riccardo Chailly (in 1979, for a studio recording without an audience) and the Four Maritime Interludes from Peter Grimes by Benjamin Britten, conducted by Neville Marriner at the Primavera concertistica in Lugano in 1999. On the other hand, the homage delves into the historical significance of the "radio orchestras" thanks to the recent - and at times truly exciting - documentary by Magdalena Zieba-Schwind entitled 100 Years of Radio Orchestras. - Symphony no. 3 "Scottish" by Mendelssohn - 100 years of radio orchestras - Neville Marriner conducts the OSI / Radiorchestra, Orchestra della Radiotelevisione Svizzera, Orchestra della Svizzera italiana sono alcuni dei nomi utilizzati nel corso degli anni per indicare lunico ensemble sinfonico, stabile, professionistico e con funzioni pubbliche che sia mai esistito nella Svizzera italiana: lOSI - come oggi viene comunemente chiamata. Lo sfondo su cui lorchestra nacque è quello della Lugano Belle Époque e il primo ensemble musicale stabile fu proprio lorchestrina allestita dalla società Kursaal SA e dalla Società degli Albergatori col preciso scopo di fornire lintrattenimento desiderato dai turisti di cultura germanica. Nel 1933 subentrò parzialmente il neonato ente radiofonico nazionale - acquisendo alcuni servizi dallorchestra per i propri programmi radio - e nel 1935 si completò la trasformazione, con la nascita ufficiale della Radiorchestra. Paganini festeggia - nella sua puntata di domenica 12 ottobre, dalle 10.30 su RSI LA1 - i 90 anni dellOrchestra della Svizzera italiana sottolineandone le origini "interne" alla RSI. Da un lato con due storiche produzioni televisive: la Sinfonia n. 3 Scozzese di Felix Mendelssohn diretta da Riccardo Chailly (nel 1979, per una registrazione in studio senza pubblico) e i Quattro interludi marini da Peter Grimes di Benjamin Britten, diretti da Neville Marriner alla Primavera concertistica di Lugano del 1999. Dallaltro lato, lomaggio va ad approfondire il significato storico delle "orchestre radiofoniche" grazie al recente - e a tratti davvero appassionante - documentario di Magdalena Zieba-Schwind intitolato I 100 anni delle orchestre radiofoniche. - La Sinfonia n. 3 "Scozzese" di Mendelssohn - I 100 anni delle orchestre radiofoniche - Neville Marriner dirige lOSI
